raw.pt: Um guerreiro da República arruinada de Atharva. Um dos seis heróis que dizem ter enfrentado os deuses empunhando a Espada-Trovão Batootha. Durante a guerra com os deuses ele dizimou seus inimigos com velocidade espantosa e poderosos golpes trovejantes, apesar da desigualdade entre as forças. A épica história de seu resgate à Deusa Emilia ainda é tido como um conto atemporal.
raw.th: นักรับจากสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย ภายหลังเข้าได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษและเป็นผู้ที่ใช้ดาบสายฟ้าบาทูธ่าเข้าต่อสู้กับเหล่าทวยเทพ ในช่วงสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้าเขาทำลายศัตรูของเขาด้วยความเร็วที่ไม่น่าเชื่อ และสายฟ้าทำลายล้างก็ปัดเป่าได้ทุกอย่างแม้แต่โอกาสน่าขันเพียงน้อยนิดที่จะเอาชนะเทพเจ้า เรื่องมหากาพย์เกี่ยวเขาช่วยเหลือเทพธิดาเอมิเลียยังคงเป็นเรื่องเล่าอมตะไม่เสื่อมคลาย
raw.vi: Một chiến binh từ Cộng hòa Atharva  đổ nát.  Một trong sáu anh hùng và đã có một trận đánh với các vị thần Kiếm Sấm Batootha khi diễn ra cuộc chiến tranh lớn với các vị thần, ông đánh kẻ thù của mình với tốc độ khó nắm bắt và thổi sấm để phá hủy những ai đối đầu với ông. Câu chuyện sử thi của ông ta cứu Nữ thần Emilia vẫn được coi như một câu chuyện vượt thời gian

id: Pejuang dari reruntuhan Republik Atharva, ia kemudian menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Eze-lah yang menyelamatkan jenderal wanita Emilia dalam perang intens melawan para dewa. Saat itu Emilia berbicara kepada Eze, yang mulai terisi dengan kekuatan eksplosif lebih banyak dari sebelumnya. Eze kemudian menyombong ke teman tentang apa yang diucapkan Emilia. Ternyata Emilia berkata, "Kamu bukan orang idiot biasa. Kamu orang idiot yang harus dihormati."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40015_DESCRIPTION
desc: A warrior from the ruined Atharva Republic, he later became one of the Six Heroes. It was Eze who saved the republic's female general Emilia during the intense battle with the gods. At that time Emilia spoke to Eze, who then began to overflow with more explosive power than ever before. Eze later boasted of what Emilia had told him to a friend. Apparently, she had said "You're not just some idiot. You're an idiot to be respected."

raw.en: A warrior from the ruined Atharva Republic, he later became one of the Six Heroes. It was Eze who saved the republic's female general Emilia during the intense battle with the gods. At that time Emilia spoke to Eze, who then began to overflow with more explosive power than ever before. Eze later boasted of what Emilia had told him to a friend. Apparently, she had said "You're not just some idiot. You're an idiot to be respected."
raw.es: Guerrero de la antigua república de Atharva, que luego se convertiría en uno de los Seis héroes. Fue Eze quien salvó a Emilia, la general de la república, durante la intensa batalla contra los dioses. Fue entonces cuando Emilia habló con Eze, quien comenzó a sentir que un poder explosivo fluía dentro de él como nunca antes. Más adelante, Eze alardeó sobre lo que Emilia le había dicho. Aparentemente, las palabras de Emilia fueron las siguientes: "Tú no eres un simple idiota. Eres un idiota al que hay que respetar".
raw.id: Pejuang dari reruntuhan Republik Atharva, ia kemudian menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Eze-lah yang menyelamatkan jenderal wanita Emilia dalam perang intens melawan para dewa. Saat itu Emilia berbicara kepada Eze, yang mulai terisi dengan kekuatan eksplosif lebih banyak dari sebelumnya. Eze kemudian menyombong ke teman tentang apa yang diucapkan Emilia. Ternyata Emilia berkata, "Kamu bukan orang idiot biasa. Kamu orang idiot yang harus dihormati."
raw.pt: Um guerreiro da República arruinada de Atharva, que depois se tornou um dos Seis Heróis. Foi Eze quem salvou a general Emilia durante a intensa batalha com os deuses. Foi então que Emilia falou com Eze, que começou a transbordar com ainda mais poder explosivo do que antes. Eze depois se exibiu a um amigo do que Emilia lhe disse. Aparentemente, ela disse “Você não é apenas um idiota. Você é um idiota a ser respeitado.”
raw.th: นักรับจากสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย ภายหลังเข้าได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ อีเซ่เป็นผู้ช่วยชีวิตแม่ทัพหญิงเอมิเลียในช่วงการต่อสู้ที่ดุเดือดกับเทพเจ้า ในตอนนั้นเอมิเลียได้พูดกับอีเซ่ผู้ที่เริ่มเอ่อล้นไปด้วยพลังระเบิดที่มากขึ้นกว่าแต่ก่อน ภายหลังอีเซ่ได้คุยโวกับเพื่อนถึงคำพูดของเอมิเลียที่พูดกับเขาว่า "เจ้าน่ะไม่ได้เป็นแค่คนโง่หรอกนะ แต่เป็นคนโง่ที่น่านับถือ"
raw.vi: Một chiến binh đến từ nước Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát, anh trở thành một trong Sáu vị anh hùng. Đó là Eze người đã cứu nữ tướng Emilia của nước cộng hòa trong trận chiến dữ dội với các vị thần. Lúc đó Emilia đã nói chuyện với Eze, người sau đó đã bắt đầu tràn đầy sức mạnh bùng nổ hơn bao giờ hết. Sau này, Eze đã tự hào về những gì Emilia đã kể về anh với một người bạn. Hình như, cô đã nó "Anh không chỉ là một chàng ngốc. Anh là một chàng ngốc cần được tôn trọng."

id: Selagi menuju jantung perang melawan para dewa, seorang wanita muncul untuk mengancam nyawanya. Menolak bertarung melawan wanita, Eze ragu dalam menyerbu saat serangan buas terus menyerbunya. Namun melalui percakapan mereka, Eze akhirnya menyadari niat wanita ini, dan meraih kekuatan lebih besar daripada dewa, lalu ia menghabisinya. Sesaat setelahnya, ksatria seorang diri datang, muncul di depan Eze dengan mimik sedih. Eze tersenyum lebar membalasnya, dan membalikkan pedang, lalu bunuh diri. Katanya, Eze berseru, "Hanya aku yang bisa mengalahkan diri sendiri!" dan dia mati.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40016_DESCRIPTION
desc: As he made his way onto the heart of the battle against the gods, a woman appeared to threaten his life. Refusing to fight with a woman, Eze hesitated to strike her as her ferocious attacks kept coming at him. However, through their exchange Eze finally realized the extent of this woman's resolution, and attaining powers greater than those of the gods, he took her life. Shortly after, a lone knight appeared before Eze, speaking to him with a sad expression on his face. Eze smiled broadly in response, and turning his blade towards himself, took his own life. It is said that Eze exclaimed "Only I can defeat my own self!" as he perished.

raw.en: As he made his way onto the heart of the battle against the gods, a woman appeared to threaten his life. Refusing to fight with a woman, Eze hesitated to strike her as her ferocious attacks kept coming at him. However, through their exchange Eze finally realized the extent of this woman's resolution, and attaining powers greater than those of the gods, he took her life. Shortly after, a lone knight appeared before Eze, speaking to him with a sad expression on his face. Eze smiled broadly in response, and turning his blade towards himself, took his own life. It is said that Eze exclaimed "Only I can defeat my own self!" as he perished.
raw.es: Mientras iba de camino hacia el corazón de la batalla contra los dioses, una mujer apareció y amenazó con quitarle la vida. Eze se negó a luchar contra una mujer, aunque dudó debido a los feroces ataques que la guerrera no dejaba de lanzarle. Debido al intercambio de agresiones, Eze comprendió lo decidida que estaba la mujer. Luego, desarrolló poderes más abrumadores que los de los dioses y le quitó la vida. Poco después, un caballero solitario apareció delante de Eze y le habló con una expresión de tristeza en el rostro. Eze esbozó una gran sonrisa, tomó su espada y se quitó la vida. Se dice que Eze exclamó "¡Solo yo puedo derrotarme a mí mismo!" mientras moría.

raw.pt: Conforme entrava na batalha contra os deuses, uma mulher apareceu para ameaçar sua vida. Recusando lutar com uma mulher, Eze hesitou em atacá-la conforme ela o atacava vorazmente. Porém, percebendo a determinação dessa mulher, Eze juntou poderes maiores que dos deuses e tirou a vida da mulher. Logo em seguida, um cavaleiro apareceu para ele, falando com uma expressão triste. Eze sorriu em resposta, virou sua espada contra si e tirou a própria vida. Dizem que Eze exclamou “Apenas eu posso me derrotar!” enquanto perecia.
raw.th: ขณะที่อีเซ่เข้าไปยังศูนย์กลางการต่อสู้กับเทพ มีสตรีผู้หนึ่งปรากฎตัวขึ้นหมายจะคุกคามชีวิตของเขา แต่เขาปฏิเสธการต่อสู้กับผู้หญิง อีเซ่ลังเลที่จะตอบโต้ขณะที่หล่อนโจมตีใส่เขาอย่างรุนแรง แต่ในที่สุด อีเซ่ก็เข้าใจการตัดสินใจของเธอ จึงกำจัดเธอเพื่อให้ตนได้รับพลังที่เหนือกว่าเทพ แต่ทันใดนั้น อัศวินผู้หนึ่งก็ปรากฎตัวขึ้นและพูดกับเขาด้วยสีหน้าเศร้า แต่อีเซ่กลับยิ้มและใช้ดาบของตนสังหารตัวเอง ว่ากันว่าอีเซ่ตะโกนร้องว่า "มีแต่ข้าเท่านั้นที่สังหารตัวเองได้" ก่อนตาย
raw.vi: Khi anh đi vào giữa trận chiến chống lại các vị thần, một phụ nữ đã xuất hiện đe dọa đến tính mạng của anh. Từ chối đánh nhau với phụ nữ, Eze ngần ngại tấn công cô khi những đòn tấn công dữ dội của cô vẫn nhắm vào anh. Tuy nhiên, qua trao đổi Eze cuối cùng đã nhận ra mức độ cương quyết của người phụ nữ này và đạt được sức mạnh lớn hơn sức mạnh của các vị thần, anh đã giết cô ta. Ngay sau đó, một hiệp sĩ đơn độc đã xuất hiện trước mặt Eze, nói với anh với vẻ mặt buồn rầu. Eze mỉm cười một cách rộng rãi để đáp lại và quay lưỡi kiếm của anh về phía mình rồi tự sát. Tương truyền rằng Eze thét lên "Chỉ ta mới có thể đánh bại chính bản thân ta!" khi anh chết.

id: Seorang ahli taktik dari Republik Atharva yang hancur, dia memimpin republik dengan keahlian strategis dan sihirnya, tapi tidak pernah memimpin sebagai komandan. Bukan karena pengecut, tapi karena dia menyadari dia punya peran lain yang lebih penting. Dia meninggalkan banyak buku tentang teori-teorinya yang masih menjadi dasar dari ahli taktik modern.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40021_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic, he led the republic in strategic ability and magic, but never took charge when it came to being a commander. That was not due to cowardice, but due to recognizing he had a different, more important role to play. He left many books organizing his theories which are still used as a foundation for modern tacticians.

raw.en: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic, he led the republic in strategic ability and magic, but never took charge when it came to being a commander. He left many books organizing his theories which are still used as a foundation for modern tacticians.
raw.es: Consejero de la república de Atharva que dirigió al ejército con sus dotes estrategas y magia, pero no se unió al frente como comandante. No fue por cobardía, sino porque creyó tener otro puesto más importante que desempeñar. Fue el autor de numerosos libros con teorías sobre estrategia bélica.

Isso não foi devido à covardia, mas devido ao reconhecimento de que ele tinha um papel diferente, mais importante. Ele deixou muitos livros detalhando suas teorias, que ainda são usados como fundação por estrategistas modernos.
raw.th: นักวางกลยุทธ์จากสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย เขานำสาธารณรัฐด้วยความสามารถในการวางแผนและเวทมนตร์ แต่ไม่เคยมารับภาระหน้าที่ผู้ญชาการในสนามรบแต่อย่างใด ไม่ใช่เพราะความขลาดกลัว แต่เป็นเพราะรู้หน้าที่และบทบาทที่สำคัญมากกว่าของตัวเขา เขาได้ทิ้งตำราไว้มากมายเกี่ยวกับทฤษฎีของเขาซึ่งยังคงถูกใช้เป็นพื้นฐานสำคัญสำหรับนักวางกลยุทธ์รุ่นใหม่
raw.vi: Một nhà chiến thuật từ  Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát. Ông đã lãnh đạo đất nước với khả năng chiến lược và ma thuật, nhưng không bao giờ chịu trách nhiệm khi nó được áp dụng. Đó không phải là do hèn nhát, nhưng nhờ nhận thức, ông đã có một thay đổi và giữ  vai trò quan trọng hơn trong trận đánh. Ông để lại nhiều sách về lý thuyết vẫn còn được sử dụng như một nền tảng cho chiến thuật gia hiện đại.

id: Seorang ahli taktik dari Republik Atharva yang hancur. Dia dikritik karena tidak pernah muncul di baris depan, tapi dia tidak memperdulikan komentar itu dan melanjutkan kepemimpinannya. Setelah perang melawan dewa dimulai, dia akan menghancurkan musuhnya dengan sihir. Ini membuat dia dikagumi, tapi dia menjadi malu bahwa dia diserang, dan mencatatnya sebagai kesalahan terbesarnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40022_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic. He was criticized for never appearing at the front, but he paid no mind to such comments and continued his command. After the war with the gods began,  he would annihilate his enemies with his magic. This earned him admiration, but he was ashamed that he had been attacked, and recorded it as his greatest mistake.

raw.es: Estratega de la antigua república de Atharva. Fue duramente criticado por no luchar al frente, pero hizo oídos sordos a esto y siguió liderando su ejército. Tras iniciarse la guerra contra los dioses, aniquiló a sus rivales con su magia y ganó algo de respeto, aunque se sintió avergonzado por el mero hecho de que alguien hubiera podido atacarlo.

raw.pt: Um estrategista da República arruinada de Atharva. Ele foi criticado por nunca comparecer à frente de batalha, mas ele não deu importância a tais comentários e continuou seu comando. Depois do início da guerra com os deuses, ele viria a aniquilar seus inimigos com sua magia. Isso fez com que ele fosse admirado, mas ele tinha vergonha de ter sido atacado, e registrou isso como seu maior erro.
raw.th: นักวางกลยุทธ์จากสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย เขาถูกวิจารณ์ว่าไม่เคยออกไปรบในแนวหน้า แต่เขาก็ไม่ใส่ใจและยังคงทำหน้าที่ออกคำสั่งในแนวหลังต่อไป หลังจากสงครามกับเหล่าทวยเทพเริ่มต้นขึ้น เขาได้กวาดล้างศัตรูด้วยเวทมนตร์ของเขา ซึ่งทำให้เขาได้รับการชื่นชม แต่เขากลับอับอายที่ถูกบุกโจมตีและบันทึกเหตุการณ์ครั้งนี้ไว้ว่าเป็นความผิดพลาดครั้งใหญ่ของเขา
raw.vi: Một nhà chiến thuật từ  Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát.  Ông bị chỉ trích vì không bao giờ đi tiên phong, nhưng ông không để tâm đến những ý kiến và tiếp tục chỉ huy. Sau khi cuộc chiến với các vị thần bắt đầu, ông tiêu diệt kẻ thù của mình với phép thuật của mình. Điều này làm cho mọi người ngưỡng mộ, nhưng ông cảm thấy xấu hổ khi ông đã bị tấn công, và xem nó như là sai lầm lớn nhất của ông.

id: Seorang ahli taktik dari Republik Atharva yang hancur. Matanya yang tajam tentang strategi tidak hanya memprediksi kekalahannya, tapi juga bahwa beberapa dewa mau menyelamatkan manusia. Karena pandangannya itu, dia berfokus untuk bertahan hidup dan bukan menang. Banyak prajurit yang menganggapnya lemah, tapi sebagai hasilnya, banyak orang yang terselamatkan olehnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40023_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic. His strong eye for strategy not only saw his imminent defeat, but also that there were still some gods willing to save humanity. Due to this foresight he focused on surviving instead of winning. Many soldiers called him weak, but the result was that many people were saved by him.

raw.en: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic. His strong eye for strategy not only saw his imminent defeat, but also that there were still some gods willing to save humanity. Due to this foresight he focused on surviving instead of winning. Many soldiers called him weak, but the result was that many people were saved by him.
raw.es: Estratega de la antigua república de Atharva. Su talento para la estrategia predijo su inminente derrota, pero también que habría dioses dispuestos a salvar a la humanidad. Gracias a su predicción, se centró en sobrevivir en lugar de vencer y llegó a salvar numerosas vidas, a pesar de que muchos lo tacharan de cobarde.

Karena pandangannya itu, dia berfokus untuk bertahan hidup dan bukan menang. Banyak prajurit yang menganggapnya lemah, tapi sebagai hasilnya, banyak orang yang terselamatkan olehnya.
raw.pt: Um estrategista da República arruinada de Atharva. Seu olho atento para a estratégia viu não somente sua derrota iminente, mas também que alguns deuses estavam dispostos a salvar a humanidade. Devido a esse conhecimento, ele focou em sobreviver em vez de vencer. Muitos soldados o chamaram de fraco, mas o resultado foi que ele salvou muitas vidas.
raw.th: นักวางกลยุทธ์จากสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย สายตาที่คมของเขาสำหรับการวางกลยุทธ์์ไม่เพียงแต่เห็นความพ่ายแพ้ของเขาที่ใกล้เข้ามา แต่ยังอีกด้วยว่ามีเทพเจ้าบางตนยินดีที่จะช่วยเหลือมนุษยชาติ เนื่องจากการคาดการณ์นี้เขาจึงจดจ่ออยู่กับการรอดชีวิตแทนการเอาชนะ ทหารมากมายว่าเขาอ่อนแอ แต่ผลสุดท้ายมันกลับช่วยชีวิตคนได้มากมาย
raw.vi: Một nhà chiến thuật từ  Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát. Đôi mắt mạnh mẽ của ông không chỉ nhìn thấy chiến lược thất bại sắp xảy ra mà còn cũng vẫn còn có một số vị thần sẵn sàng để cứu nhân loại. Do tầm nhìn xa này, ông tập trung vào sống sót thay vì chiến thắng. Nhiều binh sĩ cho rằng ông yếu, nhưng kết quả là nhiều người đã được ông cứu

id: Ahli taktik dari reruntuhan Republik Atharva. Saat Lucius mendekat untuk membantu, Weiss mengaktifkan strategi akhirnya. Ia memakai dirinya sendiri sebagai pemancing agar yang lain bisa lolos. Meski tidak ada harapan untuk penegakan, dengan moral baru, anak buahnya mengikuti setiap ucapannya. Saat rakyatnya lolos dan dia bersama pasukannya nyaris kalah, legenda bilang ia berkata, "Akhirnya, kurasa, kita menang."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40024_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic. Just as Lucius was reaching out to help, Weiss enacted his final end strategy. He used himself as a decoy so that others could escape. Despite there being no hope for reinforcements, with renewed morale his men followed his every word. Just as his people had escaped and he and his men were on the verge of defeat, legend has it that he said, "In the end, I guess we won."

raw.en: A tactician from the ruined Atharva Republic. Just as Lucius was reaching out to help, Weiss enacted his final end strategy. He used himself as a decoy so that others could escape. Despite there being no hope for reinforcements, with renewed morale his men followed his every word. Just as his people had escaped and he and his men were on the verge of defeat, legend has it that he said, "In the end, I guess we won."
raw.es: Estratega de la antigua república de Atharva. En el momento en que Lucius clamaba por ayuda, Weiss diagramó su estrategia final. Se propuso distraer a los enemigos para que los demás pudieran escapar. A pesar de que no había esperanzas de que llegaran refuerzos, sus hombres, con la moral renovada, siguieron todas sus órdenes. Justo cuando su gente había escapado, y él y sus hombres estaban al borde de la derrota, la leyenda cuenta que Weiss dijo: "Al final, creo que hemos ganado".
raw.id: Ahli taktik dari reruntuhan Republik Atharva. Saat Lucius mendekat untuk membantu, Weiss mengaktifkan strategi akhirnya. Ia memakai dirinya sendiri sebagai pemancing agar yang lain bisa lolos. Meski tidak ada harapan untuk penegakan, dengan moral baru, anak buahnya mengikuti setiap ucapannya. Saat rakyatnya lolos dan dia bersama pasukannya nyaris kalah, legenda bilang ia berkata, "Akhirnya, kurasa, kita menang."
raw.pt: Um estrategista da República arruinada de Atharva. Quando Lucius estava procurando por ajuda, Weiss fez a sua estratégia final. Ele usou a si mesmo como chamariz para que os outros pudessem escapar. Apesar de não haver esperança de reforços, seus homens seguiram a cada uma de suas ordens com moral revigorada. Assim que as pessoas escaparam e ele e seus homens estavam à beira da derrota, reza a lenda que ele falou, “No fim das contas, acho que ganhamos”.
raw.th: นักวางกลยุทธ์จากสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย ในขณะที่ลูเชียสกำลังยื่นมือเข้าช่วยเหลือ ไวส์ได้กำหนดยุทธวิธีสุดท้ายของเขาไว้ เขาจะใช้ตนเองเป็นตัวล่อเพื่อให้ผู้อื่นสามารถหลบหนีไป  แม้ว่าจะไม่มีความหวังที่จะให้กองหนุนมาช่วยเหลือ แต่ด้วยการปลุกใจของเขาเหล่าทหารก็พร้อมทำตามคำสั่งทุกประการ ในขณะที่ประชาชนของเขาหลบหนีและทหารของเขากำลังอยู่ในช่วงความเป็นความตาย ตำนานกล่าวไว้ว่าเขาพูดว่า "ท้ายที่สุดแล้ว ข้าว่าพวกเราชนะ"
raw.vi: Một chiến thuật gia đến từ nước Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát. Ngay khi Lucius đưa tay ra giúp đỡ, Weiss đã đưa ra chiến lược cuối cùng của mình. Ông sử dụng bản thân làm mồi nhử để những người khác có thể trốn thoát. Mặc dù không có hy vọng gì ở quân tiếp viện, nhưng với tinh thần đã được khôi phục, những người hầu của ông đã làm theo mọi lời ông nói. Ngay khi người dân của mình đã trốn thoát và ông và người hầu của ông đang trên bờ vực của sự thất bại, truyền thuyết kể rằng ông đã nói "Cuối cùng, ta đoán chúng ta đã thắng."

id: Ahli taktik yang sukses mengevakuasi banyak orang selama perang besar dengan para dewa. Ia menjadikan diri sendiri umpan pada strategi terakhir, menghadapi musuh sebagai penyihir sendirian. Ia juga menggunakan intel dari burung-burungnya yang terbang, membuatnya tahu pergerakan Tentara Dewa. Menentukan titik lemah musuh dari langit, tentara dewa mulai takut padanya. Kilat tiada batas juga mampu membelah dewa menjadi dua.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40025_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tactician who succeeded in helping many people to evacuate during the great war with the gods. He served as bait for his own final strategic ploy, facing off against the enemy as a lone sorcerer. He also used the intel he gained from his beloved birds as they spied from the skies, rendering him able to keep up with the God Army's movements. Determining his enemy's weak points from the heavens, the god army learned to fear him. His limitless lightning is said to have been able to split the gods in half.

raw.en: A tactician who succeeded in helping many people to evacuate during the great war with the gods. He served as bait for his own final strategic ploy, facing off against the enemy as a lone sorcerer. He also used the intel he gained from his beloved birds as they spied from the skies, rendering him able to keep up with the God Army's movements. Determining his enemy's weak points from the heavens, the god army learned to fear him. His limitless lightning is said to have been able to split the gods in half.
raw.es: Un estratega que logró ayudar a muchísima gente a escapar durante la gran guerra contra los dioses. Tomó el rol de cebo en su plan estratégico final y se enfrentó al enemigo solo con sus poderes. También utilizó la información que obtuvieron sus amadas aves desde los cielos y, gracias a ella, siempre estuvo al tanto de los movimientos del ejército de los dioses. Como podía determinar los puntos débiles de sus enemigos desde los aires, los dioses aprendieron a temerle. Se dice que su ilimitada fuerza eléctrica era capaz de partir a los dioses por la mitad.

Ia juga menggunakan intel dari burung-burungnya yang terbang, membuatnya tahu pergerakan Tentara Dewa. Menentukan titik lemah musuh dari langit, tentara dewa mulai takut padanya. Kilat tiada batas juga mampu membelah dewa menjadi dua.
raw.pt: Um tático que auxiliou na fuga de muitas pessoas durante a grande guerra com os deuses. Ele serviu como isca para seu próprio plano, encarando o inimigo como um feiticeiro solitário. Ele usava informações de seus adorados pássaros, que espionavam do alto e informavam sobre os movimentos do exército dos deuses. Determinando os pontos fracos dos seus inimigos, o exército dos deuses aprendeu a temê-lo. Dizem que seus raios ilimitados poderiam dividir os deuses ao meio.
raw.th: นักยุทธศาสตร์ผู้ประสบความสำเร็จในการช่วยเหลือผู้คนมากมายให้หลบหนีไประหว่างสงครมครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้า เขาได้ใช้ตัวเองเป็นเหยื่อล่อในกลยุทธครั้งสุดท้ายของเขา คอยเผชิญหน้ากับศัตรูเพียงลำพังในฐานะจอมเวทย์ เขายังได้ใช้ข่าวกรองจากนกสุดที่รักของเขาที่คอยสอดแนมบนท้องฟ้า ทำให้เขาสามารถตามความเคลื่อนไหวของกองทัพเทพเจ้าได้ทัน การคํานวณจุดอ่อนแอของศัตรูของเขาจากสวรรค์, กองทัพเทพเจ้าเริ่มหวาดกลัวเขา สายฟ้าที่มีไม่จำกัดของเขาว่ากันว่าได้ผ่าครึ่งเทพเจ้าร่างของเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Một chiến thuật gia đã thành công trong việc giúp nhiều người sơ tán trong cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần. Ông đã từng làm mồi nhử cho mưu đồ chiến lược cuối cùng của chính mình, đối mặt với kẻ thù như một phù thủy đơn độc. Ông cũng đã sử dụng những thông tin ông có được từ đàn chim yêu quý của ông khi chúng bay đi do thám khắp bầu trời, giúp ông có thể theo dõi nhất cử nhất động của Đội Quân Các Vị Thần. Xác định những điểm yếu của kẻ thù từ trên trời, đội quân các vị thần phải kính sợ ông. Tia sét không giới hạn của ông được cho rằng đã có thể chẻ đôi các vị thần.

id: Setan tipe air yang terbungkus listrik, katanya muncul ketika guntur menggelegar. Punya tanduk di kepalanya dan pola hitam di badannya. Sangat nakal dan tertawa dengan teman-temannya sambil menyetrum manusia. Mereka masih lemah dan levelnya rendah, tapi seperti banyak jelly lainnya, cocok untuk lawan bertarung Pemanggil baru.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40030_DESCRIPTION
desc: A liquid-type demon wrapped in electricity, thought to appear when lighting strikes. It has a horn on its head and a black pattern on its body. It is mischievous and laughs with its friends as it electrically shocks humans. Sparky is still a weak and very low level monster, but like so many other liquid-type enemies, they are perfect sparring partners for new Summoners.

raw.en: A liquid-type demon wrapped in electricity, thought to appear when lighting strikes. It has a horn on its head and a black pattern on its body. It is mischievous and laughs with its friends as it electrically shocks humans. Sparky is still a weak and very low level monster, but like so many other liquid-type enemies, they are perfect sparring partners for new Summoners.
raw.es: Criatura cargada de electricidad que supuestamente nació de un rayo. Tiene un cuerno en la cabeza y rayas negras por el cuerpo. Es travieso y le gusta electrocutar humanos. Es una unidad de bajo nivel pero, como sus otros compañeros elementales, resulta perfecto para los nuevos invocadores.
raw.id: Setan tipe air yang terbungkus listrik, katanya muncul ketika guntur menggelegar. Punya tanduk di kepalanya dan pola hitam di badannya. Sangat nakal dan tertawa dengan teman-temannya sambil menyetrum manusia. Mereka masih lemah dan levelnya rendah, tapi seperti banyak jelly lainnya, cocok untuk lawan bertarung Pemanggil baru.
raw.pt: Um demônio do tipo líquido envolto em eletricidade, que acredita-se aparece quando cai um raio. Ele tem um chifre em sua cabeça e um padrão na cor preta por seu corpo. Ele é levado e ri junto a seus amigos quando causa choques em humanos. Eles ainda são fracos e de nível baixo, mas como tantos outros viscos eles são perfeitos parceiros de treinamento para Invocadores novatos.
raw.th: ปีศาจชนิดของเหลวที่ห่อหุ้มไปด้วยกระแสไฟฟ้า มันจะปรากฎตัวขึ้นมาเมื่อมีฟ้าผ่า มันมีเขาอยู่บนหัวและลายสีดำบนตัว มันเป็นอันตรายและหัวเราะกับเพื่อนของมันเมื่อใช้ไฟฟ้าช๊อตมนุษย์ พวกมันยังคงอ่อนแอและมีระดับต่ำแต่ก็เช่นเดียวกับสไลม์ชนิดอื่นๆ มันเป็นคู่ซ้อมชั้นดีสำหรับซัมมอนเนอร์มือใหม่
raw.vi: Một tên quỷ lỏng có các dòng điện xung quanh người và chỉ xuất hiện khi không có ánh sáng. Nó có một cái sừng trên đầu và một hình săm màu đen trên cơ thể. Nó tinh nghịch và cười với những ai bị nó sốc điện vào người. Sức mạnh của chúng vẫn yếu và ở mức rất thấp, nhưng cũng giống như rất nhiều chất lỏng khác, chúng là những đối tác spat đối với những Summoner mới.

id: Ketika Jelly Guntur diisi, dia berubah menjadi Raja Jelly Guntur. Kekuatan setrumannya jauh di atas Jelly Guntur, dan dia dapat membuat Pemanggil baru kerepotan dengan cepat. Sifatnya suka perang, memaksa Pemanggil bertarung kalau bertemu dengan mereka. Jadi, banyak Pemanggil yang langsung bersembunyi kalau melihat Raja Jelly Guntur.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40031_DESCRIPTION
desc: When Sparky charges up, it evolves into King Sparky. Its new electric shock power far exceeds that of the regular Sparky, and it can quickly put new Summoners in a bind. It has a very warlike nature, forcing Summoners into battle once it spots them. Thus, many Summoners immediately hide after spotting a King Sparky.

raw.en: When Sparky charges up, it evolves into King Sparky. Its new electric shock power far exceeds that of the regular Sparky, and it can quickly put new Summoners in a bind. It has a very warlike nature, forcing Summoners into battle once it spots them. Thus, many Summoners immediately hide after spotting a King Sparky.
raw.es: Cuando Chispitas acumula suficiente carga se convierte en monarca. Su nuevo rayo eléctrico supera al de su predecesor y puede ponerte en más de un aprieto. Su carácter bélico hace que ataque a cualquier invocador con el que se encuentre, por lo que conviene esconderse de él.

Sifatnya suka perang, memaksa Pemanggil bertarung kalau bertemu dengan mereka. Jadi, banyak Pemanggil yang langsung bersembunyi kalau melihat Raja Jelly Guntur.
raw.pt: Quando o Sparky adquire carga, ele se transforma no Rei Sparky. Seu novo poder elétrico excede em muito o de um visco elétrico comum, e ele pode colocar Invocadores novatos em apuros em um piscar de olhos. Ele tem uma natureza belicosa, forçando Invocadores ao combate assim que os vê. Por isso, muitos Invocadores se escondem imediatamente ao ver um Rei Sparky.
raw.th: เมื่อสไลม์สายฟ้าสะสมพลังเพิ่มขึ้น มันจะพัฒนาเป็นราชาสไลม์สายฟ้า พลังช๊อตไฟฟ้าใหม่ของมันสูงเกินกว่าสไลม์สายฟ้าทั่วไป และสามารถตรึงซัมมอนเนอร์ใหม่ๆ ได้อย่างรวดเร็ว ธรรมชาติของมันชอบการต่อสู้และบังคับให้ซัมมอนเนอร์ต้องสู้กับมันเมื่อพบเห็น ทำให้ซัมมอนเนอร์มากมายหลบ หลังจากสังเกตุเห็นราชาสไลม์สายฟ้า
raw.vi: Khi Bolt Slime tích điện, nó phát triển thành Vua Bolt Slime.Sức mạnh của sốc điện mới sẽ vượt xa so với Bolt Slime, và nó có thể nhanh chóng đưa Summoner mới trong liên kết. Nó có tính chất rất hiếu chiến, buộc Summoner phải đánh nhau với chúng một lần. Vì thế, nhiều Summoner trốn ngay lập tức phát hiện ra Vua Bolt Slime.

id: Penari yang cantik, dan sangat populer di Republk Atharva yang hancur. Tariannya membuat banyak orang kagum, kadang kasar, kadang terkesima. Banyak yang berkata bahwa orang menjadi sembuh badan dan pikirannya oleh tariannya. Meskipun telah diketahui bahwa kekuatan sihirnya adalah hasil dari tariannya yang berkekuatan setan, popularitasnya tidak pernah menurun.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40040_DESCRIPTION
desc: A beautiful dancer, extremely popular in the ruined Atharva Republic. Her dancing fascinates many people, sometimes violent, sometimes bewitching. There are many accounts of people gladly having their bodies, and their minds, healed by her dancing. Although it was later made public that her magic power was the result of her dance's demonic nature, her popularity never declined.

raw.en: A beautiful dancer, extremely popular in the ruined Atharva Republic. Her dancing fascinates many people, sometimes violent, sometimes bewitching. There are many accounts of people gladly having their bodies, and their minds, healed by her dancing. Although it was later made public that her magic power was the result of her dance's demonic nature, her popularity never declined.
raw.es: Bella y famosa bailarina de la antigua república de Atharva. Sus danzas, algunas violentas y otras cautivadoras, fascinaron a muchos. Hay quien dice haber notado cómo los bailes llegaban a curarlos tanto física como mentalmente. Poco después se supo que esto se debía a su naturaleza demoníaca, pero no por ello su popularidad dejó de crecer.

Meskipun telah diketahui bahwa kekuatan sihirnya adalah hasil dari tariannya yang berkekuatan setan, popularitasnya tidak pernah menurun.
raw.pt: Uma dançarina exótica, extremamente popular na República arruinada de Atharva. Muitas pessoas são fascinadas por sua dança às vezes violenta, às vezes sedutora. Existem muitos relatos de pessoas alegremente tendo seus corpos e mentes curados por sua dança. E apesar de mais tarde ter se tornado público o fato que seu poder mágico era devido à natureza demoníaca da dança, sua popularidade nunca diminuiu.
raw.th: นักเต้นแสนสวย  โด่งดังมากในสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย การเต้นของเธอทำให้คนมากมายหลงไหล บางครั้งก็รุนแรง บางครั้งก็มีเสน่ห์ มีคนมากมายยินดีที่จะให้ร่างกายและจิตใจของพวกเขาได้รับการเยีวยาด้วยการเต้นของเธอ แม้ในภายหลังจะเป็นที่รับรู้กันอย่างเป็นทางการว่าพลังเวทของเธอเป็นผลมาจากธรรมชาติปีศาจของการเต้นรำ ความโด่งดังของเธอก็ไม่เคยลดลง
raw.vi: Một vũ công xinh đẹp, một nghề rất phổ biến ở Cộng hòa  Atharva đổ nát. Điệu nhảy của cô ta làm mê hoặc nhiều người, đôi khi bạo lực, đôi khi mê hồn. Có rất nhiều loại người hãnh diễn với cơ thể của họ, và tâm trí của họ, chữa lành bệnh bởi điệu nhảy của cô. Mặc dù sau đó đã được công bố công khai rằng sức mạnh ma thuật của cô là kết quả của bản chất ma quỷ nhảy của cô, nổi tiếng của cô không bao giờ từ chối.

id: Penari yang cantik, sangat populer di Republik Atharva yang hancur. Dia menyembuhkan banyak orang dengan tarian setan magisnya. Setelah perang dengan para dewa dimulai, dia melawan para dewa dengan tariannya yang bisa memanggil guntur dan juga menyembuhkan. Sosoknya memikat banyak orang, dan kalau dia kembali dari perang dengan terluka, dokter dari seluruh negara datang untuk merawatnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40041_DESCRIPTION
desc: A beautiful dancer, extremely popular in the ruined Atharva Republic. She healed many with her magical demon dance. After the war with the gods began, she stood up to the gods as her dance could call forth thunder as well as heal. Her figure charmed many, and when she returned from battle injured, doctors from all over the country came to treat her.

Her figure charmed many, and when she returned from battle injured, doctors from all over the country came to treat her.
raw.es: Bella y famosa bailarina de la antigua república de Atharva que era capaz de curar con sus bailes demoníacos. Al comenzar la guerra contra los dioses, hizo frente a los dioses con su magia curativa y ofensiva. Su figura la hizo cautivadora y, en cuanto volvía del combate herida, miles de médicos venían en su rescate a tratarla.

Sosoknya memikat banyak orang, dan kalau dia kembali dari perang dengan terluka, dokter dari seluruh negara datang untuk merawatnya.
raw.pt: Uma dançarina exótica, extremamente popular na República arruinada de Atharva. Ela curou muitos com sua dança mágica demoníaca. Quando a guerra contra os deuses começou, ela os enfrentou já que sua dança podia chamar trovões tanto quanto curar. Sua figura encantava muitos, e quando ela voltou ferida da batalha, médicos de todo o país vieram tratá-la.
raw.th: นักเต้นแสนสวย  โด่งดังมากในสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย เธอรักษาคนมากมายด้วยเวทมนตร์การเต้นปีศาจของเธอ หลังจากที่สงครามกับเหล่าเทพเริ่มต้นขึ้น เธอได้ยืนหยัดต่อต้านเหล่าเทพเพราะการเต้นของเธอสามารถรักษาและเรียกสายฟ้าได้ด้วย รูปร่างของเธอทำให้คนมากมายหลงไหลและเมื่อเธอได้รับบาดเจ็บกลับมาจากสงคราม บรรดาหมอจากทั่วประเทศต่างมาเพื่อรักษาเธอ
raw.vi: Một vũ công xinh đẹp, một nghề rất phổ biến ở Cộng hòa  Atharva đổ nát. Cô chữa lành bệnh với điệu nhảy ma thuật của mình. Sau khi cuộc chiến với các vị thần bắt đầu, cô đã dùng điệu nhảy của mình để chữa lành bệnh. Cơ thể của cô quyến rũ nhiều người, và khi cô trở về từ cuộc chiến do bị thương, các thầy thuốc từ khắp nơi trên đất nước đến để điều trị cho cô.

id: Penari cantik, sangat populer di Republik Atharva yang hancur. Perang intens dengan para dewa berlanjut, ia makin menyuntikkan kekuatan dalam tarian setan sihirnya. Ia mengeluarkan guntur atas para musuh selagi ia peduli pada sekutunya. Bahkan kehadirannya menginspirasi siapa saja yang bertarung di sisinya. Mengetahui hal ini, para dewa berkonsentrasi menyerang dia, tetapi banyak prajurit di sekitarnya bertindak sebagai perisai dan membelanya dari serangan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40042_DESCRIPTION
desc: A beautiful dancer, extremely popular in the ruined Atharva Republic. As the intense battle with the gods continued, she injected even more force into her magical demon dance. She unleashed thunder above her enemies as she cared for her allies. It is said that even just her presence inspired those who fought alongside her. Having noticed this, the gods concentrated their attack on her, but many soldiers around her gathered to act as her shield and defend her from their fierce attack.

raw.en: A beautiful dancer, extremely popular in the ruined Atharva Republic. As the intense battle with the gods continued, she injected even more force into her magical demon dance. She unleashed thunder above her enemies as she cared for her allies. It is said that even just her presence inspired those who fought alongside her. Having noticed this, the gods concentrated their attack on her, but many soldiers around her gathered to act as her shield and defend her from their fierce attack.
raw.es: Bella y famosa bailarina de la antigua república de Atharva. A medida que la intensa batalla contra los dioses continuaba, May insufló más fuerza en su mágica danza demoníaca. Desató una tormenta sobre sus enemigos y protegió a sus aliados. Se dice que su presencia era causa suficiente para que los que lucharan a su lado se sintieran inspirados. Los dioses se percataron de esto y concentraron todos sus ataques sobre ella, pero muchos soldados rodearon a la bailarina y actuaron como su escudo para defenderla de los feroces ataques.

raw.pt: Uma dançarina exótica, extremamente popular na República arruinada de Atharva. Conforme a batalha intensa contra os deuses continuava, ela injetou ainda mais força em sua demoníaca dança mágica. Ela libertou o trovão sobre seus inimigos enquanto cuidava de seus aliados. Dizem que sua mera presença já inspirava aqueles que lutavam a seu lado. Tendo notado isso, os deuses concentraram seus ataques nela, mas muitos soldados ficaram à sua volta servindo como escudos e defendendo-a dos ataques ferozes.
raw.th: นักเต้นแสนสวย ผู้มีชื่อเสียงโด่งดังมากในสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย ระหว่างสงครามที่เข้มข้นกับเทพเจ้ากำลังดำเนินต่อไป เธอได้อัดฉีดพลังที่มากขึ้นให้กับเวทมนตร์การเต้นปีศาจของตน เธอปล่อยสายฟ้าเหนือศัตรูขณะที่กำลังช่วยรักษาเหล่าพันธมิตร ว่ากันว่าแค่เธอปรากฏตัวขึ้นก็สร้างแรงบันดาลใจให้กับคนที่ต่อสู้เคียงข้างเธอ เมื่อสังเกตได้เช่นนั้นเหล่าเทพเจ้าจึงมุ่งการโจมตีมาที่เธอ แต่เหล่าทหารทั้งหลายรอบๆ ตัวกลับให้การปกป้องดังโล่ห์จากการโจมตีที่โหดร้ายของพวกนั้น
raw.vi: Một vũ công xinh đẹp, rất nổi tiếng ở Nước cộng hòa Atharva. Khi trận chiến với các vị thần tiếp tục, cô đã tăng cường nhiều lực lượng hơn vào khiêu vũ ma quỷ của mình. Cô ta tung ra sấm sét lên kẻ địch của mình khi cô ta chăm sóc cho đồng minh. Thâm chí người ta nói rằng chỉ có sự hiện diện của cô ta mới khích lệ cho những người chiến đấu bên cạnh cô ta. Xin lưu ý rằng các vị thần tập trung tấn công cô ta, nhưng nhiều binh lính xung quanh cô ta tập hợp lại làm khiên chống và bảo vệ cô ta khỏi sự tấn công kinh hoàng

id: Monster yang setengah wanita setengah burung dari suku manusia burung. Dengan sifatnya yang bernafsu, mereka menggoda lelaki muda yang dilihatnya. Lelaki yang menanggapi ajakannya, tergoda oleh penampilannya yang seksi, dibawa ke kandang harpy dan dimakankan ke anak-anaknya. Tapi, tidak ada pilihayn yang aman. Yang menolaknya langsung diserang dan dirobek dengan cakarnya yang tajam.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40050_DESCRIPTION
desc: A half-human, half-bird female monster from the birdman tribe. With her lusty nature, she seduces young men on sight. Men who take her invitation, tempted by her lascivious looks, are taken to the harpy nest, and fed to harpy children. However, there is no safe choice. Someone who refuses is immediately charged and ripped to shreds by her sharp claws.

raw.en: A half-human, half-bird female monster from the birdman tribe. With her lusty nature, she seduces young men on sight. raw.es: Monstruo de la tribu de los hombres pájaro. Su mirada lasciva atrae a los hombres, quienes acaban siendo bocado de sus crías. Resistirse a sus encantos de nada sirve, pues todo el que se niega a seguirla acaba hecho picadillo por sus letales garras.

raw.pt: Uma monstra meio-humana, meio-fêmea da tribos dos homens-pássaro. Com sua natureza luxuriosa, ela seduz jovens homens assim que os vê. Os que cedem à tentação de seus olhares lascivos são levados ao ninho, para servir de alimento aos filhotes. Mas não há escolha segura. Os que recusam são imediatamente atacados e rasgados por suas garras afiadas.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์เพศหญิงครึ่งคนครึ่งนกจากเผ่ามนุษย์นก ด้วยธรรมชาติที่มีชีวิตชีวาของเธอ เธอจะล่อลวงชายหนุ่มที่พบเห็น ชายที่ถูกล่อหลอกด้วยรูปร่างยั่วยวนจะถูกพาไปที่รังของฮาร์ปี้และเป็นอาหารของฮาร์ปี้เด็ก แต่ถึงอย่างไรมันก็ไม่มีทางเลือกที่ปลดอภัย ใครก็ตามที่ปฏิเสธทันทีก็จะถูกโจมตีและฉีกเป็นชิ้นๆ ด้วยเล็บคมของเธอ
raw.vi: Một nữ quái nửa người, nửa chim từ các bộ lạc người chim. Với sức sống tràn đầy của mình, cô đã quyến rũ những người đàn ông trẻ qua ánh mắt. Những người đàn ông nhận lời mời của bà, bị cám dỗ bởi vẻ dâm đãng của bà, được đưa đến tổ của bà và trở thành thức ăn cho các con non trong tổ. Tuy nhiên, không có sự lựa chọn an toàn. Người từ chối lời mời của bà thì ngay lập tức bị xé thành trăm mảnh bởi móng vuốt sắc nhọn của bà.

id: Monster yang setengah wanita setengah burung dari suku manusia burung. Setelah mendapat banyak pengalaman perang, sihir di dalamnya diklepaskan, dan dia berubah menjadi Aero. Jelas, kemampuan tarung dan gaya seksinya meningkat karena dia tetap menggoda lelaki untuk memuaskan nafsunya. Beberapa ingin disukai Aero karena dia hanya suka mereka yang terlihat enak.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40051_DESCRIPTION
desc: A half-man, half-bird female monster from the birdman tribe. After a harpy gains a lot of experience in combat, the magic inside her is released, and she evolves into Aero. Naturally, her fighting power and lusty nature grow as she continues to seduce men to satisfy her appetite. Few desire being liked by Aero since she favors those who look delicious.

raw.en: A half-man, half-bird female monster from the birdman tribe. After a harpy gains a lot of experience in combat, the magic inside her is released, and she evolves into Aero. Naturally, her fighting power and lusty nature grow as she continues to seduce men to satisfy her appetite. Few desire being liked by Aero since she favors those who look delicious.
raw.es: Monstruo de la tribu de los hombres pájaro. Las arpías que mejoran en combate liberan su magia y se convierten en aeros, criaturas más poderosas y lascivas que siguen seduciendo a los hombres para saciar su apetito. Sienten predilección hacia aquellos que se ven más apetitosos.

raw.pt: Uma monstra meio-humana, meio-fêmea da tribos dos homens-pássaro. Depois de uma harpia obter muita experiência em combate, a magia dentro dela é libertada, e ela evolui para Aero. Naturalmente, seu poder de luta e natureza luxuriosa crescem já que ela continua a seduzir homens para satisfazer seu apetite. Poucos desejam ser apreciados por Aero já que ela favorece os que parecem deliciosos.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์เพศหญิงครึ่งคนครึ่งนกจากเผ่ามนุษย์นก หลังจากที่ฮาร์ปี้ได้รับประสบการณ์มากมายจากการต่อสู้ เวทมนตร์ภายในร่างกายจะถูกปลดปล่อยออกมาและเธอจะพัฒนาเป็น "เอโร" โดยธรรมชาติแล้วพลังต่อสู้และความเย้ายวนของเธอจะเพิ่มมากขึ้นเมื่อเธอยังคงหลอกล่อผู้ชายเพื่อเป็นอาหารต่อไป น้อยคนต้องการที่จะถูกชอบโดยเอโร เพราะเธอมันจะชอบคนที่ดูน่าอร่อย
raw.vi: Một nữ quái nửa người, nửa chim từ các bộ lạc người chim. Sau khi cô ta tăng rất nhiều kinh nghiệm trong chiến đấu, sự kỳ diệu bên trong của cô được phát hành, và đã biến thành Aero. Đương nhiên, sức mạnh chiến đấu của cô và vẻ đẹp tràn đầy sức sống phát triển và cô tiếp tục quyến rũ đàn ông để thỏa mãn sở thích của mình. Sự khao khát của Aero khi cô thích những người trông ngon miệng

id: Monster setengah manusia setengah burung dari suku manusia burung. Meskipun teman dari Harpy yang rakus dan penuh nafsu, individu unik ini tidak mencari mangsa, tapi pertarungan. Katanya mereka adalah evolusi dari Aeros yang telah mempunyai banyak pengalaman bertarung. Menurut periset monster, Ocypete tinggal di pegunungan tempat kediaman Harpy, di mana mereka mengalahkan para penyusup untuk melindungi spesies mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40052_DESCRIPTION
desc: A half-human, half-bird female monster from the birdman tribe. Though friends of the voracious and lusty Harpys, these unique individuals seek not prey, but combat. They are said to be the evolved form of battle experienced Aeros that've gained power after numerous encounters. According to monster researchers, these Ocypete's inhabit the mountains where Harpy's nest, where they take care of intruders in protecting their species.

raw.en: A half-human, half-bird female monster from the birdman tribe. Though friends of the voracious and lusty Harpys, these unique individuals seek not prey, but combat. They are said to be the evolved form of battle experienced Aeros that've gained power after numerous encounters. According to monster researchers, these Ocypete's inhabit the mountains where Harpy's nest, where they take care of intruders in protecting their species.
raw.es: Bestia mitad humana, mitad ave perteneciente a la tribu de los hombres pájaro. A pesar de ser amigos de las voraces y lujuriosas Arpías, estos particulares seres no buscan una presa, sino un desafío. Se dice que son la forma evolucionada de los Aeros tras acumular suficiente poder. Según los investigadores de monstruos, los Ocypetes viven en las montañas, lugar en el que anidan las Arpías, donde se deshacen de los intrusos que intentan dañar a su especie.
raw.id: Monster setengah manusia setengah burung dari suku manusia burung. Meskipun teman dari Harpy yang rakus dan penuh nafsu, individu unik ini tidak mencari mangsa, tapi pertarungan. Katanya mereka adalah evolusi dari Aeros yang telah mempunyai banyak pengalaman bertarung. Menurut periset monster, Ocypete tinggal di pegunungan tempat kediaman Harpy, di mana mereka mengalahkan para penyusup untuk melindungi spesies mereka.
raw.pt: Uma monstra meio-humana, meio-fêmea da tribos dos homens-pássaro. Embora sejam amigos das vorazes harpias, essas criaturas únicas não procuram por presas, mas por combates. Dizem que elas são a forma evoluída do guerreiro experiente Aeros, que obteve poder depois de vários embates. De acordo com pesquisadores de monstros, esse Ocípete vive nas montanhas, onde harpias fazem ninho e onde eles se livram de intrusos para proteger sua espécie.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์ครึ่งนก ครึ่งมนุษย์เพศเมีย จากเผ่ามนุษย์นก แม้จะเป็นเพื่อนกับฮาร์ปี้ที่ดุร้ายและมากตัณหา เผ่าพันธุ์พิเศษนี้กลับไม่ได้ไล่ล่าเหยื่อแต่เป็นสงคราม ว่ากันว่าพวกมันวิวัฒนาการมาจากแอโร่ ที่มากด้วยประสบการณ์การต่อสู้จนได้รับพลังหลังจากการเผชิญหน้าหลายครั้ง ตามที่นักวิจัยมอนสเตอรืได้ค้นคว้า อ็อคซี่พีทพวกนี้จะอาศัยอยู่ในภูเขาที่ๆ ฮารืปี้ทำรัง ซึ่งพวกมันจะจัดการผู้บุกรุกเพื่อปกป้องสายพันธุ์ของมัน
raw.vi: Một quái vật nữ nửa người, nửa chim đến từ bộ lạc người chim. Mặc dù là bạn của Harpys phàm ăn và đầy sức sống, những cá thể độc đáo này không kiếm mồi, mà lại chiến đấu. Chúng được cho rằng có hình dạng phát triển là Nữ quái người chim có kinh nghiệm chiến đấu đã có được sức mạnh sau vô số cuộc đo sức. Theo một nhà nghiên cứu quái vật, những Ocypete này sống ở núi nơi Harpy làm tổ, tại đây chúng chăm sóc những kẻ không mời mà đến để bảo vệ loài của chúng.

id: Bajak udara yang menggunakan pistol dari dunia lain, terkenal di seluruh Republik Atharva yang hancur. Grafl berasal dari keluarga yang menjaga kapal terbang menggunakan aksesoris unik, tapi dia melanggar tabu keluarga dan kabur dengan kapal yang dicurinya. Meskipun mereka yang berkuasa menamainya bajak udara karena pencurian dan pistolnya yang terlarang, dia mencoba sebisa mungkin untuk hidup jujur.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40061_DESCRIPTION
desc: An air pirate using an other-worldly pistol, widely known throughout the ruined Atharva Republic. Grafl was from a family that safeguarded flying ships using unique spheres, but he broke a family taboo and fled on a stolen ship. Although those in power labeled him an air pirate for his theft and forbidden pistol wielding, he tried his best to lead an honest life.

raw.en: An air pirate using an other-worldly pistol, widely known throughout the ruined Atharva Republic. Grafl was from a family that safeguarded flying ships using unique spheres, but he broke a family taboo and fled on a stolen ship. Although those in power labeled him an air pirate for his theft and forbidden pistol wielding, he tried his best to lead an honest life.
raw.es: Aviador que usaba una pistola de otro mundo y se hizo famoso en la antigua república de Atharva. La familia de Grafl protegía naves voladoras usando esferas especiales, pero un día el joven rompió una regla y huyó en una de ellas. A pesar del robo y de usar armas prohibidas, Grafl trató de llevar una vida lejos del crimen.
raw.id: Bajak udara yang menggunakan pistol dari dunia lain, terkenal di seluruh Republik Atharva yang hancur. Grafl berasal dari keluarga yang menjaga kapal terbang menggunakan aksesoris unik, tapi dia melanggar tabu keluarga dan kabur dengan kapal yang dicurinya. Meskipun mereka yang berkuasa menamainya bajak udara karena pencurian dan pistolnya yang terlarang, dia mencoba sebisa mungkin untuk hidup jujur.
raw.pt: Um pirata do ar usando uma pistola de outro mundo, amplamente conhecido na República arruinada de Atharva. Grafl vem de uma família que resguardava navios voadores usando esferas peculiares, mas ele quebrou o tabu familiar e fugiu em um navio roubado. Apesar de ser taxado por aqueles no poder como pirata do ar por seu roubo e por empunhar uma arma proibida, ele tentou ao máximo levar uma vida honesta.
raw.th: สลัดอากาศผู้ใช้ปืนพกจากโลกอื่น เป็นที่รู้จักกันอย่างกว้างขวางทั่วทั้งสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย "กราฟ" มาจากครอบครัวที่ทำงานคุ้มกันเรือบินที่ใช้สเฟียร์แบบเฉพาะ แต่เขาก็แหกคอกและหนีไปบนเรือที่ขโมยมา แม่พวกเจ้าหน้าที่จะตราหน้าเขาว่าเป็นสลัดอากาศเพราะการขโมยและการใช้ปืนต้องห้ามของเขา แต่เขาก็พยายามอย่างมากที่สุดเพื่อใช้ชีวิตแบบสุจริต
raw.vi: Một tên cướp biển không gian sử dụng một khẩu súng lục của thế giới khác mà được phổ biến trong Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát. Grafl  xuất thân trong gia đình mà giữ gìn phi thuyền duy nhất, nhưng ông đã phá vỡ một điều cấm kỵ trong gia đình và bỏ chạy trên một chiếc tàu đánh cắp. Mặc dù những người cầm quyền gọi ông là một tên cướp biển không gian vì hành vi của ông và khẩu súng lục trên tay, ông đã cố gắng hết sức để sống một cuộc sống trung thực.

id: Bajak udara yang menggunakan pistol dari dunia lain, terkenal di seluruh Republik Atharva yang hancur. Dia berkelana dengan krunya di kapal terbangnya, dan pernah bertarung dengan prajurit republik, Falma. Terkesan, Grafl mengajaknya bergabung, tapi Falma menolak, dan ingin kemitraan yang setara. Jadi, mereka menjadi teman dekat, berdiri bersama dalam berbagai perang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40062_DESCRIPTION
desc: An air pirate using an other-worldly pistol, widely known in the ruined Atharva Republic. He traveled with his crew on his airship, and once fought against the republic soldier, Falma. Impressed, Grafl asked him to join, but Falma refused, wanting an equal partnership. Still, they became close friends, standing shoulder-to-shoulder through many battles.

raw.es: Piloto aéreo que usaba una pistola de otro mundo y se hizo famoso en la antigua república de Atharva. Grafl viajó a bordo de su nave aérea con su tripulación y tuvo que enfrentarse a Falma, a quien pidió que se uniera a su banda. Falma rechazó su oferta porque quería convertirse en líder conjunto, pero ambos se hicieron grandes amigos.

Dia berkelana dengan krunya di kapal terbangnya, dan pernah bertarung dengan prajurit republik, Falma. Terkesan, Grafl mengajaknya bergabung, tapi Falma menolak, dan ingin kemitraan yang setara. Jadi, mereka menjadi teman dekat, berdiri bersama dalam berbagai perang.
raw.pt: Um pirata do ar usando uma pistola de outro mundo, amplamente conhecido na República arruinada de Atharva. Ele viajou com sua tripulação em seu barco voador, e uma vez lutou contra o soldado da república, Falma. Impressionado, Grafl o convidou a se juntar à tripulação, mas Falma recusou já que queria uma parceria de igualdade. Ainda assim, eles se tornaram amigos próximos, combatendo lado-a-lado em muitas batalhas.
raw.th: สลัดอากาศผู้ใช้ปืนพกจากโลกอื่น เป็นที่รู้จักกันอย่างกว้างขวางในสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย เขาเดินทางไปกับลูกน้องบนเรือของเขา และครั้งหนึ่งเขาได้ประมือกับ "ฟาลม่า" ทหารของสาธารณรัฐ ด้วยความประทับใจ กราฟจึงได้เชิญเขามาเข้าร่วมแต่ฟาลม่าปฏิเสธที่ต้องการเป็นหุ้นส่วนที่เท่าเทียมกัน แต่พวกเขาก็ยังกลายเป็นเพื่อนสนิทและยืนหยัดเคียงบ่าเคียงไหล่ผ่านการรบด้วยกันมาแล้วหลายสมรภูมิ
raw.vi: Một tên cướp biển không gian sử dụng một khẩu súng lục của thế giới khác mà được phổ biến trong Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát. Ông du hành với thủy thủ đoàn trên con tàu của mình, và khi chiến đấu chống lại lính cộng hòa, Falma. Bị ấn tượng, Grafl đề nghị ông tham gia, nhưng Falma từ chối, muốn một đối tác bình đẳng. Tuy nhiên, họ trở thành bạn thân, kề vai sát cánh qua nhiều trận đánh.

id: Bajak udara memakai pistol dunia lain, umum dikenal seantero Republik Atharva yang hancur. Grafl naik ke langit dengan kapalnya, sembari memerangi para dewa. Membantu teman baiknya, Raja Langit Falma dalam melenyapkan para dewa, keterampilannya sebagai jago tembak cepat melampaui penembak pendukung, dan ia sendiri segera menakhlukkan para dewa. Menghargai dukungan Grafl, Falma secara mesra memanggilnya Kaisar Langit.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40063_DESCRIPTION
desc: An air pirate using an otherworldly pistol, widely known throughout the ruined Atharva Republic. Grafl made his way through the sky on his ship, fighting the gods as he went along. Aiding his good friend Sky King Falma in vanquishing the gods, his skills as a marksman quickly surpassed that of a mere support gunner, and he soon found himself taking down gods himself. In appreciation of Grafl's support despite this, Falma affectionately called him the Sky Emperor.

raw.en: An air pirate using an otherworldly pistol, widely known throughout the ruined Atharva Republic. Grafl made his way through the sky on his ship, fighting the gods as he went along. Aiding his good friend Sky King Falma in vanquishing the gods, his skills as a marksman quickly surpassed that of a mere support gunner, and he soon found himself taking down gods himself. In appreciation of Grafl's support despite this, Falma affectionately called him the Sky Emperor.
raw.es: Aviador y pirata que usaba una pistola de otro mundo. Se hizo famoso en la antigua república de Atharva. Grafl atravesó los cielos con su nave y peleó contra los dioses. Ayudó a su gran amigo Falma, Rey celestial, en la lucha contra los dioses. Sus habilidades como tirador rápidamente lo llevaron a ser mucho más que un simple artillero, y pronto comenzó a derribar dioses. Como muestra de gratitud por el apoyo de Grafl, Falma comenzó a llamarlo, afectuosamente, "Emperador celestial".

Membantu teman baiknya, Raja Langit Falma dalam melenyapkan para dewa, keterampilannya sebagai jago tembak cepat melampaui penembak pendukung, dan ia sendiri segera menakhlukkan para dewa. Menghargai dukungan Grafl, Falma secara mesra memanggilnya Kaisar Langit.
raw.pt: Um pirata do ar usando uma pistola de outro mundo, amplamente conhecido na República arruinada de Atharva. Grafil abria caminho pelos céus com seu navio, lutando contra os deuses por onde passava. Ajudando seu bom amigo, o Rei Celeste Falma, na aniquilação dos deuses, suas habilidades no gatilho logo superaram as de um mero atirador de suporte, e logo ele próprio derrubava deuses. Em agradecimento do suporte de Grafl, Falma afetivamente o chamava de Imperador do Céu.
raw.th: สลัดอากาศผู้ใช้ปืนพกจากโลกอื่น เป็นที่รู้จักกันอย่างกว้างขวางในสาธารณรัฐอธาวาที่ล่มสลาย กราฟบุกฝ่าไปบนท้องฟ้าด้วยเรือของเขา ต่อสู้กับเทพเจ้าในขณะเขาไปสนับสนุนเพื่อนรักสกายคิงฟัลม่าในศึกพิชิตเหล่าเทพเจ้า ทักษะในฐานะนักแม่นปืนสูงส่งกว่าพวกพลปืนสนับสนุนทั่วไป และไม่ช้าเขาก็สามารถจัดการเทพเจ้าลงได้ด้วยตนเอง ด้วยความซาบซึ้งต่อการช่วยเหลือของกราฟ เป็นผลให้ฟัลม่าได้เรียกเขาอย่างสนิทสนมว่าสกายเอ็มเพอเรอ
raw.vi: Một tên cướp trên không sử dụng 1 khẩu súng lục lạ được biết đến trên toàn Nước cộng hòa Atharva. Grafl thực hiện theo cách của mình trên khắp bầu trời trên tàu của hắn, đánh lại các vị thần trên đường đi của cô ta. Giúp đỡ người bạn tốt Vua bầu trời tên là Falma khi chinh phục các vị thần, những kĩ năng của anh ta như 1 tay thiện xạ nhanh chóng vượt qua một tay xạ thủ hỗ trợ đơn thuần, và anh ta sớm nhận ra mình đang hạ thấp các vị thần. Vì đánh giá cao sự hỗ trợ của Grafl mặc dù điều này, nhưng Falma vẫn trìu mến gọi ông là Hoàng đế bầu trời

id: Monster yang sangat kuat dari suku raksasa. Mereka disebut minotaur karena kepalanya berbentuk kerbau. Seperti diduga, mereka suka perang, dan kalau dikatakan minotaur berperang hanya karena hal sepele memang tidak berlebihan. Tapi, mereka tidak terlalu pintar dan hanya mengikuti perintah siapapun yang lebih kuat dari mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40071_DESCRIPTION
desc: An extremely powerful monster from the giant tribe. They're called minotaurs as their heads are bull-shaped. As expected, they are very warlike, and to say that a minotaur fights at the drop of a towel would be no exaggeration. However, they are not too smart and will blindly follow anyone stronger than themselves. Confident fighters often try to subjugate minotaurs.

raw.en: An extremely powerful monster from the giant tribe. They're called minotaurs as their heads are bull-shaped. As expected, they are very warlike, and to say that a minotaur fights at the drop of a towel would be no exaggeration. However, they are not too smart and will blindly follow anyone stronger than themselves. Confident fighters often try to subjugate minotaurs.
raw.es: Monstruo inmenso de una tribu de gigantes al que llaman minotauro porque tiene la cabeza de un toro. Como era de esperarse, son violentos y luchan hasta el final. Por otro lado, son algo torpes y se dejan dominar por alguien más fuerte que ellos. Los luchadores, confiados, suelen tratar de someterlos a sus órdenes.
raw.id: Monster yang sangat kuat dari suku raksasa. Mereka disebut minotaur karena kepalanya berbentuk kerbau. Seperti diduga, mereka suka perang, dan kalau dikatakan minotaur berperang hanya karena hal sepele memang tidak berlebihan. Tapi, mereka tidak terlalu pintar dan hanya mengikuti perintah siapapun yang lebih kuat dari mereka.
raw.pt: Um monstro extremamente poderoso da tribo dos gigantes. Eles são chamados de minotauros por suas cabeças de touro. Como esperado, eles são extremamente bélicos, e dizer que um minotauro briga por uma toalha derrubada não é exagero. Entretanto, eles não são muito fortes e seguirão cegamente qualquer um mais forte do que eles. Lutadores confiantes geralmente tentam subjugar minotauros.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์ผู้มีกำลังมหาศาลจากเผ่ายักษ์ พวกมันถูกเรียกว่ามิโนทอร์จากหัวที่คล้ายวัว และตามที่คาดไว้ พวกมันชอบการต่อสู้มาก และถ้าจะบอกว่าพวกมิโนทอร์นั้นสู้จนกว่าจะโยนผ้ายอมแพ้คงจะไม่เกินความจริงเท่าไหร่ อย่างไรก็ดี พวกมันไม่ค่อยฉลาดเท่าไหร่และมักหลับหูหลับตาจะติดตามใครก็ได้ที่แข็งแกร่งกว่าพวกมัน เหล่านักสู้ที่มั่นใจในฝีมือของตนมักจะพยายามมาปราบมิโนทอร์
raw.vi: Một con quái vật cực mạnh từ các bộ lạc khổng lồ. Chúng đã gọi là Minotaur như người thủ lĩnh. Theo dự kiến, chúng rất hiếu chiến, và nói rằng một chiến đấu của minotaur đơn giản như thả của một chiếc khăn mà không gây tiếng động. Tuy nhiên, họ không quá thông minh và mù quáng sẽ làm theo bất cứ ai mạnh hơn mình. Các chiến binh tự tin thường cố gắng để chinh phục Minotaur.

id: Monster yang sangat kuat dari suku raksasa. Mereka suka perang, sama seperti semua raksasa. Selain itu, mereka suka lawan yang kuat. Mereka lebih pintar dari tampangnya, dan mereka punya filosofi unik yang berkata "bertempur untuk makanan adalah berburu, bukan perang." Jadi, mereka tidak akan merampok, dan mendapatkan makanan dengan menyandera orang lain dan memaksa mereka menjadi budak.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40072_DESCRIPTION
desc: An extremely powerful monster from the giant tribe. They are warlike, just like all giants. Above all, they like tough combat with strong opponents. They are more intelligent than they look, and have a unique philosophy that says "fighting for food is hunting, not combat." Thus, they won't plunder, and get food by capturing others and forcing them into slavery.

raw.en: An extremely powerful monster from the giant tribe. They are warlike, just like all giants. Above all, they like tough combat with strong opponents. They are more intelligent than they look, and have a unique philosophy that says "fighting for food is hunting, not combat." Thus, they won't plunder, and get food by capturing others and forcing them into slavery.
raw.es: Monstruo inmenso de una tribu de gigantes apasionados por la lucha con rivales de su altura. Son más inteligentes de lo que parecen y su filosofía es que "la lucha por alimentarse no es un combate, sino una caza". Por ello, suelen capturar a otras unidades y forzarlas a que les consigan comida.
raw.id: Monster yang sangat kuat dari suku raksasa. Mereka suka perang, sama seperti semua raksasa. Selain itu, mereka suka lawan yang kuat. Mereka lebih pintar dari tampangnya, dan mereka punya filosofi unik yang berkata "bertempur untuk makanan adalah berburu, bukan perang." Jadi, mereka tidak akan merampok, dan mendapatkan makanan dengan menyandera orang lain dan memaksa mereka menjadi budak.
raw.pt: Um monstro extremamente poderoso da tribo dos gigantes. São belicosos como o resto de sua tribo. Acima de tudo, eles gostam de combates difíceis contra oponentes fortes. Eles são mais inteligentes do que parecem, e têm uma filosofia única de que “lutar por comida é caça, e não combate”. Assim, eles não saqueiam, e conseguem comida capturando outros e forçando-os à escravidão.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์ผู้มีกำลังมหาศาลจากเผ่ายักษ์ พวกมันชอบการต่อสู้เหมือนกับยักษ์ทั้งหมด เหนือสิ่งอื่นใดพวกมันชอบการต่อสู้ที่ยากลำบากกับคู่ต่อสู้ที่แข็งแกร่ง พวกมันฉลาดมากกว่าที่เห็นและมีปรัชญาการดำรงชีวิตที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ "สู้เพื่ออาหารคือการล่า ไม่ใช่การต่อสู้" กระนั้นพวกมันก็จะไม่ปล้น และหาอาหารด้วยการจับผู้อื่นและบังคับไปเป็นทาส
raw.vi: Một con quái vật cực mạnh từ các bộ lạc khổng lồ. Chúng hiếu chiến, giống như tất cả những người khổng lồ. Trên tất cả, họ thích cuộc chiến khó khăn với các đối thủ mạnh. Họ thông minh hơn họ tưởng, và có một triết lý duy nhất nói "đấu tranh vì thức ăn là được săn bắn, không thì không chiến đấu." Do đó, họ sẽ không cướp bóc, và lấy thức ăn bằng cách bắt người khác và buộc họ làm nô lệ

id: Monster yang mempunyai kekuatan luar biasa, yang katanya adalah salah satu spesies dari raksasa. Meskipun dalam suku raksasa yang gila perang, spesies satu ini benar-benar terobsesi perang, bertarung tanpa henti siang dan malam dari saat mereka lahir, sampai kematiannya. Meskipun badannya terbungkus otot yang kuat, kepandaian mereka lebih dari manusia. Tapi, mereka tidak tertarik dengan urusan selain perang. Hanya beberapa manusia yang pernah minta bantuan dari raksasa bijak ini, tapi karena dia meminta orang yang memohon bantuannya untuk bertarung sebagai imbalannya, kebanyakan dari mereka yang berani meminta bantuannya akhirnya hanya mati dalam pertarungan itu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40073_DESCRIPTION
desc: A monster boasting incredible power who is said to come from a species of giants. Even within the battle-hungry giant race, this particular species is completely obsessed with battle, fighting incessantly day and night from the moment they are born, until their very death. Although its body is made up of pure solid muscle, it has an intelligence that puts humans to shame. However, it holds no other interests besides battle. Only a few humans have sought aid from this gigantic and wise creature, but since it demands a fight from the person requesting help as compensation, most of those who do ask only end up beaten to death.

raw.en: A monster boasting incredible power who is said to come from a species of giants. Even within the battle-hungry giant race, this particular species is completely obsessed with battle, fighting incessantly day and night from the moment they are born, until their very death. Although its body is made up of pure solid muscle, it has an intelligence that puts humans to shame. However, it holds no other interests besides battle. Only a few humans have sought aid from this gigantic and wise creature, but since it demands a fight from the person requesting help as compensation, most of those who do ask only end up beaten to death.
raw.es: Se dice que este monstruo con increíbles poderes desciende de una especie de gigantes. Incluso para los estándares guerreros de los gigantes, esta especie en particular está completamente obsesionada por la batalla, pelean incansablemente día y noche desde el momento en el que nacen hasta su mismísima muerte. Si bien su cuerpo es puro músculos, su inteligencia avergonzaría a los humanos. Sin embargo, lo único que le interesa es la batalla. Solo unos pocos humanos han buscado la ayuda de esta gigante y sabia criatura. Sin embargo, dado que la persona que pide ayuda tiene que luchar contra él a modo de compensación, la mayoría de los que lo han hecho han terminado muertos.

Meskipun badannya terbungkus otot yang kuat, kepandaian mereka lebih dari manusia. Tapi, mereka tidak tertarik dengan urusan selain perang. raw.pt: Um monstro que possui incrível poder e que dizem ter vindo de uma espécie de gigante. Mesmo dentro da raça sedenta por guerras dos gigantes, esta espécie particular é completamente obcecada por lutar, batalhando incansavelmente dia e noite do momento em que nascem até a morte. Embora seu corpo seja feito de puro músculo rígido, ele tem uma inteligência de causar inveja em humanos. No entanto ele não tem interesse em nada além da batalha. Poucos humanos buscaram ajuda dessa sábia e gigantesca criatura mas, já que ela exige uma batalha como compensação da pessoa que pedir, a maioria dos que pediram acabaram sendo mortos.
raw.th: สัตว์ประหลาดที่โอ้อวดพลังของตนเองที่เชื่อว่ามาจากเผ่าพันธุ์ยักษ์ เผ่าพันธุ์ที่หิวโหยสงครามนี้ได้ชอบการต่อสู้ตั้งแต่เกิดจนถึงวินาทีสุดท้ายของชีวิต ถึงแม้ว่าร่างกายของมันจะมีแต่กล้ามที่แข็งแรง แต่ปัญญาความฉลาดของมันก็ไม่ได้เหนือกว่ามนุษย์มากนัก อย่างไรก็ตามพวกมันไม่สนใจอย่างอื่นนอกจากสงคราม มีมนุษย์เพียงไม่กี่คนที่กล้าจะขอความช่วยเหลือจากสัตวที่แข็งแรงและชาญฉลาดนี้ แต่เพราะพวกมันขอการต่อสู้เป็นการตอบแทน มนุษย์ส่วนมากที่ขอความช่วยเหลือจึงตายจากการถูกอัด
raw.vi: Một con quái vật tự hào với sức mạnh khủng khiếp, được cho là từ một loài khổng lồ. Ngay cả trong cuộc đua khổng lồ thèm khát tranh đấu, loài vật đặc biệt này hoàn toàn bị ám ảnh bởi chiến trận, chiến đấu ngày đêm không ngừng từ khi được sinh ra cho đến lúc chúng chết đi. Mặc dù cơ thể của nó toàn cơ bắp rắn chắc, trí thông minh của nó khiến con người cũng phải xấu hổ. Tuy nhiên, nó chẳng quan tâm đến việc gì khác ngoài chiến đấu. Chỉ một vài người đã nhờ sinh vật khổng lồ và khôn ngoan này hỗ trợ, nhưng vì nó đòi trả công bằng một cuộc chiến từ người yêu cầu giúp đỡ, hầu hết những kẻ đó chỉ còn cách bị đánh đến chết.

id: Roh kuat yang katanya bisa mengontrol angin dengan bebas. Badannya tidak berbentuk, memungkinkan mereka untuk mengubah sesukanya, meskipun mereka biasanya berupa wanita bersayap. Informasi tentang manusia menarik untuk mereka dan mereka akan mengendap-endap ke rumah-rumah untuk mengumpulkan rahasia. Banyak manusia yang menderita karena tipuan mereka, tapi biasanya mereka tidak berniat untuk melukai manusia.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40081_DESCRIPTION
desc: A powerful spirit said to freely control the wind. Their bodies are free-forming, allowing them to change shape at will, though they usually take the form of a winged woman. Human information interests them and they will sneak into homes to collect secrets. Many humans have suffered from their tricks, but it's generally accepted that they don't intend to hurt people.

raw.en: A powerful spirit said to freely control the wind. Their bodies are free-forming, allowing them to change shape at will, though they usually take the form of a winged woman. Human information interests them and they will sneak into homes to collect secrets. Many humans have suffered from their tricks, but it's generally accepted that they don't intend to hurt people.
raw.es: Espíritu poderoso que controla el viento a su antojo. Su cuerpo puede moldearse como el viento, aunque suelen adoptar la figura de una mujer con alas. Le encanta saberlo todo de los humanos, por lo que suele colarse en sus casas para desvelar secretos. Muchos han sufrido sus bromas, aunque se dice que no las hacen de mala fe.
