raw.es: Un antiguo discípulo de Maxwell, la Creadora, que terminó encerrado en Ishgria. Cuando despertó de su letargo, tenía delante a un discípulo blandiendo una espada. Luego de que el discípulo dijera que todo iba de acuerdo a los planes, Kanon atacó. El trueno que lanzó dentro de la barrera hizo que todos los demás se dispersaran, lo que provocó que tuviera que deambular por el lugar en busca de un nuevo rival. Aunque se cree que no existió un ser que tuviera la habilidad de adivinar lo que Kanon pensaba o de predecir sus movimientos, un discípulo que lo conocía dijo que una vez que Kanon se movía, el impacto de su fuerza era magnífico.

raw.pt: Um antigo discípulo da Criadora Maxwell que foi trancado em Ishgria. Quando acordou de seu sono, ele viu um discípulo sozinho empunhando uma espada. Assim que o discípulo pronunciou que “tudo está conforme planejado”, Kanon contra-atacou. O trovão que ele atingiu a barreira fez com que todos os discípulos dispersassem, o que fez ele sair para procurar seu próximo oponente. Mesmo que nenhum ser tivesse a capacidade de adivinhar o que ele estava pensando ou prever seus movimentos, um discípulo que o conhecia disse que sempre que Kanon estivesse em movimento o impacto seria grande.
raw.th: อดีตสาวกของแม็กซ์เวลที่ถูกผนึกในอิชเกรีย เมื่อเขาตื่นขึ้นมาจากการหลับไหล เขาได้พบกับสาวกผู้ถือดาบในมือเดียวอยู่เบื้องหน้าเขา หลังจากที่สาวกคนนนั้นได้กล่าวไว้ว่า "ทุกๆ อย่างเป็นไปตามแผน," คาน่อนก็โจมตีสวนกลับไป สายฟ้าฟาดที่เขาปล่อยออกมาในม่านพลังทำให้สาวกทั้งหมดหายไป, ซึ่งทำให้เขาเตร่ไปทั่วเพื่อค้นหาคู่ต่อสู้หน้าใหม่ แม้จะเชื่อกันว่าไม่มีใครมีความสามารถที่จะคาดเดาในสิ่งที่เขาคิด หรือความเคลื่อนไหวของเขาอยู่ได้, สาวกที่รู้จักเขาได้เคยกล่าวไว้ว่า เมื่อใดที่คาน่อนได้มีการเคลื่อนไหว, เขามักจะสร้างผลกระทบที่ยิ่งใหญ่เสมอ
raw.vi: Thần tạo Maxwell đã bị phong ấn tại Ishgria. Khi anh thức dậy sau giấc ngủ, anh thấy trước mặt mình một mình một đệ tử dùng kiếm. Sau khi đệ tử đó thốt lên rằng "mọi thứ đã diễn ra theo kế hoạch", Kanon tung ra một đòn phản công. Sấm sét anh đã đánh trong rào chắn khiên tất cả đệ tử giải tán, điều này khiến anh phải đi lang thang xung quanh để tìm kiếm một đối thủ mới. Măc dù được cho rằng không ai có khả năng đoán được suy nghĩ của anh hay dự đoán được các động tác của anh, nhưng một đệ tử quen biết anh đã nói rằng khi Kanon di chuyển, anh luôn tạo ra ảnh hưởng lớn.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith, who worshipped the Holy Emperor Karna Masta in the La Veda Republic. Diana was gifted with a sabre of thunder by the Holy Emperor when she had been unexpectedly appointed as a Guardian, regardless of her humble origins as fisherman's daughter. She gained confidence in the swordsmanship she had developed despite her father's opposition, and her faith grew stronger with it, though this only caused her to become unsure of her place in the world. Trapped in her own emotional struggle, it is said that Quaid came to irritate her with his easygoing and happy-go-lucky demeanor.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith. Diana set off towards Ishgria with the other Guardians to face off against the invading demons. Honing her swordsmanship even further throughout her journey, it is said that no demon could ever lay a hand on her. However, she received word from one of her comrades stating that some group was planning to attack Karna Masta. Lost as to whether she should go back home or stay, Krea asked her to take care of Quaid for her, and so she did.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith who was left behind in Ishgria. The words that Krea left her with before returning to Grand Gaia had a great impact on Diana, and she was finally able to own up to how she really felt about Quaid. This outburst of pure emotion made her sabre sharper, helping her to attain powers rivaling those of the gods. However, it is said that Quaid never took notice of her feelings for him, and kept irritating her until the very end.

Tuy nhiên một ngày, bọn cướp tấn công tu viện. Sau khi Atro đẩy lùi chúng chỉ với một nhánh cây, Friar đề nghị cô tìm kiếm một chuyên gia đánh kiếm Vedan. Dijuluki "Santa Pedang," meski ia tidak tahu itu, dan ia terus berlatih setiap hari.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50012_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordsman from the ruined La Veda Republic, later he became one of the Six Heroes. As advised by the Friar that raised him, Atro trained with a fencing master, quickly becoming a gifted swordsman. His technique was keen, and he had integrity thanks to his monastery childhood. He earned the title of "Sword Saint." Unaware of this, he continued to train daily.

Al poco tiempo, se convirtió en un excelso espadachín. Su técnica era perfecta, y el tiempo que pasó de pequeño en el monasterio lo dotó de honradez. Muchos comenzaron a llamarlo "El santo de la espada". Atro ignoraba por completo su nuevo apodo, y no dejó de entrenar día y noche.

Kỹ thuật của cô đã được quan tâm, và cô đã rất cảm kích thời thơ ấu trong tu viện của mình. Cô đã đạt danh hiệu "Gươm thánh" Không biết điều này, cô tiếp tục luyện tập hàng ngày.

Urias, được tôi luyện bởi các vị thần,là một thanh gươm rất mạnh. Người ta nói rằng Atro không bao giờ rút gươm ra khi chiến đấu với những kiếm sĩ đi tìm sự nổi tiếng.

id: Wanita jago pedang dari Republik La Veda yang hancur. Menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan, ia menghadapi perang besar dengan ara dewa dengan memegang Pedang Terang Urias. Ia bimbang apakah hendak bertempur atau tidak melawan para dewa, namun akhirnya setelah para dewa menghancurkan biara masa kecilnya, ia memutuskan untuk berperang. Ia membabat para dewa dalam kemarahan, menghancurkan reputasi lamanya sebagai master jago pedang yang anggun.

desc: A swordsman from the ruined La Veda Republic. One of the Six Heroes, he faced the great battle with the gods wielding the Light Sword Urias. He cut down the gods in a rage, breaking with his former reputation as a graceful master swordsman.

Asesinó a los dioses envuelto en un halo iracundo y disipó su antigua reputación de elegante maestro espadachín.

raw.pt: Um espadachim da República arruinada de La Veda. Um dos Seis Heróis, ele encarou a batalha com os deuses em posse da Espada da Luz Urias. Ele estava incerto sobre lutar contra os deuses, mas finalmente decidiu enfrentá-los quando eles destruíram o monastério onde cresceu. Ele abateu os deuses furiosamente, quebrando sua fama anterior de mestre gracioso na arte da espada.
raw.th: นักดาบจากสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลาย ภายหลังเขาได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรษ เขากวัดแกว่งดาบแสงอูเรียสเผชิญศึกครั้งใหญ่กับเหล่าเทพเจ้า เขาติดอยู่กับความชั่งใจว่าจะสู้กับเหล่าเทพเจ้าดีหรือไม่ แต่ก็ตัดสินใจได้ในที่สุดเมื่อพวกนั้นทำลายวัดที่เขาเติบโตขึ้นมา เขาผ่าเทพเจ้าเป็นชิ้นๆ ด้วยความโกรธ และทำลายฉายาที่เคยได้รับว่า "ปรมาจารย์นักดาบผู้กรุณา" ไปจนหมดสิ้น
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ đến từ nước Cộng hòa La Veda đổ nát. Là một trong Sáu anh hùng., cô phải đối mặt với trận chiến lớn với các vị thần với thanh kiếm ánh sáng Urias. Cô phải đáu tranh với việc có hay không nên chống lại các vị thần, nhưng cuối cùng cô đã quyết định khi bị  họ phá hủy tu viện cô lớn lên. Cô chém giết các vị thần với sự giận dữ, phá vỡ danh tiếng cũ của cô là một kiếm sĩ bậc thầy duyên dáng.

id: Jago pedang dari reruntuhan Republik La Veda yang nantinya menjadi salah satu Enam Pahlawan. Atro berjuang keras setelah kuil tempatnya dibesarkan dihancurkan para dewa, di tengah-tengah perang, pedang legendaris Urias patah. Sadar, Atro menyadari betapa tidak dewasa dirinya, lalu ia bersumpah demi pedangnya bahwa ia akan membawanya hanya untuk melindungi rakyat. Dengan perkataan itu, Urias mengeluarkan cahaya terang dan katanya bentuk bangkitnya lebih hebat dari sebelumnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50015_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordsman from the ruined La Veda Republic who later became one of the Six Heroes. As Atro fought back violently after the monastery where he grew up was destroyed, in the midst of battle the legendary sword Urias was broken. Coming to his senses, Atro realized how immature he still was, and he then swore on his sword that he would wield it only to protect his people. With his words, Urias gave off a brilliant light, and it's told its resurrected form was more sublime than ever.

Foi então que Atro percebeu o quão imaturo ainda era, e ele então prometeu à sua espada que ele a empunharia somente para proteger seu povo. Com estas palavras Urias emitiu uma luz brilhante, e dizem que sua forma renascida era ainda mais sublime.
raw.th: นักดาบจากสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลาย ผู้ซึ่งภายหลังได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรษ ขณะที่อาโทรต่อสู้กลับอย่างดุร้ายหลังจากที่วัดที่เขาเติบโตขึ้นมาถูกทำลาย ในระหว่างการปะทะนั้นดาบในตำนานอูเรียสก็หักลง เมื่อเขาได้สติ อาโทรก็รู้ว่าตนเองนั้นยังไม่บรรลุนิติภาวะเท่าไหร่ และได้สาบานด้วยดาบที่เขาถืออยู่ว่าจะใช้มันเพื่อปกป้องผู้คนเท่านั้น ด้วยคำพูดของเขาอูเรียสได้เปล่งแสงจ้าออกมา และว่ากันว่าดาบใหม่ที่ฟื้นขึ้นมานั้นดูน่าศรัทธามากกว่าที่เคยเป็นมา
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ đến từ nước Cộng hòa Atharva đổ nát sau này trở thành một trong Sáu vị anh hùng. Khi Atro đánh trả dữ dội sau khi tu viện nơi anh lớn lên bị phá hủy, ở giữa trận chiến, thanh kiếm huyền thoại Urias đã bị gẫy. Tỉnh trí lại, Atro nhận ra anh còn chưa chín chắn đến mức nào, và sau đó anh đã thề trên thanh kiếm của mình rằng anh sẽ chỉ sử dụng nó để bảo vệ người dân. Với những lời của anh, thanh Urias đã tỏa ra một luồng ánh sáng rực rỡ và người ta nói rằng hình dạng được hồi sinh của nó tuyệt vời hơn bao giờ hết.

id: Sadar kembali setelah kehilangan pedang berharganya, Atro menyaksikan seorang ksatria muncul di depannya. Selagi ksatria itu berbicara padanya, Atro mulai menyabetkan pedangnya pada ksatria itu dengan ekspresi penuh derita di wajahnya. Tapi, setelah Kuda mengambil anak-anak sebagai sandera, Atro berhenti membalas dan menghadapi serangan ksatria itu dengan diam. Setelah Kuda melepaskan anak-anak itu, pahlawan yang sekarat itu menusukkan pedang sucinya pada Kuda, mengambil nyawa pembunuh itu. Katanya kata-kata terakhir Atro pada ksatria itu adalah "Semoga itu membawa masa depan cerah untuk anak-anak."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50016_DESCRIPTION
desc: Finally coming to his senses after having lost his precious blade, Atro witnessed a knight appear before him. As the knight spoke to him, Atro began to swing his sword at the knight with an expression of agony on his face. However, once Kuda took the children as hostages, Atro stopped retaliating and faced the knight's strike in silence. As soon as Kuda released the children, the dying hero pierced Kuda with his holy sword, taking the assassin's life. It is said that Atro's last words to the knight were "May it bring a bright future for the children."

raw.es: Cuando Atro recapacitó luego de perder su preciada espada, un caballero solitario apareció frente a él. Mientras le hablaba, Atro comenzó a blandir su espada contra el guerrero con una expresión de agonía en el rostro. Pero cuando Kuda tomó a los niños como rehenes, Atro dejó de atacar y recibió la estocada del caballero en silencio. Tan pronto Kuda liberó a los niños, el moribundo héroe lo atravesó con su espada sagrada. El asesino había muerto. Se dice que las últimas palabras de Atro fueron "Que los niños tengan un futuro brillante".

raw.pt: Após finalmente voltar a si depois de perder sua espada, Atro viu um cavaleiro surgir à sua frente. Conforme ele falava, Atro começou a apontar sua espada para o cavaleiro com uma expressão de agonia. Porém, quando Kuda usou crianças como reféns, Atro parou e encarou o cavaleiro em silêncio. Quando Kuda liberou as crianças, o herói moribundo o atacou com a espada sagrada, acabando com a vida do assassino. Dizem que as últimas palavras de Atro foram: “Que isso traga um futuro para as crianças.”
raw.th: หลังจากสูญเสียดาบอันล้ำค่าไป อาโทรก็ได้พบกับอัศวินผู้หนึ่ง เมื่อเขาพูดบางอย่างออกมา ทำให้อาโทรเหวี่ยงคมดาบใส่เขาด้วยความโกรธที่เห็นได้ชัดบนใบหน้า อย่างไรก็ตาม เขาพบว่าคุดะได้จับเด็กๆ เป็นตัวประกัน อาโทรจึงหยุดโต้ตอบและเผชิญหน้ากับการโจมตีของอัศวินด้วยความเงียบ แต่เมื่อคุดะปล่อยเด็กๆ แล้ว อาโทรจึงรีบใช้ดาบศักดิ์สิทธิ์แทงคุดะจนเสียชีวิต และก่อนที่อาโทรจะสิ้นชีพเพราะทนพิษบาดแผลไม่ไหว เขาได้กล่าวไว้ว่า "ขอให้แสงแห่งอนาคตนำทางให้กับพวกเด็กๆ"
raw.vi: Cuối cùng đã tỉnh ngộ sau khi mất đi lưỡi kiếm quý giá, Atro đã chứng kiến một hiệp sĩ xuất hiện trước mặt anh. Khi hiệp sĩ nói với anh, Atro bắt đầu vung thanh kiếm của mình về phía hiệp sĩ với vẻ mặt đau đớn. Tuy nhiên, khi Kuda bắt bọn trẻ làm con tin, Atro đã dừng đánh trả và lặng lẽ đối mặt với đòn tấn công của hiệp sĩ. Ngay khi Kuda thả bọn trẻ, người anh hùng sắp chết đã đâm Kuda bằng thanh thánh kiếm của mình, lấy đi mạng sống của tên sát thủ. Tương truyền rằng những lời cuối cùng của Atro với hiệp sĩ là "Cầu mong sẽ mang lại tương lai tươi sáng cho bọn trẻ."

id: Wanita dengan rambut berkilau yang tiba-tiba muncul di Republik La Veda saat perang dengan dewa dimulai. Ia melawan dewa dengan tombak raksasa. Kepahlawanan dan asal-usulnya yang misterius membuatnya dipuja sebagai mesias. Ini berakhir setelah ia membuka mulut, dengan bahasa kasar. Yang diucapkannya sangat buruk sehingga tidak pernah dicatat dalam buku sejarah.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50021_DESCRIPTION
desc: A woman with glittering hair who suddenly appeared in the La Veda Republic when the battle with the gods began. She fought the gods with a giant lance and her heroism and mysterious origins led some to worship her as a messiah. This ended when she spoke. Luna was very foul-mouthed. What she said was so terrible that it was never recorded in the history books.

Dijo algo tan terrible que ningún libro de historia se atrevió a dar cuenta de ello.

raw.pt: Uma mulher de cabelo brilhante que subitamente apareceu na República de La Veda quando a batalha com os deuses começou. Ela usou uma lança gigante para lutar contra os deuses, e suas origens misteriosas levaram muitos a venerá-la como messias. Isso acabou quando ela falou. Luna era muito desbocada. O que ela dizia era tão terrível que nunca foi registrado nos livros de história.
raw.th: หญิงสาวผู้มีผมอันวาววับที่อยู่ๆ ก็ปรากฎตัวขึ้นที่สาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าเมื่อสงครามกับเหล่าเทพเจ้าเริ่มต้นขึ้น เธอต่อสู่กับเหล่าเทพเจ้าด้วยหลาวยักษ์ด้วยความกล้าหาญและความลึกลับเกี่ยวกับที่มาที่ไปของเธอทำให้บางคนยกย่องบูชาเธอเป็นพระผู้ช่วยให้รอด แต่ทุกอย่างก็จบลงเมื่อเธอพูด "ลูน่า" เป็นพวกปากร้ายสุดขีด สิ่งที่เธอพูดออกไปมันเลวร้ายมากจนมันไม่สามารถจะนำมาบันทึกลงในหน้าประวัติศาสตร์ได้
raw.vi: Một người phụ nữ có mái tóc lấp lánh đột nhiên xuất hiện tại nước Cộng hòa La Veda khi trận chiến với các vị thần bắt đầu. Cô đã chiến đấu với các vị thần với một cây thương  khổng lồ cùng chủ nghĩa anh hùng và nguồn gốc bí ẩn khiến một số người tôn thờ cô như một đấng cứu thế. Điều này đã kết thúc khi cô nói. Luna rất hôi miệng. Những gì cô ấy nói là khủng khiếp như vậy nên nó không bao giờ được ghi lại trong những cuốn sách lịch sử.

id: Wanita dengan rambut berkilau yang tiba-tiba muncul di Republik La Veda saat perang dengan dewa dimulai. Serangan dan ejekannya bertambah kuat selagi dia bertarung. Ejekannya tidak hanya membingungkan musuh, tapi juga pasukannya sendiri. Dia akan tiba-tiba muncul, mengobrak-abrik, lalu menghilang. Kadang dia dikatakan sebagai penampakan dewa, tapi mendengar ini dia hanya tersenyum kecut.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50022_DESCRIPTION
desc:
A woman with glittering hair who suddenly appeared in the La Veda Republic as the battle with the gods began. Her attacks and verbal abuse grew as she fought. The verbal abuse confused not only the enemy, but also her own army. She would suddenly appear, go berserk, and then disappear.
She was sometimes said to be an avatar of a god, but upon hearing this she responded with little more than a wry smile.

id: Wanita dengan rambut berkilau yang tiba-tiba muncul di Republik La Veda saat perang dengan para dewa dimulai. Tentara lain masih berjuang, Luna menghiasi zirahnya dengan dekorasi menyolok dan menghajar para dewa yang mengejar. Melihat ini, para tentara tersenyum dan bersemangat lagi mengangkat senjata.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50024_DESCRIPTION
desc: A woman with glittering hair who suddenly appeared in the La Veda Republic when the battle with the gods began. As other soldiers struggled along, Luna adorned her armor with gaudy decorations and bashed away at the gods who were after them. It's said that seeing this brought back a smile to the soldiers' faces, and gave them the courage to once again pick up their weapons.

raw.es: Mujer de deslumbrante cabello que apareció repentinamente en la república de La Veda cuando comenzó la guerra contra los dioses Peleaba y hablaba sin misericordia, pero su comportamiento durante la retirada de la república de La Veda luego de la gran guerra no fue propio de ella. Mientras otros soldados avanzaban penosamente, Luna adornó su armadura con llamativas ornamentaciones y apaleó a los dioses que atormentaban a los soldados. Se dice que esta situación pintó una sonrisa en los rostros de los soldados y les dio ánimo suficiente para volver a alzar sus armas.
raw.id: Wanita dengan rambut berkilau yang tiba-tiba muncul di Republik La Veda saat perang dengan para dewa dimulai. Meski berbicara dan menyerang tanpa ampun, tindakannya selama mundurnya Republik La Veda setelah perang besar tidaklah seperti karakternya. Tentara lain masih berjuang, Luna menghiasi zirahnya dengan dekorasi menyolok dan menghajar para dewa yang mengejar. Melihat ini, para tentara tersenyum dan bersemangat lagi mengangkat senjata.
raw.pt: Uma mulher de cabelo brilhante que subitamente apareceu na República de La Veda quando a batalha com os deuses começou. Embora ela falasse e atacasse impiedosamente, durante o recuo da República de La Veda depois da grande guerra suas ações foram atípicas. Enquanto seus soldados continuavam no embate, Luna enfeitou sua armadura com decorações espalhafatosas e espancou os deuses que perseguiam. Dizem que ver isto devolveu um sorriso no rosto dos soldados, e lhes deu coragem de pegar suas armas novamente.
raw.th: หญิงสาวผู้มีผมอันวาววับที่อยู่ๆ ก็ปรากฎตัวขึ้นที่สาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าเมื่อสงครามกับเหล่าเทพเจ้าเริ่มต้นขึ้น แม้ว่าการพูดและการโจมตีของเธอจะดูไร้เมตตา แต่การกระทำของเธอในช่วงการล่าถอยของสาธารณรัฐหลังจากสงครามนั้น มันไม่ใช่ตัวตนของเธอเลย ขณะที่เหล่าทหารกำลังต่อสู้ไปตามทาง ลูน่าประดับชุดเกราะของเธอด้วยการตกแต่งฉูดฉาดและทุบไปที่เทพเจ้าซึ่งไล่ตามพวกเขามา ว่ากันเมื่อเห็นสิ่งนี้ ทหารทั้งหลายก็มีรอยยิ้มและสร้างแรงใจให้พวกนั้นจับอาวุธขึ้นสู้อีกครั้ง
raw.vi: Một người phụ nữ có mái tóc lấp lánh đột nhiên xuất hiện ở nước Cộng hòa La Veda khi trận chiến với các vị thần bắt đầu. Mặc dù cô vừa nói vừa tấn công không thương tiếc, hành động của cô khi nước Cộng hòa La Veda rút lui sau cuộc đại chiến không phải đặc điểm của cô. Như những người lính khác đã chiến đấu cùng, Luna trang trí áo giáp của mình bằng những đồ trang trí cầu kỳ và đánh đuổi các vị thần bắt chước họ. Người ta nói rằng khi nhìn thấy điều này đã mang lại nụ cười trên khuôn mặt của binh sĩ, và cho họ sự can đảm để một lần nữa cầm vũ khí của họ lên.

id: Tentara yang berjuang di garis depan La Veda sampai titik darah penghabisan saat perang besar dengan para dewa. Perang intens terus berlangsung, Luna menarget seorang murid yang terlihat tidak senang yang muncul di medan perang, seakan ini sudah diharapkan terjadi. Orang-orang di sekitarnya mencoba bekerja sama menyerang sebagai grup, tapi dihentikan Luna, yang mengejar si murid seorang diri. Menurut para saksi, Luna terlihat lebih kuat dan lebih ilahi.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50025_DESCRIPTION
desc: A soldier who fought at the frontlines of La Veda until the very end during the great war with the gods. As the intense battle continued, Luna targeted a seemingly displeased disciple who appeared on the battlefield, as if she had been expecting this to happen. Those around her tried to cooperate by attacking as a group, but were stopped by Luna, who went after the disciple by herself. According to the accounts the witnesses left behind, she looked stronger and more divine than ever.

raw.en: A soldier who fought at the frontlines of La Veda until the very end during the great war with the gods. raw.es: Un soldado que luchó al frente de batalla de La Veda hasta el mismísimo final durante la gran guerra contra los dioses. Mientras se libraba la intensa batalla, Luna, como si hubiera esperado que esto sucediera, señaló a un discípulo que apareció en el campo de batalla y que se veía algo disconforme. Los que estaban alrededor de ella intentaron ayudarla y atacar como una unidad, pero Luna los detuvo y persiguió al discípulo por su cuenta. Según los testimonios de los testigos, a Luna se la vio mucho más fuerte y divina que nunca.

raw.pt: Um soldado que lutou na linha de frente de La Veda até o fim da grande guerra com os deuses. Conforme a batalha continuava, Luna mirava em um discípulo desgostoso que apareceu no campo de batalha, como se ela estivesse esperando isso acontecer. Os próximos a ela cooperavam atacando em grupo, mas foram parados por Luna, que foi atrás do indivíduo. As testemunhas dizem que ela parecia mais forte e divina do que nunca.
raw.th: ทหารผู้ต่อสู้ในแนวหน้าของ ลา วิดา จนกระทั่งจบสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้า ขณะที่สงครามดุเดือดยังคงดำเนินต่อไป ลูน่าได้มุ่งเป้าไปยังสาวกที่ไม่พอใจซึ่งปรากกตัวในสนามรบ ราวกับว่าเธอได้คาดเอาไว้แล้วว่ามันจะเกิดขึ้น พวกที่อยู่รอบๆ ตัวเธอ พยายามที่จะร่วมมือโดยการโจมตีกันเป็นกลุ่ม แต่ก็ถูกหยุดเอาไว้โดยลูน่าที่ไล่ตามสาวกไปด้วยตัวเธอเอง ตามบันทึกของผู้เห็นเหตุการณ์ที่ถูกทอ้งเอาไว้ เธอดูแข็งแกร่งขึ้นและเทพมาขึ้นกว่าที่เป็นมา
raw.vi: Một chiến binh đã chiến đấu ở tuyến đầu của La Veda cho đến tận khi cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần kết thúc. Khi trận chiến dữ dội tiếp tục, Luna đã nhắm mục tiêu một đệ tử dường như không hài lòng xuất hiện trên chiến trường, như thể cô đã mong đợi điều này xảy ra. Những tên xung quanh cô đã hợp sức thành một nhóm tấn công, nhưng đã bị Luna chặn đứng, cô đang tự tìm kiếm đệ tử đó. Theo các ghi chép mà các nhân chứng kể lại, cô có vẻ mạnh hơn và thần thông hơn bao giờ hết.

id: Jelly dengan badan yang berkilauan. Makhluk yang sangat umum, meskipun asal-usulnya tidak dikehatui. Ada yang berpikir mereka dibuat pada saat penciptaan, dan bertambah jumlahnya. Kebanyakan biasanya baik. Ketika mereka menemukan orang yang berjalan di malam hari, mereka menawarkan diri sebagai lampion. Tapi, karena banyak, ada beberapa yang menjadi kasar dan menyerang manusia.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50030_DESCRIPTION
desc: A type of liquid-type monster with a sparkling body. They are a very common creature, although their origin is unknown. Some think they were made at the time of creation, and have since increased in number. Most are basically kind. When they find a person walking at night, they offer themselves as lamps. However, since there are so many, some have become violent and will attack humans.

raw.es: Criatura de cuerpo resplandeciente. Considerados monstruos comunes, nadie sabe de donde surgieron. Hay quien piensa que existen desde el comienzo de los tiempos y han ido reproduciéndose. Por lo general son amables y se prestan a guiar con su luz a viajeros extraviados. Como que hay tantos, algunos se han vuelto algo violentos y pueden atacar.

raw.pt: Um visco com um corpo brilhante. Os viscos são criaturas comuns, mas a origem destes é desconhecida. Alguns acham que eles foram feitos criados junto com o mundo, e desde então aumentaram em número. A maioria é gentil. Quando eles encontram alguém caminhando à noite, eles se oferecem como lanternas. Porém, como há tantos, alguns se tornaram violentos e começaram a atacar humanos.
raw.th: สไลม์ชนิดหนึ่งที่มีร่างกายเรืองแสง พวกมันเป็นสิ่งมีชีวิตธรรมดาแต่ที่มาของมันกยังไม่มีใครรู้ บางคนคิดว่าพวกมันถูกสร้างมาในช่วงเวลาสร้างโลกและจากนั้นก็เพิ่มจำนวนมาเรื่อยๆ ส่วนใหญ่จะใจดี เมื่อพวกมันพบเจอผู้คนเดินอยู่ในเวลากลางคืน พวกมันจะใช้ตัวเองเป็นตะเกียงส่องนำทาง อย่างไรก็แล้วแต่ เนื่องจากพวกมันมีจำนวนมาก บางส่วนจึงดุและทำร้ายมนุษย์ด้วย
raw.vi: Một loại chất nhờn trong một cơ thể lấp lánh. Chúng là một sinh vật rất phổ biến, mặc dù nguồn gốc là không xác định. Một số nghĩ rằng chúng đã được tạo ra tại thời điểm sáng tạo, và kể từ đó gia tăng về số lượng. Hầu hết chúng  cơ bản là tốt bụng. Khi chúng thấy con người đi bộ vào ban đêm, chúng giúp họ như đèn chiếu sáng. Tuy nhiên, vì số lượng rất nhiều, một số chúng đã trở nên bạo lực và  tấn công cả con người.

id: Banyak misteri yang menyelimuti Jelly Berkilau, termasuk asal-usulnya, tapi yang paling menarik adalah keberadaan Raja Jelly Berkilau. Katanya beberapa grup jelly bergabung untuk menjadi Raja Jelly Berkilau. Tapi, tidak ada monster jelly yang melakukan ini sebelumnya, para periset bingung bagaimana ini terjadi. Ketika Raja jelly Berkilau muncul, meskipun malam, akan menjadi terang seperti siang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50031_DESCRIPTION
desc: There are many mysteries about Glowy, including its origin, but the most curious thing is the existence of the King Glowy. It's said that a group of liquid-type monsters merge to become a King Glowy. However, as no other creatures of this kind have done this before, researchers are puzzled as to how this could happen. When King Glowy appears, even the night becomes as bright as day.

raw.en: There are many mysteries about Glowy, including its origin, but the most curious thing is the existence of the King Glowy. It's said that a group of liquid-type monsters merge to become a King Glowy. However, as no other creatures of this kind have done this before, researchers are puzzled as to how this could happen. When King Glowy appears, even the night becomes as bright as day.
raw.es: Si los monstruos como Brillito son ya de por sí misteriosos, los reyes Brillito son todo un enigma. Dicen que se forman al agruparse varios Brillitos, aunque esto es algo que tiene en vilo a los investigadores pues nunca antes habían visto algo así. Con solo aparecer, el rey Brillito puede transformar la noche en día.

raw.pt: Existem muitos mistérios sobre o visco brilhante, incluindo sua origem, mas a parte mais curiosa de sua existência é o Rei Glowy. Dizem que um grupo de viscos se funde para se tornar um visco Glowy Rei. Porém, como nenhum visco demônio fez isso antes, pesquisadores estão intrigados por como isso pode acontecer. Quando o visco Glowy Rei aparece, até a noite fica clara como o dia.
raw.th: มันมีเรื่องลึกลับมากมายเกี่ยวกับสไลม์เรืองแสงรวมถึงจุดกำเนิดของมัน แต่สิ่งที่น่าสงสัยมากที่สุดคือการมีตัวตนของราชันย์สไลม์เรืองแสง ว่ากันว่ากลุ่มของสไลม์มารวมตัวกันจนเกิดเป็นราชันย์สไลม์เรืองแสง อย่างไรก็ตาม เนื่องจากไม่เคยมีสไลม์ชนิดอื่นทำแบบนั้นมาก่อน นักวิจัยต่างฉงนไปตามๆกันว่ามันเกิดขึ้นได้อย่างไร  เมื่อราชันย์สไลม์เรืองแสงปรากฎตัวขึ้น ถึงแม้จะเป็นกลางคืนก็จะสว่างขึ้นราวกับเป็นกลางวัน
raw.vi: Có rất nhiều bí ẩn về Glowy Slime, bao gồm cả nguồn gốc của nó, nhưng điều kỳ lạ nhất là sự tồn tại của Vua Glowy Slime . Người ta nói rằng một nhóm các slimes hợp nhất lại để trở thành một Glowy Slime King. Tuy nhiên, như không có trường hợp những con quỷ slime khác đã làm vậy trước đây, các nhà nghiên cứu đang bối rốitìm cách lý giải điều này xảy ra như thế nào. Khi  vuaGlowy Slime xuất hiện, ngay cả màn đêm cũng trở nên sáng như ban ngày.

id: Penyihir putih yang aktif di Republik La Veda yang hancur dalam perang kuno. Dia bertalenta magis sejak kecil, dan berkeliling dunia untuk menyembuhkan orang dengan orang tuanya yang juga penyihir putih. Cahaya yang keluar dari tongkatnya dapat menyembuhkan beberapa luka sekaligus. Dia dikenal suka makanan manis, dan katanya dia menyimpan banyak camilan di bajunya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50040_DESCRIPTION
desc: A white mage that was active in the ruined La Veda Republic during the ancient war. She was magically gifted as a child, and traveled around the world healing people with her white mage parents. The light released from her wand could heal multiple wounds simultaneously. She was known for liking sweets, and rumor has it that she kept lots of snacks up her sleeves.

La luz que emanaba de su bastón podía curar múltiples heridas a la vez. Cuentan que le encantaban las golosinas y solía tener siempre alguna oculta bajo las mangas de su túnica.

raw.pt: Uma maga branca que esteve ativa na República arruinada de La Veda durante a antiga guerra. Ela era muito talentosa com magia quando criança, e viajou pelo mundo curando pessoas com seus pais, também magos brancos. A luz emitida por sua varinha podia curar vários ferimentos simultaneamente. Ela era conhecida por gostar de doces, e dizem que ela escondia várias guloseimas em suas mangas.
raw.th: นักเวทขาวที่มีบทบาทในสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลายระหว่างช่วงสงครามโบราณ เธอมีพรสวรรค์ด้านเวทมนตร์มาตั้งแต่เด็กและเดินทางไปรอบโลกคอยรักษาผู้คนพร้อมกับพ่อแม่ที่เป็นนักเวทขาวของเธอ แสงจากไม้กายสิทธิ์ของเธอสามารถรักษาอาการบาดเจ็บหลายๆ จุดพร้อมๆกับ เธอชอบขนมหวานและลือกันว่าเธอเก็บขนมจำนวนมากซ่อนไว้ตามแบนเสื้อ
raw.vi: Một phù thủy hoạt động tại nước cộng hòa La Veda trong suốt chiến tranh thời cổ đại. Cô là một đứa trẻ có khả năng thần kỳ chu du khắp thế giới để chữa bệnh cho mọi người cùng với bố mẹ phù thủy của mình. Ánh sáng mà đũa thần của cô tạo ra có thể chữa lành nhiều vết thương cùng một lúc. Người ta kể rằng cô thích đồ ngọt và nhét rất nhiều đồ ăn vặt dưới ống tay áo.

id: Penyihir putih yang aktif di Republik La Veda yang hancur dalam perang kuno. Dia berkeliling menyembuhkan orang sejak kecil. Pada usia 25 tahun, orang mulai memujanya sebagai si bijak. Kemampuan penyembuhnya bertambah matang tahun demi tahun sampai dia bisa menyembuhkan orang yang sakit parah seketika. Minatnya pada makanan manis juga bertumbuh. Dia adalah pemakan camilan yang legendaris, mampu makan sampai 10 kali per hari.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50041_DESCRIPTION
desc: A white mage who was active in the ruined La Veda Republic during the ancient war. She traveled around healing people since she was a child. At age 25, people began praising her as a sage. Her healing ability matured year after year to the point she became able to heal even the severely wounded in an instant. Her sweet tooth grew as well. She was a legendary snacker, eating up to 10 times a day.

Su amor por el dulce también creció, hasta poder comerse toda una docena de pasteles en un segundo.

raw.pt: Uma maga branca que esteve ativa na República arruinada de La Veda durante a antiga guerra. Ela viajou curando pessoas desde criança. Aos 25, as pessoas começaram a considerá-la uma grande sábia. Sua habilidade de cura amadureceu ano após ano ao ponto que ela conseguia curar os piores ferimentos em um instante. Sua fome por doces também aumentou. Ela era uma comilona lendária, comendo até 10 vezes por dia.
raw.th: นักเวทขาวที่มีบทบาทในสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลายระหว่างช่วงสงครามโบราณ เธอเดินทางไปรอบโลกคอยรักษาผู้คนตั้งแต่ยังเด็ก เมื่ออายุ 25 ผู้คนเริ่มสรรเสริญเธอเป็นปราชญ์ ความสามารถในการรักษาของเธอแข็งกล้าขึ้นจนถึงจุดที่เธอสามารถรักษาอาการบาดเจ็บหลายๆจุดให้หายได้ในทันที ความชอบในขนมหวานของเธอก็เพิ่มมากขึ้นเช่นกัน เธอเป็นนักกินในตำนานที่กินมาถึง 10 มื้อในแต่ละวัน
raw.vi: Một phù thủy hoạt động tại nước cộng hòa La Veda trong suốt chiến tranh thời cổ đại. Cô đi khắp thế giới để chữa bệnh cho mọi người từ khi còn nhỏ. Khi cô 25 tuổi, mọi người bắt đầu ca ngợi cô như một vị thần. Khả năng chữa bệnh của cô ngày càng giỏi hơn đặc biệt là cô có thể chữa những vết thương trong chốc lát. sở thích ăn đồ ngọt của cô cũng ngày càng tăng. Cô là người ăn vặt giỏi nhất với 10 lần 1 ngày.

id: Magi putih yang aktif di Republik La Veda yang hancur. Saat perang dengan para dewa dimulai, kemampuannya menyembuhkan telah bertambah sangat kuat. Ia bebas mengeluarkan kekuatannya, menyembuhkan banyak orang yang kemudian memanggilnya santa, dan dia hanya tersenyum. Ia tidak menerima bayaran atas jasanya, namun ia akan mengambil permen, setelah ragu-ragu sejenak.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50042_DESCRIPTION
desc: A white mage that was active in the ruined La Veda Republic during the ancient war. By the time the war with the gods had started, her healing powers had grown miraculously strong. She freely wielded her powers saving countless people who in turn called her a saint, to which she simply smiled. She would never accept payment for her services, but it's said she would take sweet treats, albeit after a bit of hesitation.

raw.en: A white mage that was active in the ruined La Veda Republic during the ancient war. By the time the war with the gods had started, her healing powers had grown miraculously strong. She freely wielded her powers saving countless people who in turn called her a saint, to which she simply smiled. She would never accept payment for her services, but it's said she would take sweet treats, albeit after a bit of hesitation.
raw.es: Maga blanca de la antigua república de La Veda que participó en la guerra ancestral. Cuando la guerra contra los dioses ya había comenzado, los poderes sanadores de Mimir eran milagrosamente fuertes. La maga hizo uso de sus facultades y salvó a una cantidad incontable de gente, que comenzó a llamarla "Santa", a lo que Mimir contestaba con una sonrisa. Nunca reclamó un pago a cambio de sus servicios, pero se dice que sí aceptaba dulces luego de dudarlo un poco.
raw.id: Magi putih yang aktif di Republik La Veda yang hancur. Saat perang dengan para dewa dimulai, kemampuannya menyembuhkan telah bertambah sangat kuat. Ia bebas mengeluarkan kekuatannya, menyembuhkan banyak orang yang kemudian memanggilnya santa, dan dia hanya tersenyum. Ia tidak menerima bayaran atas jasanya, namun ia akan mengambil permen, setelah ragu-ragu sejenak.
raw.pt: Uma maga branca que esteve ativa na República arruinada de La Veda durante a antiga guerra. Quando a guerra com os deuses começou, seus poderes de cura tinham ficado milagrosamente mais fortes. Ela usou seu poder para salvar pessoas além da conta, que a aclamaram como santa, o que ela só respondeu sorrindo. Ela nunca aceitava pagamento pelos serviços, mas dizem que após alguma hesitação ela aceitava doces.
raw.th: นักเวทขาวที่มีบทบาทในสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลายระหว่างช่วงสงครามโบราณ เมื่อถึงเวลาที่สงครามกับเหล่าเทพเจ้าเริ่มต้นขึ้น พลังในการรักษาของเธอก็เพิ่มมากขึ้นราวกับปาฏิหาริย์ เธอใช้พลังที่เธอได้รับไปช่วยเหลือผู้คนนับไม่ถ้วน ซึ่งพวกเขาต่างก็เรียกเธอว่า "นักบุญ" เธอเองก็ได้แต่ยิ้มรับ และจะไม่รับเงินจากการช่วยเหลือผู้อื่นโดยเด็ดขาด แต่ว่าเธอจะยอมรับพวกขนมหวานเป็นสิ่งตอบแทน แม้ว่าในตอนแรกจะลังเลอยู่เล็กน้อย
raw.vi: Một pháp sư áo trắng hoạt động tại Nước cộng hòa La Veda bị phá hủy trong suốt chiến tranh cổ đại. Cũng cùng thời gian khi chiến tranh với các vị thần nổ ra, khả năng chữa bệnh của cô ta ngày một mạnh hơn. Cô ta tự do nắm giữ sức mạnh của mình để cứu vô số người mà sau đó họ gọi cô là bà thánh, và khi đó cô chỉ đơn giản là mỉm cười. Cô ta thường không bao giờ nhận tiền họ trả cho mình vì đã chữa bệnh cho họ, nhưng người ta nói rằng cô ta thường vẫn đối xử ngọt ngào với họ mặc dù sau 1 chút do dự

id: Makhluk seperti manusia dengan sayap yang putih di punggungnya. Mereka sangat patuh pada para dewa sampai mereka hampir tidak punya kepribadian. Mereka menghabiskan waktunya menyembah para dewa, tapi mereka bukan sepenuhnya pecinta damai. Mereka akan mengambil pedangnya untuk melawan siapapun musuh para dewa. Mereka juga mengabdi sepenuhnya pada semua yang mereka anggap teman, membuatnya menjadi teman yang sangat setia.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50050_DESCRIPTION
desc: A humanoid with pure-white wings on its back. They are so submissive to the gods that they have nearly no individuality. They spend most of their time worshiping the gods, but they're not pure pacifists. They will wield their swords relentlessly against any who are recognized as the gods' enemies. They also devote themselves fully to anyone they consider a friend, making them very loyal allies.

raw.en: A humanoid with pure-white wings on its back. They are so submissive to the gods that they have nearly no individuality. They spend most of their time worshiping the gods, but they're not pure pacifists. They will wield their swords relentlessly against any who are recognized as the gods' enemies. They also devote themselves fully to anyone they consider a friend, making them very loyal allies.
raw.es: Humanoide con alas blancas en la espalda. Son sumisos y apenas tienen personalidad. Pasan el tiempo adorando a los dioses, pero no son del todo pacifistas. Suelen blandir su espada sin vacilar a todo el que consideren enemigo de los dioses o a cualquier que consideren su amigo, por lo que son verdaderamente leales.

Mereka menghabiskan waktunya menyembah para dewa, tapi mereka bukan sepenuhnya pecinta damai. Mereka akan mengambil pedangnya untuk melawan siapapun musuh para dewa. Mereka juga mengabdi sepenuhnya pada semua yang mereka anggap teman, membuatnya menjadi teman yang sangat setia.
raw.pt: Um humanoide com asas do mais puro branco. Eles são tão submissos aos deuses que quase não possuem personalidade. Eles passam a maior parte do tempo venerando aos deuses, mas não são puramente pacifistas. Eles irão empunhar suas espadas implacavelmente contra aqueles que perceberem como inimigos dos deuses. Eles também se devotam completamente a quem considerarem seus amigos, tornando-os aliados muito leais.
raw.th: เผ่าพันธุ์ที่มีปีกสีขาวบริสุทธิ์บนหลังของมัน พวกเขาเคารพเชื่อฟังเทพเจ้ามากจนแทบไม่มีความเป็นตัวของตัวเองเลย พวกเขาใช้เวลาเกือบทั้งหมดไปกับการบูชาเทพเจ้า แต่พวกเขาไม่ใช่ผู้ยึดถือลัทธิอหิงสาที่บริสุทธิ์ พวกเขาจะมุ่งมั่นควงดาบเข้าโจมตีผู้ที่ถูกตัดสินว่าเป็นศัตรูของเทพเจ้า และพวกเขายังอุทิศตนอย่างเต็มที่เพื่อทุกคนที่พวกเขาคิดว่าเพื่อน ทำให้พวกเขาเป็นพันธมิตรที่ซื่อสัตย์มาก
raw.vi: Một sinh vật có hình dáng giống con người với đôi cánh trắng muốt trên lưng. Chúng ngoan ngoãn tuân lời các vị thần đến mức dường như không có tính cách riêng của mình. Chúng dành hầu hết thời gian để tôn thờ các vị thần tuy nhiên chúng không hoàn toàn yêu thích sự hòa bình. Chúng sẽ dùng kiếm chống lại những ai được coi là kẻ thù của các vị thần. chúng hết mình trung thành với những người được chúng coi là bạn.

id: Makhluk seperti manusia dengan sayap putih yang besar di punggungnya. Malaikan yang telah memenangkan banyak perang dan dianggap cocok sebagai komandan disebut sebagai Archangel. Orang yang menerima perlindungan ilahi dan perhatian mereka akan membuat luka kecilnya sembuh seketika. Mereka lebih dari sekedar kejam dan menghancurkan musuhnya tanpa ragu-ragu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50051_DESCRIPTION
desc: A humanoid with large, pure-white wings on its back. Angels who have won numerous battles and considered as suitable commanders are called Archangels. People who have received their divine protection and extreme devotion can have their  minor wounds instantly healed by them. They are more than ruthless and will annihilate their enemy without hesitation.

raw.en: A humanoid with large, pure-white wings on its back. Angels who have won numerous battles and considered as suitable commanders are called Archangels. People who have received their divine protection and extreme devotion can have their  minor wounds instantly healed by them. They are more than ruthless and will annihilate their enemy without hesitation.
raw.es: Humanoide con alas blancas en la espalda. Los ángeles que ganan numerosos combates se convierten en arcángeles. Los que gozan de su protección divina y extrema devoción pueden beneficiarse de sus fabulosas artes curativas. Además contarán también con un aliado capaz de eliminar al resto de rivales sin vacilar.
raw.id: Makhluk seperti manusia dengan sayap putih yang besar di punggungnya. Malaikan yang telah memenangkan banyak perang dan dianggap cocok sebagai komandan disebut sebagai Archangel. Orang yang menerima perlindungan ilahi dan perhatian mereka akan membuat luka kecilnya sembuh seketika. Mereka lebih dari sekedar kejam dan menghancurkan musuhnya tanpa ragu-ragu.
raw.pt: Um humanóide com enormes asas do mais puro branco. Anjos que venceram inúmeras batalhas e são vistos como comandantes apropriados são chamados de Arcanjos. As pessoas que recebem sua proteção divina e devoção extrema podem ter seus ferimentos curados instantaneamente por eles. Eles são mais do que implacáveis e aniquilarão seus inimigos sem hesitar.
raw.th: เผ่าพันธุ์ที่มีปีกสีขาวบริสุทธิ์ขนาดใหญ่บนหลังของมัน "นางฟ้า"ที่ชนะการต่อสู้จำนวนมากและถือเป็นผู้บัญชาการที่เหมาะสมจะเรียกว่าเป็น "หัวหน้านางฟ้า" คนที่ได้รับการคุ้มครองด้วยพรศักดิ์สิทธิ์และความจงรักภักดีที่สูงส่งของพวกเขาจะได้รับการรักษาบาดแผลเล็ก ๆ น้อย ๆ ให้หายในทันที แต่พวกเขาไร้ความปรานีและจะทำลายศัตรูของพวกเขาโดยไม่ลังเล
raw.vi: Một sinh vật có hình dáng giống con người với đôi cánh lớn, trắng muốt trên lưng. Những thiên thần chiến thắng trong các trận chiến và những thiên thần được coi là người chỉ huy thích hợp đều được gọi là tổng thiên thần. Nếu những người họ bảo vệ tận tình bị thương dù nhỏ đều được chữa lành ngày lập tức.  Đối với kẻ thù, họ thẳng tay tiêu diệt kẻ thù không chút lưỡng lự.

id: Makhluk berbentuk manusia dengan sayap surgawi di punggungnya. Dulu dikira spesies yang sama dengan Valkyrie, spesies baru ini berevolusi dari Malaikat Perang yang diberi kekuatan oleh para dewa karena keahliannya. Mereka sering salah diidentifikasi karena meskipun berkepribadian seperti Malaikat, tugas mereka mirip dengan para Valkyrie. Gambar yang cantik menceritakan mereka membersihkan langit dari si jahat ada di Katedral Veda.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50052_DESCRIPTION
desc: A humanoid with heavenly white wings on its back. Though once thought to have been of the same species as Valkyries, this new species evolved from Archangels that were blessed with power from the gods thanks to their virtuoucity. They were likely mistakenly identified this way as though they have the personality of Angels, their roles are similar to that of Valkyries. Beautiful depictions of them clearing the skies of evil are depicted on the ceiling of the Veda Cathedral.

raw.en: A humanoid with heavenly white wings on its back. Though once thought to have been of the same species as Valkyries, this new species evolved from Archangels that were blessed with power from the gods thanks to their virtuoucity. They were likely mistakenly identified this way as though they have the personality of Angels, their roles are similar to that of Valkyries. Beautiful depictions of them clearing the skies of evil are depicted on the ceiling of the Veda Cathedral.
raw.es: Humanoide con alas blancas en la espalda. En una época se creía que esta nueva especie pertenecía al grupo de las Valkirias, pero ahora se sabe que es una evolución de los Arcángeles que fueron bendecidos con el poder de los dioses por su virtuosismo. Es probable que se los identificara de esta forma por error ya que su personalidad es muy parecida a la de los Ángeles. Sin embargo, su rol es más parecido al de las Valkirias. En el techo de la catedral vedana se pueden ver increíbles representaciones de ellos liberando el cielo de la oscuridad.
raw.id: Makhluk berbentuk manusia dengan sayap surgawi di punggungnya. Dulu dikira spesies yang sama dengan Valkyrie, spesies baru ini berevolusi dari Malaikat Perang yang diberi kekuatan oleh para dewa karena keahliannya. Mereka sering salah diidentifikasi karena meskipun berkepribadian seperti Malaikat, tugas mereka mirip dengan para Valkyrie. Gambar yang cantik menceritakan mereka membersihkan langit dari si jahat ada di Katedral Veda.
raw.pt: Um humanoide com asas brancas celestiais nas costas. Embora já tenham achado que fosse da mesma espécie das Valquírias, esta nova espécie evoluiu dos arcanjos que foram abençoados com os poderes dos deuses graças a seus talentos. É provável que eles tenham sido identificados dessa forma por terem funções semelhantes às das Valquírias, embora tenham personalidade de Anjos. Belas caracterizações deles purificando os céus de todo o mal foram pintadas no teto da Catedral de Veda.
raw.th: สิ่งมีชีวิตรูปร่างเหมือนมนุษย์ที่มีปีกสีขาวแห่งสวรรค์อยู่บนหลัง แม้ครั้งหนึ่งจะเคยเข้าใจว่าเป็นสายพันธุ์เดียวกันกับวาลคิรี่ แต่สายพันธุ์ใหม่นี่ได้วิวัฒนาการมาจากอาร์คแองเจิลที่ได้รับพรด้วยพลังจากเทพเจ้าเพื่เป็นการตอบแทนความสามารถ พวกมันมักจะถูกจำผิดแบบนี้เพราะนิสัยของพวกมันคล้ายกับฑูตสวรรค์และบทบาทก็คล้ายกับวาลคิรี่ ความสวยงามที่เด่นชัดของพวกนั้นซึ่งได้ขจัดความชั่วร้ายออกจากท้องฟ้า เป็นภาพที่แสดงอยู่บนเพดานของวิหารวีดา
raw.vi: Có hình dáng của con người với đôi cánh thiên thần màu trắng ở trên lưng. Mặc dù từng được cho là cùng loài với Valkyries, loài mới này đã phát triển từ Tổng thiên sứ đã được ban cho sức mạnh từ các vị thần nhờ trình độ điêu luyện của chúng. Theo cách này chúng có thể được xác định nhầm như thể chúng có tính cách của Thiên thần, nhưng vai trò của chúng tương tự như của Valkyries. Mô tả vẻ đẹp làm quang đãng bầu trời tội lỗi của chúng được mô tả trên trần của Thánh đường Veda.

id: Makhluk mistis dengan satu tanduk yang besar di dahinya. Mirip dengan kuda putih yang cantik, dan jarang dekat dengan manusia. Dia hanya membuka hatinya pada jiwa yang bersih. Mereka bisa merasakan niat jahat seketika karena kemampuan telapatinya. Banyak yang berusaha menangkap mereka karena obat di tanduknya, tapi malah akhirnya tertusuk.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50060_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mythical creature with a single large horn on its brow. It resembles a beautiful white horse, and rarely gets close to humans. It will only open its heart to those with unstained souls. They can sense ulterior motives immediately thanks to their telepathy. Many try to capture them for the medicine in their horns, but usually end up getting pierced instead.

raw.en: A mythical creature with a single large horn on its brow. It resembles a beautiful white horse, and rarely gets close to humans. It will only open its heart to those with unstained souls. They can sense ulterior motives immediately thanks to their telepathy. Many try to capture them for the medicine in their horns, but usually end up getting pierced instead.
raw.es: Ser legendario con un cuerno en la frente. Se parece a un caballo blanco y rara vez se acerca a los humanos. Solo alguien de corazón puro podrá ganarse su amistad. Su poder de telepatía les hace ver las intenciones de quien se les acerca. Muchos han tratado de hacerse con su cuerno medicinal y han acabado atravesados por él.
raw.id: Makhluk mistis dengan satu tanduk yang besar di dahinya. Mirip dengan kuda putih yang cantik, dan jarang dekat dengan manusia. Dia hanya membuka hatinya pada jiwa yang bersih. Mereka bisa merasakan niat jahat seketika karena kemampuan telapatinya. Banyak yang berusaha menangkap mereka karena obat di tanduknya, tapi malah akhirnya tertusuk.
raw.pt: Uma criatura mítica com um grande chifre em sua testa. Ele lembra um belo cavalo branco, e raramente se aproxima de humanos. Eles só abrem seu coração àqueles com almas imaculadas. Eles podem perceber segundas intenções imediatamente graças à sua telepatia. Muitos tentam capturá-los por causa do remédio de seus chifres, mas geralmente acabam sendo perfurados.
raw.th: สัตว์ในเทพนิยายที่มีเขาเดี่ยวขนาดใหญ่บนหน้าผากของมัน มีรูปร่างเป็นม้าขาวที่สง่างามและไม่ค่อยยอมใกล้ชิดมนุษย์ มันจะเปิดใจของมันให้กับผู้มีจิตวิญญาณบริสุทธ์เท่านั้น พวกมันสามารถรู้สึกถึงแรงจูงใจซ่อนเร้นได้ทันทีด้วยกระแสจิตของพวกมัน คนมากมายพยายามจะจับพวกมันเพื่อยาที่อยู่ในเขาแต่มันจะจบลงด้วยการถูกแทงเสียมากกว่า
raw.vi: Một sinh vật huyền bí với một chiếc sừng lớn trên trán. Trông nó giống như một con ngựa xinh đẹp và ít khi đến gần con người. Nó chỉ thân thiện với những ai có tâm hồn trong sạch. Nó có thể cảm nhận được những chuyển động bất thường nhờ khả năng cảm nhận từ xa. Nhiều người cố bắt nó để lấy thuốc trong chiếc sừng nhưng thay vào đó  họ chỉ nhận được sự đau đớn.

id: Makhluk mistis dengan tanduk besar di dahinya dan sayap yang cantik di punggungnya. Berbeda dengan penampilannya yang elegan, dia sangat kasar, dan mencoba menungganginya adalah sesuatu yang sulit. Awalnya diciptakan sebagai kendaraan para dewa, hanya pahlawan yang dihormati pada level yang sama dengan dewa bisa menungganginya. Yang melihatnya di medan perang menakuti penunggangnya lebih dari monster itu sendiri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50061_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mythical creature with a huge horn on its brow and beautiful wings on its back. Contrary to its elegant appearance, it's very violent, and trying to ride one is a massive undertaking. Originally created as a vehicle for the gods, only a hero respected at the same level as a god can ride one. Those who see one on the battlefield fear the rider more than the beast itself.

raw.es: Ser legendario con un cuerno en la frente y alas en el lomo. A pesar de su majestuosidad, son violentos y se desaconseja tratar de montarlos. Se crearon para transportar a los dioses, así que solo un héroe de su talla puede domarlo. Aquellos que lo ven en combate temen más a quien va sobre él que a la bestia.

raw.pt: Uma criatura mítica com um chifre enorme na testa e um belo par de asas. Ao contrário de sua aparência elegante, é muito violento, é tentar montá-lo é um empreendimento enorme. Originalmente criado como um veículo para os deuses, somente um herói tão respeitado quanto um deus pode montá-lo. Aqueles que o vêem no campo de batalha temem o cavaleiro mais do que a própria criatura.
raw.th: สัตว์ในเทพนิยายที่มีเขาเดี่ยวขนาดใหญ่บนหน้าผากของและปีกที่สวยงามบนหลังของมัน พวกมันมีความรุนแรงมากขัดกับลักษณะสง่างามและการพยายามที่จะขี่มันถือเป็นความท้าทายอย่างยิ่งยวด ดั้งเดิมถูกสร้างมาเพื่อเป็นพาหนะของเทพเจ้า มีเพียงวีรบุรุษผู้ถูกยกย่องในระดับเดียวกับเทพเจ้าเท่านั้นจึงจะขี่มันได้ เหล่าคนที่ได้พบเห็นพวกมันในสนามรบต่างหวาดกลัวผู้ขี่มากกว่าตัวพวกมันเองเสียอีก
raw.vi: Một sinh vật huyền bí với một chiếc sừng lớn trên trán và đôi cánh xinh đẹp trên lưng. Trái với vẻ bề ngoài, nó rất hung dữ và điều khiển nó là cả một việc lớn. Ban đầu nó được tạo ra để làm phương tiện cho các vị thần , chỉ có anh hùng được tôn trọng ở mức như một vị thần mới có thể điều khiển nó. Những người trên chiến trường còn sợ người điều khiển hơn cả con thú này.

id: Beast legenda dengan pedang kebenaran tertancap di dahinya, dan sayap pelangi menutupi punggungnya. Katanya dia adalah kuda suci yang menarik tank Pasukan Dewa, atau beast suci yang bisa menerangi kegelapan, makhluk ini dianggap sebagai karya terbaik yang pernah dibuat para dewa. Pedang di dahinya lebih tajam dari pedang apapun yang bisa dibuat manusia, dan katanya sangat efektif untuk memotong para setan. Karena itu Remuihl dipercaya adalah musuh alami para setan, dan menghiasi kuil di banyak negara sebagai patung yang melindungi dari si jahat.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50063_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mythical beast with a virtuous sword attached to its forehead, and rainbow wings covering its back. Said to be the sacred horse which pulled the tanks of the God Army, or a divine beast that can cut through the darkness, this creature is considered the best creation the gods ever made. The blade on its forehead is sharper than any sword humans are capable of producing, and it is said to be particularly effective when cutting down demons. For this reason Remuihl is believed to be a natural enemy of the demon race, and has thus come to adorn the temples of many countries as a charm of protection against evil.

raw.en: A mythical beast with a virtuous sword attached to its forehead, and rainbow wings covering its back. The blade on its forehead is sharper than any sword humans are capable of producing, and it is said to be particularly effective when cutting down demons. For this reason Remuihl is believed to be a natural enemy of the demon race, and has thus come to adorn the temples of many countries as a charm of protection against evil.
raw.es: Una bestia mítica con una espada virtuosa pegada en su frente y alas del color del arcoíris a la espalda. Se dice que esta criatura es el caballo sagrado que tira de los tanques del ejército de los dioses, o una bestia divina que puede atravesar la oscuridad. Se la considera la mejor creación de los dioses. La espada que tiene en la frente es más filosa que cualquier espada que los humanos puedan forjar y se dice que es particularmente efectiva para matar demonios. Por esta razón, se cree que Remuihl es un enemigo natural de la raza demoníaca, por lo que se puede encontrar su figura en los templos de muchas naciones como símbolo de protección contra el mal.

raw.pt: Uma fera mítica com uma espada virtuosa na testa e asas de arco-íris nas costas. Dizem ser o cavalo sagrado que puxava os tanques do exército dos deuses ou uma fera divina que pode cortar as trevas, essa criatura é considerada a melhor criação dos deuses. A lâmina em sua testa é mais afiada do que qualquer espada que humanos são capazes de produzir, e dizem que ela é particularmente eficiente para cortar demônios. Por este motivo, acredita-se que Remuihl seja um inimigo natural da raça dos demônios e por isso se tornou enfeite comum em templos de muitos países como amuleto de proteção contra o mal.
raw.th: สัตว์เทพนิยายที่มีดาบศักดิ์สิทธิ์บนหัว และปีกสายรุ้งที่หลัง ถูกเชื่อว่าเป็นม้าศักดิ์สิทธิ์ที่สามารถสู้กับกองทัพของเทพ แม้กระทั่งตัดผ่าความมืด สัตว์ตัวนี้ถือว่าเป็นสัตว์ชั้นยอดในบรรดาการสร้างของเทพ ดาบบนหัวของมันคมกว่าดาบทุกเล่มที่มนุษย์ได้สร้างขึ้น และดาบนี้เชื่อว่าเอาไว้ใช้กำจัดเหล่าปีศาจโดยเฉพาะ ด้วยเหตุนี้ เรมูห์ลถูกเชื่อว่าเป็นศัตรูตัวฉกาจของเหล่าปีศาจ และด้วยความเชื่อนี้ มันจึงถูกนำมาใช้ในวัดในหลายๆ ประเทศเพื่อใช้เป็นเครื่องป้องกันเหล่าร้าย
raw.vi: Một con quái vật huyền thoại với một thanh kiếm cắm vào trán và đôi cánh cầu vồng che phủ lưng nó. Được cho là con ngựa linh thiêng đã kéo những chiếc xe tăng của Đội quân các Vị Thần, hoặc một con linh thú có thể xé tan bóng tối, sinh vật này được coi là sáng tạo tuyệt vời nhất các vị thần đã từng tạo ra. Lưỡi kiếm trên trán nó sắc hơn bất cứ thanh kiếm nào con người có khả năng chế tạo ra, và được cho là đặc biệt hữu dụng khi chém quỷ. Vì lý do này Remuihl được cho là kẻ thù bẩm sinh của loài quỷ, và do đó đã được dùng tô điểm cho những ngôi đền của nhiều quốc gia như một bùa phép nhằm bảo vệ chống lại cái ác.

id: Pendeta yang mengajarkan dewa-dewa di puing Republik La Veda. Karmanya membuatnya kuat dan banyak mukjizat tercatat. Rumornya Maria membantu menggendong dewa karena sayap besar di punggungnya terbentang saat melakukan mukjizat. Dia menyangkal hal ini, dan berkata dia hanyalah manusia biasa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50071_DESCRIPTION
desc: A priestess who preached of the gods in the ruined La Veda Republic. Her piety made her powerful, and there are many miracles on record said to have been performed by her. Rumor was that Maria helped carry the gods because of the large wings extending from her back which spread when she'd perform a miracle. However, she obstinately denied this, saying she was just a normal person.

raw.en: A priestess who preached of the gods in the ruined La Veda Republic. Her piety made her powerful, and there are many miracles on record said to have been performed by her. Rumor was that Maria helped carry the gods because of the large wings extending from her back which spread when she'd perform a miracle. However, she obstinately denied this, saying she was just a normal person.
raw.es: Sacerdotisa de la república de Laveda. Su fe la hizo poderosa y le ayudó a realizar mil milagros. Cuentan que ayudó a transportar a los dioses con sus enormes alas que hacenalgún milagro cuando se extienden. Sin embargo, ella niega todo y afirma ser una persona normal.
raw.id: Pendeta yang mengajarkan dewa-dewa di puing Republik La Veda. Karmanya membuatnya kuat dan banyak mukjizat tercatat. Rumornya Maria membantu menggendong dewa karena sayap besar di punggungnya terbentang saat melakukan mukjizat. Dia menyangkal hal ini, dan berkata dia hanyalah manusia biasa.
raw.pt: Uma sacerdotisa que pregava a palavra dos deuses na República arruinada de La Veda. Sua piedade a tornou poderosa, e são muitos os milagres registrados atribuídos a ela. Boatos dizem que Maria era uma enviada divina por causa das grandes asas que se extendiam de suas costas quando ela fazia um milagre. Mas ela negava isso obstinadamente, dizendo que era apenas uma pessoa comum.
raw.th: นักบวชหญิงผู้เผยแพร่คำสอนของพระเจ้าในสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลาย ความมีศรัทธาแก่กล้าของเธอทำให้เธอมีพลังและมีการอัศจรรย์หลายประการในบันทึกที่ว่ากันว่าเธอเป็นผู้ดำเนินการ ลือกันว่ามาเรียรับใช้พระเจ้าเพราะปีกขนาดใหญ่ที่ยืนมาจากหลังของเธอ ซึ่งกางแผ่ออกเมื่อเธอดำเนินการสร้างปาฏิหาริย์ เธอดึงดันปฏิเสธเรื่องนี้ โดยบอกว่าเธอเป็นเพียงคนปกติ
raw.vi: Một nữ tu sĩ - người thuyết giảng cho các vị thần tại đất nước La Veda. Sự sùng đạo là sức mạnh của cô, và người ta cho rằng cô đã làm được rất nhiều điều kì lạ. Họ đồn rằng Maria đã thực hiện việc này giúp các vị thần bởi lẽ đôi cánh lớn sau lưng cô sẽ dài ra khi cô thực hiện một phép lạ. Tuy nhiên, cô hoàn toàn phủ nhận điều này và nói rằng cô chỉ là một người bình thường .

id: Pendeta yang mengajarkan dewa-dewa di puing Republik La Veda. Membantu banyak orang melalui mukjizat, ia terus menyebarkan ajaran dewa, sehingga meraih julukan: Malaikat. Saat mulai perang, ia memikirkan penghakiman para dewa. Karmanya dia junjung tinggi, dan terus memohon pada para dewa, ingin mengetahui motif mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50072_DESCRIPTION
desc: A priestess who boasted of her belief in the gods in the ruined La Veda Republic. Helping many people through supposed miracles, she continued to preach the gods' teachings, eventually earning her the nickname, Angel. Yet when the war began, the judgement of the gods concerned her. She held her piety, and continued to plead with the gods, desiring to know their motive.

raw.en: A priestess who boasted of her belief in the gods in the ruined La Veda Republic. raw.es: Sacerdotisa de la república de Laveda y fiel seguidora de los dioses. Tras ayudar a los necesitados con sus milagros, siguió rezando a los dioses quienes la acabaron nombrando eminencia. Al desatarse la guerra, decidió no perder su fe y siguió orando a los dioses con la intención de saber cuáles eran sus motivos para luchar.
raw.id: Pendeta yang mengajarkan dewa-dewa di puing Republik La Veda. Membantu banyak orang melalui mukjizat, ia terus menyebarkan ajaran dewa, sehingga meraih julukan: Malaikat. Saat mulai perang, ia memikirkan penghakiman para dewa. Karmanya dia junjung tinggi, dan terus memohon pada para dewa, ingin mengetahui motif mereka.
raw.pt: Uma sacerdotisa que que tinha orgulho de sua crença nos deuses na República arruinada de La Veda. Ajudando muitas pessoas através de supostos milagres, ela continuou a pregar os ensinamentos divinos, eventualmente ganhando a alcunha de “Angelical”. Mas quando a guerra começou, ela ficou preocupada com o julgamento dos deuses. Ela manteve sua piedade, e continuou rogando aos deuses, buscando saber seus motivos.
raw.th: นักบวชหญิงผู้เติบโตมาพร้อมกับความเชื่อในพระเจ้าในสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลาย ได้ช่วยเหลือคนมากมายผ่านทางปาฏิหาริย์ เธอยังคงเผยแพร่คำสอนของพระเจ้าจนในที่สุดเธอก็ได้รับชื่อเล่นว่า "นางฟ้า" แต่เมือนสงครามเกิดขึ้น การพิพากษาของเทพเจ้าทำให้เธอกังวล เธอยังยึดมันในศรัทธาแรงกล้าและยังคงวิงวอนพระเจ้า โดยปรารถนาจะรู้ถึงพระประสงค์ของพระองค์
raw.vi: Một nữ tu sĩ tự hào về lòng tin của mình với các vị thần tại đất nước La Veda. Cô giúp nhiều người bằng phép lạ và tiếp tục thuyết giảng lời dạy của các vị thần, cuối cùng cô được người ta gọi là thiên thần. Tuy nhiên, khi chiến tranh bắt đầu , các vị thần bắt đầu phán xét của cô. Cô vẫn giữ lòng mộ đạo của mình và tiếp tục cầu xin với các vị thần cho cô biết hành động tiếp theo của họ.

id: Pendeta yang mengajar para dewa di reruntuhan Republik La Veda. Setelah perang dengan para dewa dimulai, ia banyak dikritik orang. Namun ia tidak jengkel pada dewa ataupun manusia, dan menggunakan kekuatan penyembuhnya tanpa diskriminasi. Melihatnya beraksi, seorang dewi memutuskan untuk menambah kekuatannya. Tidak diketahui mengapa seorang dewi memberikan kekuatan sebesar itu pada manusia, namun tidak ada yang membantah bahwa tindakan tersebut telah menyelamatkan banyak nyawa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50073_DESCRIPTION
desc: A priestess who preached of the gods in the ruined La Veda Republic. After the war with the gods began she received a lot of criticism from the people, however she held no resentment toward either god or man, and used her healing powers indiscriminately on both. Seeing her in action, a goddess decided to grant her even more power. It's unknown why the goddess bestowed such power to a human, but it's undeniable how many lives that act saved.

raw.es: Sacerdotisa de la república de La Veda que oraba a los dioses. Cuando estalló la guerra contra los dioses, María recibió muchas críticas de parte de su gente. Sin embargo, la sacerdotisa no guardó resentimiento hacia los hombres o los dioses, y usó sus poderes sanadores para alegría de ambos. Tras ver el comportamiento de María, una diosa decidió darle más poderes todavía. Se desconoce por qué una diosa bendijo a una humana con tanto poder, pero no se puede negar que ese acto salvó una cantidad incontable de vidas.

raw.pt: Uma sacerdotisa que pregava a palavra dos deuses na República arruinada de La Veda. Depois da guerra com os deuses ela recebeu muitas críticas do povo, mas não tinha ressentimentos contra homens ou deuses, e usou seus poderes de cura em ambos sem discriminações. Vendo suas ações, uma deusa decidiu lhe conceder ainda mais poder. Não se sabe por que a deusa deu tanto poder a uma humana, mas é inquestionável o número de vidas salvas pelo ato.
raw.th: นักบวชหญิงผู้เผยแพร่คำสอนของพระเจ้าในสาธารณรัฐลา วิดาที่ล่มสลาย หลังจากสงครามกับเทพเจ้าได้เริ่มต้นขึ้น เธอได้รับเสียงตำหนิจากผู้คน แต่อย่างไรก็ตามเธอไม่ได้ผูกใจเจ็บแค้นทั้งต่อเทพเจ้าหรือมนุษย์ด้วยกันเอง และใช้พลังรักษาของเธอให้กับทั้งสองฝ่ายโดยไม่แบ่งแยก เมื่อเห็นการกระทำนั้นเทพธิดาจึงตัดสินใจมอบพลังให้กับเธอมากยิ่งขึ้น ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าทำไมเทพธิดาถึงได้มอบพลังขนาดนั้นให้กับมนุษย์ แต่ก็ปฏิเสธไม่ได้เลยว่าการทำแบบนั้นได้ช่วยชีวิตเอาไว้มากมาย
raw.vi: Một nữ tu sĩ đã thuyết giảng về các vị thần ở nước Cộng hòa La Veda đổ nát. Sau chiến tranh do các vị thần khơi mào, cô nhận được nhiều sự chỉ trích từ người dân, tuy nhiên cô không oán giận người hay thần, và sử dụng khả năng chữa bệnh của mình không phân biệt cho cả hai người hay thần. Chứng kiến hành động của cô, một nữ thần đã quyết định ban cho cô nhiều sức mạnh hơn nữa. Người ta không biết tại sao nữ thần lại ban sức mạnh như vậy cho một con người, nhưng không thể phủ nhận đã có bao nhiêu mạng sống được cứu nhờ hành động đó.

id: Prajurit terang yang berkelana dari satu medan perang ke yang lain karena misi dari para dewa. Mereka adalah spesies yang berbeda dari manusia meskipun penampilannya seperti manusia dengan sayap. Hanya terdiri dari wanita, masih dipelajari bagaimana mereka berkembang biak. Legenda menceritakan bahwa para dewa meninggalkan mereka untuk mempertahankan dunia. Mereka punya pedang untuk melindungi dunia dari kejahatan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50082_DESCRIPTION
desc: A warrior of light who traverses battlefield after battlefield on a mission from the gods. They're a different species from humans despite their human-with-wings appearance. As there are only females, they are still being studied to see how they maintain their species. Legend has is that the gods left them to defend the world. They have sword to protect the world from evil.

raw.es: Guerreras de la luz que atraviesan el campo de batalla encomendadas por los dioses. A pesar de su similitud, pertenecen a otra raza de humanos. Son todas mujeres, así que se está investigando cómo logran preservar su especie. Según la leyenda, los dioses las crearon para proteger el mundo del mal con sus espadas.
