raw.pt: Uma espadacim da República arruinada de La Veda, ela foi conhecida como uma aventureira que viajava por ruínas antigas em busca de seus pais. Suas aventuras, como aquela onde derrotou um espírito perverso, ou os tempos passados viajando por selvas inexploradas, a inspiravem. Mais do que glória, ela queria mesmo era encontrar seus pais.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลาย เธอเป็นที่รู้จักในฐานะนักผจญภัยผู้ท่องเที่ยวตามโบราณสถานต่างๆ เพื่อค้นหาพ่อกับแม่ของเธอ การผจญภัยของเธอ เช่นเมื่อเธอกำหลาบวิญญาณชั่วร้ายหรือยามเมื่อเธเดินทางเข้าป่าที่ยังไม่เคยได้รับการสำรวจเหล่านี้สร้างแรงบันดาลใจให้กับเธอ แต่เธอแค่ต้องการจะค้นหาพ่อแม่ของเธอมากกว่าต้องการชื่อเสียง
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ tại đất nước La Veda, cô được biết đến như một nhà thám hiểm người đi tìm những di tích cổ trong nghiên cứu của cha mẹ cô . Cuộc phiêu lưu của cô có khi là đánh bại ma quỷ, hoặc có lần cô đi qua khu rừng chưa được khám phá-thứ đã thu hút cô. Cô muốn tìm cha mẹ mình hơn là có được sự ngưỡng mộ.

id: Wanita jago pedang dari Republik La Veda yang hancur. Dia menemukan orang tuanya di sebuah reruntuhan kuno, tapi kegembirannya hanya sebentar. Mereka telah memblokir kekuatan perusak reruntuhan itu dengan mengikat mereka ke reruntuhan itu. Mengabaikan permohonan mereka untuk menekan kekuatan dengan nyawa mereka, Alma mengalahkan reruntuhan itu sendirian. Petualangannya telah berakhir, dan dia kenal setelah itu sebagai pahlawan yang mencegah katastrofe dan juga menyelamatkan orang tuanya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50143_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the ruined La Veda Republic. She found her parents at some ancient ruins, but her joy was short lived. They had blocked the ruins' destructive power by binding themselves to them. Ignoring their pleas to be allowed to suppress the power with their lives, Alma defeated it herself. Her adventures ended, and she was known soforth as a hero for both preventing a catastrophe and for saving her parents.

raw.en: A swordswoman from the ruined La Veda Republic. She found her parents at some ancient ruins, but her joy was short lived. They had blocked the ruins' destructive power by binding themselves to them. Ignoring their pleas to be allowed to suppress the power with their lives, Alma defeated it herself. Her adventures ended, and she was known soforth as a hero for both preventing a catastrophe and for saving her parents.
raw.es: Una espadachina de la antigua república de Laveda. Encontró a sus padres en unas antiguas ruinas, pero su alegría duró poco. Estos habían bloqueado el poder destructivo de las ruinas vinculándose a ellas. Ignorando sus súplicas para que los dejara contener el poder de las ruinas, Alma puso fin a todo. Tras el suceso, dejó de viajar y se convirtió en la heroína que salvó al mundo y a sus padres.

raw.pt: Uma espadachim da República arruinada de La Veda. Ela encontrou seus pais em um conjunto de ruínas antigas, mas sua alegria durou pouco. Eles haviam bloqueado o poder destrutivo das ruínas vinculando-as a si próprios. Ignorando seus pedidos de que ela permitisse a eles reprimir o poder com suas vidas, Alma o derrotou por conta própria. Suas aventuras acabaram, e dali em diante ela foi conhecida como heroína por previnir uma catástrofe e salvar seus pais.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้าที่ล่มสลาย เธอหาพ่อกับแม่ของเธอพบที่ซากโบราณแห่งหนึ่งแต่ความดีใจของเธอก็มีอยู่ไม่ได้นาน พวกเขาได้ทำสการสกัดกั้นพลังทำลายล้างของซากโบราณด้วยกันผนึกตัวเองไว้กับซากนั้น แต่ "อัลม่า" กลับลงมือจัดการกับมันโดยไม่ฟังคำขอของพวกเขาที่จะช้ชีวิตตนเองในการเอาชนะพลังนั้น การเดินทางของเธอจบลงที่นั่น และต่อมาเธอเป็นที่รู้จักในฐานะวีรสตรีผู้ป้องกันไม่ให้เดินหายนะและได้ช่วยเหลือพ่อแม่ของตนด้วย
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ tại đất nước La Veda. Cô tìm thấy cha mẹ cô tại một số di tích cổ, nhưng niềm vui của cô đã qua đi nhanh chóng. Họ bị mặc kẹt trong đống đổ nát và sức mạnh bị giảm sút vì 2 người bị trói lại với nhau. Bỏ qua lời khuyên của họ , Alma một mình chống trọi để cứu họ ra. Cuộc phiêu lưu của cô kết thúc và cô được biết với sự gan dạ như một anh hùng vì đã ngăn chặn được tai họa và cứu được bố mẹ.

id: Jago pedang wanita dari Republik La Veda. Setelah perjalanannya usai dan orang tuanya terselamatkan, mereka kembali ke kota asal mereka setelah sekian lama. Tapi, hari-hari damai mereka terhenti dengan serangan para dewa, di mana mereka sebagai keluarga memutuskan untuk menyelamatkan manusia. Dalam pertarungannya yang sengit, Alma menunjukkan penguasaan sempurna atas teknik pedangnya, meskipun orang tuanya jauh lebih hebat lagi. Meskipun awalnya Alam terkejut melihatnya, dia lalu tersenyum sambil melanjutkan serangannya yang menusuk tajam.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50144_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the La Veda Republic. After her travels ended and she'd saved her parents, they all went back to their hometown for the first time in a long time. However, their peaceful days were brought to an end by the invasion of the gods, at which time they left as a family to protect the people. During the intense battle Alma's mastered her sword technique, though her parents displayed even greater mastery and strength. At first Alma was surprised to see this, but eventually she just smiled as she continued her piercing attack.

raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากสาธารณรัฐ ลา วีดา หลังจากที่การเดินทางของเธอจบลงและเธอได้ช่วยชีวิตพอกับแม่ของเธอ พวกเขาก็กลับไปยังบ้านเกิดหลังจากที่ไม่ได้กลับไปนานมาก อย่างไรก็ตามวันที่แสนสงบสุขของพวกเขาก็ถูกทำลายด้วยการรุกรานของเทพเจ้า ซึ่งพวกเขาทั้งครอบครัวก็ได้ออกมาสู้เพื่อปกป้องผู้คน ระหว่างการต่อสู้ที่น่ากลัว อัลม่าก็สำเร็จวิชาดาบของเธอ แต่พ่อกับแม่ของเธอกลับแสดงพลังและวิชาที่แข็งแกร่งยิ่งกว่าให้เห็น ในตอนแรกอัลม่าก็ประหลาดใจกับเรื่องนี้ แต่ในที่สุดเธอก็แค่ยิ้มและฟาดฟันดาบใส่ศัตรูต่อไป
raw.vi: Một nữ kiếm sĩ đến từ nước Cộng hòa La Veda. Sau khi chuyến đi của cô kết thúc và cô đã cứu được bố mẹ mình, tất cả họ đã trở về quê hương lần đầu tiên sau một thời gian dài. Tuy nhiên, những ngày hòa bình đã kết thúc bởi cuộc xâm lược của các vị thần, lúc đó họ đã ra đi như một gia đình để bảo vệ người dân. Trong trận chiến khốc liệt, Alma được rèn rũa kỹ thuật dùng kiếm, mặc dù bố mẹ cô đã cho thấy khả năng bậc thầy và sức mạnh thậm chí còn lớn hơn nữa. Đầu tiên, Alma kinh ngạc khi thấy điều này, nhưng cuối cùng cô chỉ mỉm cười khi cô tiếp tục tấn công mạnh mẽ.

id: Ahli pedang wanita dari Republik La Veda. Sebagai ksatria dari La Veda, Alma bertarung untuk melindungi semua orang. Tapi, jumlah Pasukan Dewa menjadi sangat besar, dan akhirnya dia terkurung di rumahnya sendiri. Di dalamnya terdapat ayahnya, yang terluka melindungi anaknya dari bahaya. Ketika Alma panik melihat ayahnya yang terluka parah, ayahnya memarahinya dan memberikan kepadanya kekuatan besar yang digunakannya untuk memakai kapak kunonya. Menggunakan kekuatan baru ini, Alma berhasil membela dirinya sendiri dan ayahnya yang sekarat dari situasi berbahaya yang dihadapinya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50145_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the La Veda Republic. As a knight of La Veda, Alma fought to protect everyone in and out of her reach. However, the numbers of the God Army became too great, and eventually she was cornered in her own home. Inside was her father, who fell trying to protect his daughter from danger. When Alma panicked as she saw her father mortally wounded, he scolded her strictly and then passed onto her the great power he had used to wield his ancient axe. Using this new power, Alma was successfully able to defend herself and her dying father from the perilous situation at hand.

Cuando Alma entró en pánico mientras veía la herida mortal de su padre, él la regañó y le legó el gran poder que él había usado para blandir su hacha ancestral. Alma usó este nuevo poder y logró defenderse ella misma y defender a su padre de la situación peligrosa en la que se encontraban.

Porém, o exército dos deuses ficou muito grande, e ela acabou ficando presa em seu próprio lar. Lá estava seu pai, que morreu tentando proteger sua filha. Quando Alma entrou em pânico ao ver seu pai mortalmente ferido, ele a repreendeu e passou a ela o grande poder que tinha usado para manejar seu antigo machado. Usando esse novo poder, Alma conseguiu se defender e proteger o pai moribundo dos perigos.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากสาธารณรัฐลา วิดา ในฐานะอัศวินของ ลา วิดา อัลม่าต่อสู้เพื่อปกป้องทุกคนไม่ว่าเธอจะเอื้อมมือไปถึงหรือไม่ อย่างไรก็ตาม จำนวนของกองทัพเทพเจ้าเริ่มมีมากเกินไป และสุดท้ายเธอก็จนมุมในบ้านของเธอเอง ในนั้นมีพ่อของเธอ ผู้ที่ล้มเจ็บลงจากความพยายามที่จะปกป้องลูกสาวของตนเองจากอันตราย เมื่ออัลม่าตกใจกลัวจากการเห็นพ่อของเธอบาดเจ็บเจียนตาย เขาตะโกนใส่เธออย่างเจ้มงวดและส่งมอบพลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่ให้กับเธอ พลังที่เขาใช้กวัดแกว่งขวานโบราณของเขา ด้วยการใช้พลังใหม่นี้ อัลม่าก็สามารถป้องกันตัวเองและพ่อที่กำลังจะตายของเธอจากสถานการณ์อันเลวร้ายได้สำเร็จ
raw.vi: Một nữ kiếm sĩ đến từ nước Cộng hòa La Veda. Là một hiệp sĩ của La Veda, Alma đã chiến đấu để bảo vệ mọi người cả trong và ngoài tầm của cô. Tuy nhiên, số lượng của Đội Quân Các Vị Thần trở nên rất lớn và cuối cùng cô bị dồn vào chân tường trong chính ngôi nhà của mình. Bên trong là cha cô, người đã ngã xuống khi cố gắng bảo vệ con gái mình khỏi nguy hiểm. Khi Alma hoảng sợ vì chứng kiến cha mình bị trọng thương, ông đã mắng cô một cách nghiêm khắc, rồi truyền cho cô sức mạnh to lớn mà ông đã dùng để sử dụng cây rìu cổ của mình. Sử dụng sức mạnh mới này, Alma đã có thể bảo vệ thành công bản thân và người cha đang hấp hối của mình khỏi tình huống nguy hiểm cận kề.

id: Jago pedang yang menjadi ksatria karena mengikuti langkah pahlawannya, Will dari Republik La Veda. Sebagai rekrutan baru ksatria, Aem berlatih siang dan malam untuk menjadi cepat dan cekatan seperti Will. Will sendiri yang menyarankan dia mengubah senjatanya menjadi pedang besar, perubahan besar yang merupakan dunia baru yang penuh kemungkinan. Setelah itu, Aem mengayunkan pedangnya minimal 10 ribu kali tiap hari, dan segera dikenali sebagai orang berbakat oleh para ksatria.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50152_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordsman who became a knight in order to follow in the steps of his hero, Will of the Republic of La Veda. As a new knight recruit, Aem trained day and night to become as nimble and agile as Will. It was Will himself who suggested he swap his weapon for a broadsword, a major adjustment that brought with it a whole new world of tactical possibilities. After that, Aem swung his sword at least 10 thousand times a day, and soon became recognized as a true talent among his fellow knights.

raw.es: Espadachín que se convirtió en caballero para poder seguir los pasos de su héroe Will de la república de La Veda. Como nuevo recluta de caballero, Aem entrenó día y noche para ser tan ágil y habilidoso como Will. Fue el mismo Will quien le sugirió que cambie su arma por una espada ancha; este gran cambio significó un abanico enorme de nuevas posibilidades tácticas. Luego, Aem blandió su espada al menos diez mil veces por día, y sus colegas caballeros lo reconocieron como un guerrero verdaderamente talentoso.

raw.th: นักดาบที่กลายมาเป็นอัศวินเพื่อจะได้เดินตามแบบผู้กล้าในดวงใจของเขา "วิล แห่งสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้า" เมื่อมีการรับสมัครอัศวินใหม่ "เอม" ฝึกฝนทั้งวันทั้งคืนเพื่อให้คล่องแคล่วและว่องไวเหมือนวิล และวิลก้เป็นผู้แนะนำเขาเองให้เปลี่ยนอาวุธมาใช้ดาบยักษ์ ซึ่งเป็นการปรับเปลี่ยนครั้งสำคัญที่มาพร้อมกับโลกใหม่แห่งความเป็นไปได้ทางยุทธวิธี หลังจากนั้นเอมได้กวัดแกว่งดาบของเขาไม่ต่ำกว่าหนึ่งหมื่นครั้งต่อวัน และไม่นานก็เป็นที่จดจำในฐานะผู้มีพรสรรค์ในบรรดาอัศวิน
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ đã trở thành hiệp sĩ tiếp bước những anh hùng trước đó , Will của đất nước La Veda . Do là người mới, nên Aem được đào tạo ngày đêm để trở nên nhanh nhẹn như Will. Will chính là người đề nghị đổi vũ khí của mình lấy một thanh đao, đó là sự thay đổi lớn vì nó mang theo toàn bộ khả năng chiến thuật mới của thế giới. Sau đó, Aem đã vung lưỡi kiếm ít nhất 10.000 lần một ngày, và nhanh chóng được công nhận là một tài năng thực sự trong các hiệp sĩ .

id: Jago pedang yang menjadi ksatria karena mengikuti langkah pahlawannya, Will dari Republik La Veda. Yakin akan kemampuan Will yang lebih tinggi, Aem manantang Atro untuk bertarung secara formal. Pertarungan itu dihentikan di tengah jalan, tapi reputasi Aem terkenal sebagai ksatria yang bisa menahan sang legendaris Atro.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50153_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordsman who became a knight in order to follow in the steps of his hero, Will of the Republic of La Veda. Will’s most devoted follower, Aem couldn’t bear the way Will and Atro appeared to be held in equal regard by his peers. Convinced of Will’s superiority, Aem challenged Atro to a joust. The joust was called off halfway through, but Aem’s reputation was sealed as the knight who’d managed to hold his own against the legendary Atro.

Aun cuando fue admirado como uno de los cinco mejores caballeros del clan Veda, su inmenso respeto hacia Will nunca cambió. Mientras el mundo se sucumbía en el caos, Aem se mantuvo siempre junto a Will y continuó desempeñándose con lealtad y precisión. Se dice que en sus últimos momentos, trató de proteger heroicamente a Will de la arremetida de los dioses.
raw.id: Jago pedang yang menjadi ksatria karena mengikuti langkah pahlawannya, Willd dari Republik La Veda.  Setelah dia dianggap sebagai lima ksatria paling top di klan Veda, rasa hormat Aem yang besar terhadap Will tidak berubah. Ketika dunia menjadi kacau, Aem berdiri setia di sebelah Will, dan selalu melakukan tugasnya dengan penuh kesetiaan dan akurasi. Katanya saat-saat terakhirnya digunakan untuk mencoba melindungi Will dari serangan para dewa.
raw.pt: Um espadachim que se tornou cavaleiro para seguir os passos de seu herói, Will da República de La Veda. Mesmo quando foi considerado um dos cinco melhores cavaleiros do clã Veda, seu intenso sentimento de respeito por Will nunca mudou. Quando o mundo entrou no caos, Aem ficou ao lado de Will e continuou a cumprir seu papel com lealdade e precisão. Dizem que viveu seus últimos momentos com heroísmo tentando proteger Will da fúria dos deuses.
raw.th: นักดาบที่กลายมาเป็นอัศวินเพื่อจะได้เดินตามแบบผู้กล้าในดวงใจของเขา "วิล แห่งสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้า" แม่เขาจะถูกยกย่องเป็นหนึ่งในห้าอัศวินแห่งวีด้า ความเคารพของเอมอย่างมากมายต่อวิลก็ยังคงไม่เปลี่ยนแปลง และขณะที่โลกดำดิ่งสู่ความวุ่นวาย เอมยืนหยัดเคียงข้างวิลอย่างเด็ดเดี่ยวละยังคงปฏิบัติหน้าที่ของเขาด้วยความจงรักภักดีและความเที่ยงตรง ว่ากันว่าวินาทีสุดท้ายของเขานั้น เขาได้เข้าไปปกป้องวิลจากการสังหารของเทพเจ้าอย่างกล้าหาญ
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ đã trở thành hiệp sĩ để tiếp bước vị anh hùng trong lòng, đó là Will của Cộng hòa La Veda. Ngay cả khi chàng được ca ngợi là một trong năm hiệp sĩ hàng đầu trong gia tộc Veda, cảm xúc tông trọng mãnh liệt của AEM đối với Will không bao giờ thay đổi. Khi thế giới rơi vào hỗn loạn, AEM kiên quyết đứng bên cạnh Will, và tiếp tục nhiệm vụ của mình với lòng trung thành và đứng đắn. Người ta nói rằng những khoảnh khắc cuối cùng, chàng đã cố gắng bảo vệ Will khỏi sự tấn công của các vị thần.

id: Jago pedang yang menjadi ksatria untuk mengikuti jejak pahlawannya. Setelah La Veda jatuh, ia mengejar Will yang memisahkan diri dan hampir menantang para dewa. Setelah terkejar, Will memarahinya, Aem membalas, "Adalah harapan orang-orang bahwa Sir Will selamat dalam perang dengan dewa." Katanya, Will tersenyum ceria, Aem berdiri di depannya dan lanjut menghadapi serangan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50155_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordsman who became a knight in order to follow in the steps of his hero. After La Veda fell, he chased after Will who had broke off on his own and was about to challenge the gods. After catching up to him Will rebuked him, to which Aem responded, "It is the hope of all the people to see Sir Will safely through battle with the gods." It is said that, as Will smiled cheerfully, Aem stood in front of him and continued to counter the gods' attacks.

raw.es: Espadachín que se convirtió en caballero para poder seguir los pasos de su héroe. Luego de la caída de La Veda, salió en búsqueda de Will, que había escapado por su cuenta para desafiar a los dioses. Al alcanzarlo, Will reprendió severamente a Aem, que respondió: "El pueblo desea asegurarse de proteger a Sir Will durante la batalla con los dioses". Las historias cuentan que Will sonrió alegremente mientras Aem, ahora al frente, continuó contrarrestando el ataque de los dioses.

raw.pt: Um espadachim que se tornou cavaleiro para seguir os passos de seu herói. Depois da queda de La Veda, ele partiu atrás de Will, que se separou para desafiar os deuses sozinho. Depois de ser alcançado, Will o repreendeu, mas ele respondeu: “A esperança de todo o povo é ver Sir Will saindo com segurança da batalha contra os deuses.” Dizem que Will sorriu com gosto enquanto Aem estava em sua frente rebatendo os ataques dos deuses.
raw.th: นักดาบผู้กลายเป็นอัศวินเพื่อจะเจริญรอยตามฮีโร่ของเขา หลังจากที่ ลา วีดา ล่มสลาย เขาได้ไล่ตามวิลผู้ที่แยกออกไปเพียงลำพังและกำลังจะเผชิญหน้ากับเทพเจ้า หลังจากที่ตามทัน วิล ก็ตำหนิเขา ซึ่ง เอม ก็ตอบกลับว่า"มันเป็นความหวังของทุกผู้คนที่จะได้เห็นท่านวิลปลอดภัย ตลอดการต่อสู้กับเทพเจ้า" ว่ากันว่า ขณะที่ วิล ยิ้มอย่างมีความสุข เอม ยืนอยู่เบื้องหน้าเขาและโจมตีสวนกลับใส่เทพเจ้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ đã trở thành hiệp sĩ để đi theo các bước của anh hùng của anh. Sau khi La Veda thất thủ, anh đã đuổi theo Will, người đã tự rời khỏi và chuẩn bị thách thức các vị thần. Sau khi bắt kịp anh ta, Will đã quở trách anh, và Aem đã trả lời: "Tất cả người dân đều hy vọng sẽ thấy Ngài Will an toàn sau trận với các vị thần." Người ta nói rằng, khi Will mỉm cười vui vẻ, Aem đã đứng trước anh và tiếp tục chống lại các cuộc tấn công của các vị thần.

id: Ksatria perempuan yang membawa 8 pedang di punggungnya. Waktu itu tidak ada seorang pun yang tahu dari mana dia datang, ke manakah tujuannya, atau apa yang dicarinya. Bahkan tidak banyak yang memiliki kesempatan untuk bicara dengannya. Namun, tindakannya disaksikan sampai di banyak tempat jauh karena dia pergi dari satu tempat ke tempat lain, melenyapkan makhluk dunia lain yang mengacau. Semistis penampakannya, ia ditakuti siapa saja yang melihatnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50162_DESCRIPTION
desc: The woman warrior who wore 8 blades on her back. At the time there was no one who knew where she came from, where she was headed, or what she was after. There weren't even many who had the chance to speak with her. However, her actions were witnessed in many lands far and wide as she went from place to place, vanquishing otherworldly beings that were causing havoc. It is said that as mystical as she seemed, she still struck fear in the hearts of any who saw her.

raw.es: Guerrera que lleva ocho hojas en la espalda. En ese entonces, nadie sabía de dónde provenía, hacía dónde iba ni qué buscaba. Incluso unos pocos tuvieron la oportunidad de hablarle. Sin embargo, su comportamiento fue presenciado en muchas tierras durante sus viajes de un lugar a otro, travesías en las que derrotó a seres de otro mundo que causaban estragos. También se dice que a pesar de su apariencia mística, Sefia infundía miedo en los corazones de quienes la veían.

raw.pt: A guerreira que usava 8 lâminas em suas costas. Na época ninguém sabia de onde ela vinha, para onde ia, ou o que buscava. Poucos tiveram a chance de falar com ela. Porém, suas ações foram testemunhadas por todo lado enquanto ela viajava, dando cabo de seres de outros mundos que causavam problemas. Dizem que apesar de sua aparência mística, ela ainda enchia de temor o coração daqueles que a viam.
raw.th: นักรบหญิงผู้ติดดาบทั้ง 8 เล่มเอาไว้อยู่บนหลัง ในเวลานั้นไม่มีใครรู้ว่าเธอมาจากไหน จะมุ่งหน้าไปที่ใด หรือกำลังตามหาอะไรอยู่ และมีคนไม่มากที่มีโอกาสได้พูดคุยกับเธอ อย่างไรก็ดีการกระทำของเธอก็เป็นที่ประจักษ์ไปทั่วทั้งดินแดน เพราะขณะที่เธอเดินทางจากที่หนึ่งสู่อีกที่หนึ่ง กำจัดสิ่งมีชีวิตต่างโลกที่สร้างหายนะ ว่ากันว่าเธอสร้างความหวาดกลัวภายในใจให้กับผู้ที่พบเห็นเหมือนกับลักษณะที่ดูลึกลับของเธอ
raw.vi: Một nữ chiến binh có 8 clưỡi hái trên lưng. Khi đó không có ai biết cô ta từ đâu đến, cô ta là thủ lĩnh ở đâu và cô ta sẽ trở thành gì sau đó. Không có nhiều người có cơ hội được nói chuyện với cô ta. Tuy nhiên, những hành động của cô ta được nhiều người ở nhiều vùng đất chứng kiến khi cô ta chu du khắp đó đây , cô ta chế ngự được giống loài khác chuyên gây phá hoại. Người ta nói rằng có vẻ như thần bí khi có vẻ như cô ta thường khiến cho người khác cảm thấy sợ hại khi nhìn thấy cô ta.

id: Ksatria perempuan yang membawa 8 pisau di punggungnya. Meski ia menguburkan banyak makhluk dari dunia lain, dahulu ia ditemukan banjir darah. Menurut saksi, musuhnya berhasil mengatasi serangan 8 pisaunya, dan langsung menyerang balik. Si musuh meninggalkannya dan berkata, "Tolol sekali!" Sekali lagi ini membuatnya mengakui kelemahannya, bahwa pisau di punggungnya untuk menegakkan keadilan dan bukan melindungi diri sendiri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50163_DESCRIPTION
desc: The woman warrior who wore 8 blades on her back. Though she had buried countless hordes of raging otherworldly beings, she was once found covered in blood. According to witness account, an enemy of hers was able to evade her 8 blade attack, upon which they instantly countered back. Her enemy left her behind, spouting at her "How dull!" before departing. This left her to once again acknowledge her weakness, being that the blades on her back were for casting judgment and were not there for her own protection.

Según la versión de un testigo, uno de sus enemigos pudo evadir su ataque de ocho hojas, que instantáneamente contraatacaron. Su enemigo la dejó atrás y, antes de partir, lanzó la frase: "¡Qué aburrido!". Esto hizo que Sefia reconociera una vez más su debilidad, dado que las espadas que llevaba en la espalda eran para juzgar y no para su propia protección.

raw.pt: A guerreira que usava 8 lâminas em suas costas. Apesar de ter enterrado incontáveis hordas de seres de outros mundos, uma vez ela foi encontrada coberta de sangue. De acordo com uma testemunha, um inimigo dela conseguiu desviar do ataque de suas 8 lâminas, e imediatamente contra-atacou. Seu inimigo a deixou para trás, dizendo “Que sem graça!” antes de partir. Isso fez com que ela novamente reconhecesse sua fraqueza, sendo que as lâminas às suas costas eram para julgamento, e não para defesa.
raw.th: นักรบหญิงผู้ติดดาบทั้ง 8 เล่มเอาไว้อยู่บนหลัง แม้ว่าเธอจะเคยฝังสิ่งมีชีวิตต่างโลกมานับไม่ถ้วน ครั้งหนึ่งเธอเคยถูกพบนอนจมกองเลือด ตามที่พยานได้บอกไว้ ศัตรูของเธอสามารถหลบการโจมตีของดาบทั้ง 8 เล่มได้ ซึ่งพร้อมกัยยั้ยก็ได้โจมตีสวนกกลับไปด้วย ศัตรูทิ้งเธอเอาไว้เบื้องหลัง พร้อมกับเย้ยหยันว่า "น่าเบื่อจริง" ก่อนจะจากไป สิ่งนี้ทำให้เธอได้พบจุดอ่อนของตัวเอง ว่าขณะที่ดาบออกไปฟาดฟันเพื่อความยุตะรรม มันก็ไม่ได้อยู่ใกล้เพื่อคุ้มครองตัวเธอเองเช่นกัน
raw.vi: Nữ chiến binh có 8 lưỡi hái trên lưng. Mặc dù cô ta đã từng chiến đấu đánh bại bao giống loài khác, nhưng người ta cũng đã từng nhìn thấy cô nằm trong vũng máu. Theo một nhân chứng kể lại, một kẻ thù của cô đã có thể tránh được đòn tấn công bằng 8 lưỡi hái của cô và hắn lập tức phản hồi lại đòn đánh của cô. Kẻ thù của cô đi ra phía sau lưng phun vào cô và làm cho cô trở thành "mê muội" trước khi có thể vực dậy được. Và đây là một điểm yếu của cô, những chiếc cánh trên lưng cô không có tác dụng bảo vệ cô.

id: Ksatria perempuan yang membawa 8 pisau di punggungnya. Setelah perang dengan para dewa dimulai, ia terus, selalu, menghabisi target dengan 8 pisaunya. Sekarang hampir selesai, izinkan aku memakai kekuatanmu." Saat ini tidak mengerti siapa yang dia maksud dengan pernyataan itu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50164_DESCRIPTION
desc: The woman warrior who wore 8 blades on her back. After the war with the gods started, she continued on as always, obliterating targets with her 8 blades. However in records starting from the humans' decline during the war, a quote from her appeared, despite the fact she had never been mentioned herself up until that point. It read, "My part is finished. Now that it's almost over, allow me to use your strength." There currently exists no one who understands what she meant by that statement.

raw.vi: Một nữ chiến binh có 8 lưỡi hái trên lưng. Sau khi cuộc chiến với các vị thần nổ ra, cô ta tiếp tục phả hủy các mục tiêu với 8 lưỡi hái của mình. Tuy nhiên, trong những kỉ lục bắt đầu tự sự suy thoái của con người trong suốt chiến tranh, một lời chú thích xuất hiện từ cô mặc dù sự thật là cô ta chưa từng được đề cập cho đến thời điểm đó. Theo đó, " Tôi đã hoàn thành sứ mệnh của mình. Giờ là lúc cho phép tôi sử dụng sức mạnh của bạn". Không ai có thể hiểu được rằng cô ta muốn nói gì trong lời tuyên bố của mình

id: Prajurit wanita yang mengenakan 8 pedang di punggungnya. Melepaskan tanggung jawabnya untuk menghakimi makhluk dari dunia lain, dia mengarahkan pedangnya ke para dewa. Dalam perang yang sengit, dia sekali lagi berhadapan dengan musuh lamanya. Bau darah tercium di udara, selagi dia bersumpah kalau dia bertahan hidup dalam pertempuran ini, mereka akan bertarung sekali lagi berdua. Selagi dia berucap, pedang terbang dari belakang makhluk seram yang ada di hadapannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50165_DESCRIPTION
desc: The woman warrior who wore 8 blades on her back. Throwing away the responsibility she had been given of judging otherworldly beings, she turned her blades on the gods. In the heat of battle, she once again came face to face with an old foe. The smell of blood drifting through the air, she swore that if she was able to survive the battle that they would fight just the two of them once again. As she said this, blades shot out from the back of the wicked creature that stood before her.

raw.es: Guerrera que lleva ocho hojas en la espalda. Tras rechazar la responsabilidad que se le había asignado de juzgar a los seres de otros mundos, decidió rebelarse contra los dioses. En plena batalla, se encontró frente a frente con un antiguo enemigo. El aroma a sangre infectaba el aire que los rodeaba, y ella juró que si sobrevivía a esta batalla, se volverían a enfrentar ellos dos solos. Mientras realizaba esta promesa, varias espadas salieron disparadas desde la espalda de la monstruosa criatura que se encontraba frente a ella.

raw.pt: A guerreira que usava 8 lâminas em suas costas. Ao se desfazer da responsabilidade que recebeu de julgar seres de outros mundos, ela voltou suas lâminas contra os deuses. No calor da batalha ela voltou a ficar cara a cara com um antigo inimigo. Com o cheiro de sangue pairando no ar, ela jurou que voltariam a duelar caso ela conseguisse sobreviver à batalha. Quando ela disse essas palavras, lâminas foram arremessadas das costas da criatura maligna que estava adiante.
raw.th: นักรบหญิงผู้มีสวมดาบทั้ง 8 เล่มบนหลังของเธอ เธอละทิ้งความรับผิดชอบที่ได้รับมอบหมายในการพิพากษษสิ่งที่มาจากโลกอื่น เธอหันดาบเข้าหาเทพเจ้า ในระหว่างการต่อสู้ที่เร่าร้อน เธอก็ได้กลับมาพบกับศัตรูเก่าอีกครั้งหนึ่ง กลิ่นคาวเลือดคละคลุ้งไปในอากาศ เธอสาบานว่าเธอจะต้องมีชีวิตรอดจากการต่อสู้ของคนทั้งสองที่จะเกิดอีกครังหนึ่ง ขณะที่เธอพูด ดาบของเธอก็บินออกจากหลังและพุ่งเข้าหาสิ่งมีชีวิตที่ชั่วร้ายซึ่งยืนอยู่เบื้องหน้าเธอ
raw.vi: Một nữ chiến binh đeo 8 lưỡi kiếm trên lưng. Vứt bỏ trách nhiệm cô đã được giao là phán xét những sinh vật của thế giới khác, cô quay lưỡi kiếm của mình chống lại các vị thần. Trong sức nóng của cuộc chiến, cô từng một lần nữa đối mặt với một kẻ thù cũ. Mùi máu trôi dạt trong không khí, cô đã thề rằng nếu cô có thể sống sót qua cuộc chiến mà họ sẽ chiến đấu chỉ hai người với nhau một lần nữa. Khi cô nói điều này, lưỡi kiếm được bắn ra từ lưng của sinh vật độc ác đứng trước cô.

id: The woman warrior who wore 8 blades on her back. As Sefia fought alongside Kikuri against the gods, the clash of their enormous powers opened the door to another world, drawing them inside. What happened to her afterwards remains a mystery, but some say that she finally made good on her promise to fight Kikuri, only to end up caught up in a long battle to the death that never reached a conclusion. A fragment of her eight blades would be discovered centuries later, apparently still attached to a piece of scarlet cloth when it was found.

id: Kelinci bertanduk yang menempati sebagian kecil Gaia Besar. Herbivora, sangat teritorial dan mengotori siapa saja yang menginjakkan kaki di wilayahnya. Kelinci ini dapat menghancurkan batu dengan serangan penuh menggunakan kekuatan pegas kaki belakangnya. Kadang terlihat berjuang melepaskan tanduknya, setelah tanduk terjebak sesuatu. Teriakan Al-mi'raj yang tanduknya terjepit tinggi dan tidak bisa berdiri di tanah membuat siapa saja yang mendengarnya gemetaran.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50171_DESCRIPTION
desc: A horned rabbit that inhabits a small part of Grand Gaia. They are herbivores, but they are very territorial and indiscriminately lay waste to anyone who steps foot in their territory. One can crush a stone with a full on attack making use of the tremendous spring power in its hind legs. They are, however, sometimes seen struggling to get their horn free, having rammed it through something and getting it stuck. The scream of an Al-mi'raj that's gotten its horn stuck up high and is unable to stand on the ground is enough to make anyone who hears it tremble.

raw.es: Conejo cornudo que habita el área más pequeña de Gran Gaia. Son herbívoros, pero muy territoriales y devastan indiscriminadamente a aquellos que entren en su territorio. Pueden romper una roca utilizando el tremendo poder de salto de sus patas traseras. Sin embargo, algunas veces tienen problemas para destrabar sus cuernos, luego de embestir algo y quedarse atascados. El grito de un Al-mi'raj de pie y con su cornamenta en alza es suficiente para hacer que cualquiera tiemble de miedo.

raw.pt: Um coelho de chifres que habita uma pequena parte de Grand Gaia. Eles são herbívoros, mas são muito territoriais e acabam indiscriminadamente com qualquer um que invadir seu espaço. Eles podem esmagar pedras com um ataque em cheio, usando a tremenda potência gerada por suas pernas traseiras. Entretanto, às vezes é possível encontrar um deles com o chifre preso em algo que atacaram e atravessaram. O berro de um Al-mi’raj que trancou seu chifre no alto e não alcança o chão é o suficiente para fazer tremer aqueles que o ouvem.
raw.th: กระต่ายมีเขาที่อาศัยอยู่ในส่วนเล็กๆ ของแกรนด์ไกอา พวกมันเป็นสัตว์กินพืช แต่พวกมันห่วงถิ่นมากและจะกำจัดทุกอย่างที่ล่วงล้ำเข้ามาโดยไม่สนใจว่าเป็นอะไร พวกมันสามารถทำลายก้อนหินให้กระจายด้วยการโจมตีเต็มกำลังโดยใช้พลังสปริงตัวจากขาของมัน อย่างไรก็ตาม บางครั้งพวกมันก็ทำเขาติดจนดึงไม่ออกเพราะการโจมตี เสียงร้องของอัลมีร่าที่เขาติดนั้นสามารถทำให้ใครก็ตามที่ได้ยินต้องสั่นสะท้าน
raw.vi: Một con thỏ có sừng sinh sống ở một nơi nhỏ của Grand Gaia. Chúng là động vật ăn cỏ, nhưng chúng rất quen thuộc lãnh thổ và vứt chất thải bữa bãi vào những ai đặt chân lên lãnh thổ của chúng. Một con thỏ có thể ném đá rất mạnh bằng cách sử dụng sức mạnh mùa xuân mạnh ở chân sau của nó. Tuy vậy đôi khi chúng vẫn phải đấu tranh để có được sừng miễn phí của mình, sau khi đâm nó xuyên qua 1 cái gì đó và bị mắc kẹt. Tiếng hét của một Al-mi'raj khiến cho chiêc sừng của nó mọc lên cao hơn và không thể đứng vững trên mặt đất đủ để khiến cho ai đó có thể nghe thấy nó đang run rẩy

id: Monster kucing dengan 3 tanduk. Mutasi Al-mi'raj ini seperti kucing, tapi kepribadiannya sangat galak. Saat dijinakkan, susah membuatnya mematuhi perintah. Memakai cakar dan tanduk untuk mengoyak mangsa yang mendekat, Cait Sith juga dikenal sebagai "Bola Bulu Iris dan Cacah" di dunia liar. Ada beberapa orang yang antusias pemelihara Cait Sith sebagai kucing pemburu untuk menangkap Imp dan Incubus.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50172_DESCRIPTION
desc: A feline monster with 3 horns. This Al-mi'raj mutation may look like a cat, but its personality is extremely ferocious. Even when tamed, it's difficult to get it to follow orders. Using both its claws and horns to tear up any prey careless enough to get close, Cait Sith's have also been called the "Slice and Dice Fur Ball" in the wild. There are some enthusiasts who prize their pet Cait Siths as hunting cats which they use to capture Imps and Incubus's.

raw.es: Monstruo felino de tres cuernos. Esta mutación de Al-mi'raj quizá se vea como un simple gato, pero su personalidad es extremadamente feroz. Incluso cuando está domesticado, es difícil que siga órdenes. Utiliza las garras y los cuernos para destrozar a cualquier presa lo suficientemente descuidada como para acercársele. Cait Sith también ha sido llamado "El rebanador peludo" en estado salvaje. Algunos entusiastas utilizan a sus mascotas Cait Siths para cazar íncubos y duendes.

Usando suas garras e chifres para rasgar em pedaços qualquer presa descuidada o suficiente para se aprixomar, Cait Sith também foi apelidado de “bola de pelos e facas”. Existem alguns entusiastas que têm em alta estima seus Cait Siths, usando-os como gatos de caça para capturar diabretes e íncubos.
raw.th: มอนสเตอรืแมวที่มีสามเขา อัลมีร่ากลายพันธุ์นี้อาจจะดูเหมือนแมว แต่นิสัยของมันนั้นดุร้ายมากแม้ว่าจะถูกทำให้เชื่องแล้วก็ตาม มันยากที่จะให้พวกมันทำตามคำสั่ง มันใช้ทั้งเข้าและกรงเล็บในการจัดการเหยื่อที่ไม่ระวังตัวหลงเข้ามาใกล้ เคท สิธ ยังถูกเรียกอีกชื่อว่า "ก้อนขนเชือดและเฉือน" เวลาอยู่ในป่า ยังมีพวกคนรักแมวที่ใช้เค สิธของพวกเขาในการไล่จับอิมพ์และอินคิวบัส
raw.vi: một con mèo quái vật có 3 sừng. Dạng đột biến Al-mi'raj này trông giống như mèo  nhưng tính cách của nó lại rất hung tợn. Ngay cả khi được huấn luyện, vẫn rất khó để có thể bắt nó phục tùng. Nó sử dụng cả móng vuốt và sừng để xé bất cứ con mồi nào để tiến gần, Cait Sith's cũng được gọi 1 cách hoang dã là "Xúc xắc lông bóng". Có những người đam mê đạt được giải thưởn mèo Cait Siths là những con mèo đi săn mà họ sử dụng để bắt được Imps và Incubus's

id: Gadis kuil yang katanya turunan orang dari dunia lain yang tinggal di pegunungan Republik La Veda. Orang-orang ini tidak berdoa kepada para dewa Gaia Besar, tetapi pada bintang dan menganut kepercayaan unik bahwa mereka bisa membaca keberuntungan dari bintang. Meski kemampuan meramal Amul kecil belum berkembang, kemahirannya dengan pedang membuatnya bertumbuh menjadi salah satu yang akan melindungi rakyatnya. Meski demikian, ia berharap meningkatkan keahlian meramalnya dan tidak suka saat dicemooh monster.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50181_DESCRIPTION
desc: A shrine maiden said to have descended from a group of people from another world that inhabited the mountains in the La Veda Republic. These people didn't pray to the gods of Grand Gaia but to the stars and held the unique belief that they could read fortunes with them. Though the young Amul's fortune telling abilities weren't yet developed, her skills with a blade led to her sticking out as one who would one day protect her people. However, she wished to incrise her fortune telling skills, and disliked it when monsters provoked her.

raw.es: Una doncella perteneciente a un sagrario, supuesta descendiente de un grupo de personas provenientes de otro mundo que habitaban las montañas de la república de La Veda. Estas personas no le rezaban a los dioses de Gran Gaia sino a las estrellas y creían que podían leer el futuro a través de ellas. A pesar de que sus habilidades como vidente no se habían desarrollado por completo, la joven Amul poseía gran capacidad con el manejo de la espada, lo que hizo que se destacara como una persona capaz de proteger a su pueblo algún día. Sin embargo, ella deseaba mejorar sus habilidades de clarividencia y se molestaba cuando los monstruos la provocaban.

Meski kemampuan meramal Amul kecil belum berkembang, kemahirannya dengan pedang membuatnya bertumbuh menjadi salah satu yang akan melindungi rakyatnya. Meski demikian, ia berharap meningkatkan keahlian meramalnya dan tidak suka saat dicemooh monster.
raw.pt: Uma dama de templo que dizem ter vindo de um grupo de pessoas de outro mundo que viviam nas montanhas da República de La Veda. Essas pessoas não rezavam para os deuses de Grand Gaia, rezavam para as estrelas e tinham uma crença única de que conseguiam ler o futuro nelas. Apesar das habilidades de previsão da jovem Amul não estarem totalmente desenvolvidas, as habilidades dela com a espada fizeram com que ela se destacasse como aquela que um dia protegeria o próprio povo. No entanto, ela queria melhorar as habilidades de previsão e não gostava de ser provocada por monstros.
raw.th: มิโกะที่ว่ากันว่าสืบทอดมาจากกลุ่มของคนจากโลกอื่น ซึ่งอาศัยที่ภูเขาในสาธารณรัฐ ลา วีดา คนเหล่านี้ไม่ได้บูชาเทพเจ้าของแกรนด์ไกอาแต่บูชาดวงดาว และมีความเชื่อที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ว่าพวกเขาสามารถทำนายโชคชะตาด้วยดวงดาวได้ แม้ว่าความสามารถในการทำนายของสาวน้อยอามุลยังไม่พัฒนา แต่ทักษะในการใช้ดาบของเธอก็ทำให้เธอโดดเด่นในฐานะของคนที่วันหนึ่งจะปกป้องผู้คนของเธอ อย่างไรก็ตาม เธอปรารถนาที่จะพัฒนาวิชาการทำนายมากกว่าและไม่ชอบเวลาที่มอนสเตอร์มายั่วยุเธอ
raw.vi: Một trinh nữ trông đền được cho rằng có nguồn gốc từ một nhóm người đến từ một thế giới khác sinh sống ở vùng núi tại nước Cộng hòa La Veda.  Nhưng người này không cầu nguyện đến các vị thần của Grand Gaia nhưng cầu nguyện với các ngôi sao và giữ một niềm tin duy nhất rằng họ có thể đọc được vận mệnh bằng những ngôi sao. Mặc dù khả năng xem bói của Amul trẻ tuổi còn chưa phát triển, nhưng các kỹ năng của cô với kiếm đã khiến cô nổi lên như một người sẽ có một ngày bảo vệ người dân của cô. Tuy nhiên, cô muốn tăng các kỹ năng xem bói của mình và không thích khi bọn quái vật trêu chọc cô.

id: Gadis kuil yang katanya turunan orang dari dunia lain yang tinggal di pegunungan Republik La Veda. Amul melenyapkan banyak monster, tidak tidur dan tidak makan untuk melatih kemampuan meramalnya, ia jadi ahli dan tekniknya tak terkalahkan di antara orang-orang. Kekuatan spiritual Amul lebih kuat daripada para pendahulunya dan katanya ia punya kemampuan membaca segalanya dari posisi bintang dan memprediksi pergerakan monster.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50182_DESCRIPTION
desc: A shrine maiden said to have descended from a group of people from another world that inhabited the mountains in the La Veda Republic. As Amul vanquished monster after monster, sacrificing sleep and food to train her fortune telling abilities, she became proficient in both and her techniques were soon second to none among her people. Amul's spiritual power was stronger than any before her and it was said that she had the power to tell all things from the arrangement of the stars, and was even able to predict the movement of monsters.

raw.en: A shrine maiden said to have descended from a group of people from another world that inhabited the mountains in the La Veda Republic. Amul's spiritual power was stronger than any before her and it was said that she had the power to tell all things from the arrangement of the stars, and was even able to predict the movement of monsters.
raw.es: Una doncella perteneciente a un sagrario, supuesta descendiente de un grupo de personas provenientes de otro mundo que habitaban las montañas de la república de La Veda. Tras derrotar a cientos de monstruos, sacrificar horas de sueño y pasar largas jornadas con el estómago vacío, Amul logró dominar tanto sus habilidades de clarividencia como sus técnicas de batalla. Su destreza pronto superó la de todos los guerreros de su pueblo. Su poder espiritual era más fuerte que el de cualquier antecesor. Se decía que poseía el poder de predecir el futuro con solo observar la forma en que se encontraban organizadas las estrellas y que incluso podía vaticinar los movimientos de los monstruos.

raw.pt: Uma dama de templo que dizem ter vindo de um grupo de pessoas de outro mundo que viviam nas montanhas da República de La Veda. À medida que Amul acabava com os monstros e sacrificava sono e alimentação para treinar suas capacidades de previsão, as duas habilidades dela melhoravam a ponto de chegarem a ser as melhores entre o próprio povo. O poder espiritual de Amul era mais forte do que qualquer um que a antecedeu e dizem que ela tinha o poder de falar sobre tudo e até prever movimentos dos monstros com base nas posições das estrelas.
raw.th: มิโกะที่ว่ากันว่าสืบทอดมาจากกลุ่มของคนจากโลกอื่น ซึ่งอาศัยที่ภูเขาในสาธารณรัฐ ลา วีดา ขณะที่ อามุล กำจัดมอนสเตอร์ตัวแล้วตัวเล่า เธอก็ฝึกทักษะการทำนายด้วยการอดนอนกับอดอาหาร สุดท้ายเธอกลายเป็นผู้เชี่ยวชาญในศาสตร์ทั้งสองอย่างและในไม่ช้าก็ไม่เป็นที่สองรองใครในบรรดาผู้คนของเธอ พลังจิตวิญญาณของ อามุล แข็งแกร่งขึ้นกว่าแต่ก่อนและว่ากันว่าเธอมีพลังที่สามารถบอกทุกอย่างได้จากการเรียงตัวกันของดวงดาว จนถึงขั้นทำนายความเคลื่อนไหวของมอนสเตอร์ได้ล่วงหน้าเลยทีเดียว
raw.vi: Một trinh nữ trông đền được cho rằng có nguồn gốc từ một nhóm người đến từ một thế giới khác sinh sống ở vùng núi tại nước Cộng hòa La Veda.  Khi Amul đánh bại hết quái vật này đến quái vât khác, hy sinh giấc ngủ và thức ăn để luyện tập khả năng bói toán của cô, cô đã trở nên thành thạo cả hai và các kỹ thuật của cô sớm không ai sánh kịp trong dân gian. Sức mạnh tinh thần của Amull mạnh hơn trước khi và người ta nói rằng cô có sức mạnh để nói được mọi thứ từ sự sắp xếp của các vì sao và thậm chí có thể dự đoán hoạt động của quái vật.

id: Makhluk penasaran yang hidup di dalam pot yang katanya berkekuatan yang sanggup mengubah secara dramatis properti terang. Lembut dan ramah pada manusia, tapi cenderung menguji siapa saja yang ingin memiliki kekuatan pot untuk dirinya sendiri, sehingga mereka susah dipegang. Orang tidak boleh lupa bahwa menyentuh tanduk di kepala mereka akan menyebabkan mereka mengamuk.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50191_DESCRIPTION
desc: A curious creature that lives in a pot which is said to hold a power capable of dramatically changing the properties of light. As gentle and friendly to humans as it may be, it has a tendency to test those who wish to make the power it has hidden in its pot their own, making it likely very difficult to get ahold of. One also mustn't forget that simply touching the horn on its head can send it into a rage.

raw.en: A curious creature that lives in a pot which is said to hold a power capable of dramatically changing the properties of light. As gentle and friendly to humans as it may be, it has a tendency to test those who wish to make the power it has hidden in its pot their own, making it likely very difficult to get ahold of. One also mustn't forget that simply touching the horn on its head can send it into a rage.
raw.es: Una curiosa criatura. Vive en un pote que almacena poder capaz de cambiar dramáticamente las propiedades de la luz. Estas criaturas, si bien parecen gentiles y amistosas con los humanos, tienen la tendencia de poner a prueba a todos los que quieran quedarse con el poder de su pote. Esto hace que sean muy difíciles de capturar. No hay que olvidar que con un simple toque del cuerno que tienen en la cabeza, se puede hacer que esta criatura entre en un frenesí.

Orang tidak boleh lupa bahwa menyentuh tanduk di kepala mereka akan menyebabkan mereka mengamuk.
raw.pt: Uma criatura curiosa que vive em um pote e dizem ter um poder capaz de dramaticamente mudar as propriedades da luz. Por mais gentil e amigável que sejam com os humanos, eles têm uma tendência a testar aqueles que desejam tomar para si o poder oculto no seu pote, fazendo com que seja difícil pegá-los. Não se deve esquecer também de que um mero toque em seu chifre pode deixá-lo enfurecido.
raw.th: สิ่งมีชีวิตที่อยากรู้อยากเห็นอาศัยอยู่ในหม้อ ซึ่งว่ากันว่ามีพลังที่สามารถในการเปลี่ยนคุณสมบัติของแสง แม้ว่ามันจะสุภาพและอ่อนโยนกับมนุษย์ มันก็มีแนวโน้มที่จะทดสอบผู้ที่หวังจะได้ครอบครองพลังของมันที่ซ่อนอยู่ในหม้อเป็นของตนเอง ทำให้ยากที่จะได้ตัวมันมาครอง และจะต้องไม่ลืมด้วยว่าแค่แตะเขาที่อยู่บนหัวมันก็สามารถทำให้มันบ้าคลั่งได้
raw.vi:
Một sinh vật kì dị sinh sống trong 1 chiếc bình được cho là nắm giữ sức mạnh có thể làm thay đổi những thuộc tính của ánh sáng. Rất thân thiện và tốt bụng với con người, nó thường có xu hướng kiểm tra những ai muốn tạo ra sức mạnh mà nó cất giấu trong chiếc bình của mình,
khiến rất khó để có thể có được. Một điều quan trọng không thể quên đó là nếu chỉ chạm vào sừng trên đầu nó cũng có thể khiến nó nổi cơn thịnh nộ

name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50202_DESCRIPTION
desc: This subspecies of Metal Ghost is said to have changed after having amassed extensive records on the element of light. It is called the most unlucky of the metal record species, and not just because of the amount of knowledge it holds within itself, but also because of the various things that come out of its mouth. The element of light is much stronger in them than in normal Metal Ghosts, and it's said that when fused to other light types they provide loads more experience as well.

O elemento da luz é mais forte nele do que nos Fantasmas do Metal normais, e dizem que quando fundidos a outros do tipo luz ele também dá muita experiência a mais.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าเมทัลโกสชนิดย่อยออกไปนี้ได้เปลี่ยนแปลงหลังจากได้รวบรวมบันทึกอย่างกว้างขวางเกี่ยวกับธาตุแสง มันถูกเรียกว่าเมทัลที่โชคร้ายที่สุดในสายพันธุ์ ไม่ใช่แค่เพราะจำนวนความรู้ที่มันเก็บอยู่ในตัว แต่เป็นเพราะหลายๆ สิ่งที่มันคายออกมาจากปากด้วย มันมีธาตุแห่งแสงที่แข็งแกร่งกว่าเมทัลทั่วไป และว่ากันว่าเมื่อผสมมันเข้ากับยูนิตแสงชนิดอื่นๆ พวกมันจะมอบค่าประสบการณ์เพิ่มอีกมากมาย
raw.vi: Loài phụ sinh của Quỷ kim loại được cho là đã thay đổi sau khi tích lũy được các kỉ lục lớn về yếu tố ánh sáng. Người ta gọi đó là điều không may mắn nhất của các loài kỉ lục kim loại và không chỉ bởi vì số bí kíp mà nó nắm giữ trong người, nhưng cũng bởi vì nhiều thứ khác mà chúng nói ra. Yếu tố ánh sáng cũng mạnh hơn trong chúng so với Các quỷ kim loại thông thường và người ta nói rằng khi bị tan chảy các loại ánh sáng khác cho nhiều tải hơn so với thông thường

desc: This subspecies of Metal King is said to hold within its large body a huge collection of information on the element of light. Eles são chamados de “Heróis do Metal” nos documentos de pesquisa relacionados à espécie de registro metálico. O que exatamente os Reis do Metal fizeram para se tornar conhecidos como heróis não foi registrado, mas parece que todos ao seu redor acham seus discursos fascinantes.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าเมทัลคิงชนิดย่อยนี้เก็บข้อมูลจำนวนมากเกี่ยวกับธาตุแสง พวกมันถูกเรียกว่า "เมทัลฮีโร่" ในเอกสารที่รวบรวมการค้นคว้าเกี่ยวกับสายพันธุ์เมทัล สิ่งที่ทำให้พวกมันถูกรู้จักกันว่าเป็นฮีโร่นั้นไม่ได้มีการบันทึกไว้ แต่ดูเหมือนว่าทุกคนที่อยู่ใกล้พวกมันจะพบว่าสิ่งที่พวกมันพูดนั้นน่าทึ่ง
raw.vi: Loài phụ sinh của Vua kim loại này được cho là giữ trong cơ thể to lớn của nó một bộ sưu tập khổng lồ các thông tin về yếu tố ánh sáng. Chúng được gọi là "Anh hùng kim loại" trong những tài liệu nghiên cứu thu thập. Điều chính xác mà Vua kim loại làm để mọi người biết đến họ như những vị anh hùng không được ghi lại nhưng dường như mọi người xung quanh họ thấy được rằng những gì họ nói nghe có vẻ rất hấp dẫn

id: Subspesies Dewa Logam katanya badannya mengandung koleksi besar informasi dunia yang diketahui. Kepribadiannya sangat santai, meski adalah subspesies, mereka adalah tetua spesies rekaman logam. name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50204_DESCRIPTION
desc: This subspecies of Metal God is said to hold within its massive body an enormous collection of information on the known world. They have a very relaxed personality, and, despite them being a subspecies, they are considered the elders of the metal record species. They also have a great variety of knowledge which is not just useful in improving the lives of members of their fellow species, but is also used to give useful advice to humans which has helped them to gain recognition among normal people, too.

raw.es: Se dice que esta subespecie de Dios metálico almacena dentro de su robusto cuerpo una gran colección de información sobre el mundo conocido. Son muy relajados y, a pesar de que son una subespecie, se los considera como los ancestros de las especies metálicas. También tienen una variedad de conocimiento que no solo es útil para mejorar la vida de los miembros de su misma especie, sino que también se usa para aconsejar a los humanos. Esto les ha permitido ganarse el reconocimiento de la gente normal.

raw.pt: Dizem que esta subespécie de Deus do Metal guarda em seu enorme corpo uma coleção igualmente enorme de informações sobre o mundo conhecido. Eles têm uma personalidade muito calma e, apesar de ser uma subespécie, são considerados os anciões da espécie de registro metálico. Eles também têm conhecimentos muito variados, o que não é útil somente para melhorar as vidas de suas espécies-irmãs, mas também têm muitos conselhos úteis a humanos que os ajudam, o que os ajudou a serem reconhecidos por pessoas normais também.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าเมทัลก๊อดชนิดย่อยนี้เก็บข้อมูลมหาศาลที่โลกรู้ไว้ในร่างการใหญ่ยักษ์ของมัน พวกมันมีนิสัยสบายๆ และแม้ว่าจะเป็นชนิดย่อยของสายพันธุ์ แต่พวกมันก็จัดได้ว่าเป็นผู้เฒ่าของเหล่าสายพันธุ์เมทัล และวพกมันก็ยังมีความรู้หลากหลายที่ไม่เพียงแต่เป็นประโยชน์ในการพัฒนาชีวิตของเผ่าพันธุ์พวกมัน แต่ยังใช้เคำแนะนำที่มีประโยชน์สำหรับมนุษย์ซึ่งทำให้พวกมันเป็นที่รู้จักโดยคนทั่วไปอีกด้วย

Jatuh cinta pada pandangan pertama dengan Atros, ia mengikuti ujian ketat masuk ksatria untuk belajar seni pedang dari Atros sendiri. Setelah menjadi bagian dari ordo, ternyata Atros bukan anggota ksatria di sana. name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50242_DESCRIPTION
desc: A girl from the La Veda Republic. One day she was attacked by a thief, and later rescued by one of the Six Heroes, Atros. Having fallen in love at first sight with Atros, she undertook a rigorous examination to enter knighthood in order to learn the art of the sword from Atros himself. However, after becoming a part of the order, she then discovered that Atros was not a member of the knighthood there. Heartbroken, Will , the leader of the knights, tried to comfort her by stating that "her form with a bow was a thing of beauty." Somehow misunderstanding, she took up the bow and one year later had already become the best archer in the republic.

raw.es: Una chica de la república de La Veda. En una oportunidad un ladrón la atacó, y uno de los Seis héroes, llamado Atros, la rescató. Lo de Mila fue amor a primera vista. Se dedicó a realizar una investigación rigurosa en afán de entrar a la unidad de caballeros y poder aprender el arte de la espada de manos del mismísimo Atros. Sin embargo, tras convertirse en miembro de la orden, descubrió que Atros no era miembro de esa misma unidad. El corazón de Mila se partió en pedazos. Will, el líder de los caballeros, intentó consolarla diciéndole que "su manejo del arco era algo digno de belleza". Un poco confundida, Mila tomó el arco y un año después se había convertido en la mejor arquera de la república.

raw.pt: Uma garota da República de La Veda. Um dia ela foi atacada por um ladrão, sendo depois resgatada por um dos Seis Heróis, Atros. Cedendo ao amor à primeira vista por Atros, ela se submeteu a um rigoroso exame para entrar na cavalaria para aprender a arte da espada com o próprio Atros. Porém, depois de se tornar parte da ordem, ela descobriu que Atros não era um membro da cavalaria ali. De coração partido, o líder dos cavaleiros, Will, tentou consolá-la dizendo que “sua forma, como um arco, era algo belo”. De alguma forma entendendo errado, ela tomou o arco e um ano depois já havia se tornado a melhor arqueira da república.
raw.th: เด็กสาวจากสาธารณรัฐลาวีดา วันหนึ่งเธอถูกโจมตีโดยโจรและต่อมาได้รับการช่วยเหลือโดยหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษอาโทร เธอได้ตกหลุมรักเขาตั้งแต่แรกเห็น เธอมารับการทดสอบอย่างเข้มงวดในการบรรจุเป็นอัศวิน เพื่อที่จะเรียนรู้ศิลปะของดาบจากตัวอาโทรเอง อย่างไรก็ตามหลังจากที่กลายเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของกองกำลัง เธอก็ค้นพบว่าอาโทรไม่ได้เป็นสมาชิกของอัศวินที่นั่น หลังจากอกหัก วิวหัวหน้าของอัศวินพยายามที่จะปลอบใจเธอด้วยการบอกว่า "รูปร่างของเธอที่เหมือนกับคันธนูเป็นสิ่งที่สวยงามมาก" ด้วยความเข้าใจผิด เธอจึงหยิบคันธนูขึ้น และอีกหนึ่งปีต่อมา เธอก็ได้กลายเป็นนักธนูที่เก่งที่สุดในสาธารณรัฐ
raw.vi: Một cô gái đến từ nước Cộng hòa La Veda. Một ngày nọ, cô bị tấn công bởi một tên trộm, và sau đó được giải cứu bởi một trong Sáu vị anh hùng, Atros. Yêu Atros ngay từ cái nhìn đầu tiên, cô đã tham gia một cuộc kiểm tra nghiêm ngặt để được nhận vào tầng lớp hiệp sĩ để được học nghệ thuật sử dụng kiếm từ chính Atros. Tuy nhiên, khi đạt được thứ bậc đó, cô đã phát hiện ra rằng Atros không phải là thành viên của tầng lớp hiệp sĩ ở đó. Đau khổ, Will, chỉ huy của các hiệp sĩ, đã cố gắng an ủi cô bằng cách nói rằng "hình thức của cô cùng với cây cung là một điều tuyệt đẹp." Không biết hiểu lầm làm sao, cô đã cầm cây cung lên và một năm sau đó, cô đã trở thành cung thủ tốt nhất ở nước cộng hòa.

id: Pemanah dari Republik La Veda. Setelah bergabung dengan ordo ksatria di republik agar lebih dekat dengan Atros, begitu ia menjadi ksatria, minatnya berpindah ke sang pemimpin, Will. Ksatria senior bernama Aem biasanya melirik dengan mata sugestif, tapi ia menganggapnya sebagai tanda Aem tertarik padanya. Dengan bakat seni perang yang hebat, reputasinya berkembang di negara-negara lain, memuji keahlian menembaknya yang tepat, dan kecepatan memukaunya. Putri bangasawan ini menjadi figur yang dikagumi dan ditakuti.

desc: An archer from the La Veda Republic. Having joined the order of knights in the republic to get closer to Atros, once she became a knight her interest shifted towards their leader, Will. A senior knight by the name of Aem used to look at her with suggestive eyes, but she took this as a sign of his interest in her. With an incredible talent for the art of war, her reputation grew in other countries, praising her machine-like precision shooting skills, and outstanding speed. This daughter of a noble came to be a figure to be both admired and feared.

raw.pt: Uma arqueira da República de La Veda. Tendo entrado na ordem de cavalaria da república para ficar mais perto de Atros, depois de se tornar uma cavaleira seu interesse mudou para o líder Will. Um cavaleiro sênior de nome Aem costumava encará-la com olhares sugestivos, mas ela tomou isso como sinal de seu interesse por ela. Com um talento incrível para a arte da guerra, sua reputação cresceu em outros países, sendo elogiada sua precisão praticamente mecânica e velocidade com o arco. Essa filha de um nobre veio a ser uma figura tanto admirada quanto temida.
raw.th: นักธนูจากสาธารณรัฐลาวีดา ได้เข้าร่วมกับกลุ่มของอัศวินของสาธารณรัฐเพื่อที่จะได้ใกล้ชิดกับอาโทร แต่เมื่อเธอได้กลายเป็นอัศวิน ความสนใจของเธอก็เปลี่ยนไปที่วิว หัวหน้าของพวกนั้น อัศวินรุ่นพี่ที่ชื่อว่าเอมมักจะมองเธอด้วยสายตาเป็นนัย แต่เธอกลับคิดว่านี่เป็นสัญญาณที่เขาเข้าใจในตัวเธอ  ด้วยความสามารถที่เหลือเชื่อในศิลปะแห่งสงคราม ชื่อเสียงของเธอก็เติบโตขึ้นในประเทศอื่นๆ ยกย่องทักษะการยิงธนูที่แม่นยำราวกับเครื่องจักร และความเร็วที่โดดเด่นของเธอ บุตรสาวของขุนนางผู้นี้กลายเป็นตัวอย่างของทั้งความชื่นชมและหวาดกลัว
raw.vi: Một cung thủ đến từ nước Cộng hòa La Veda. Sau khi đã tham gia vào tầng lớp hiệp sĩ tại nước cộng hòa này để tiếp cận với Atros, khi cô trở thành hiệp sĩ, mối quan tâm của cô đã chuyển sang chỉ huy của họ là Will. Một hiệp sĩ cấp cao tên là Aem thường nhìn cô bằng con mắt khêu gợi, nhưng cô coi đây là dấu hiệu anh ta quan tâm đến cô. Với tài năng đáng kinh ngạc về nghệ thuật chiến tranh, cô dần nổi danh ở các quốc gia khác, họ ca ngợi kỹ năng bắn chính xác như máy và tốc độ vượt trội của cô. Con gái của một bá tước này đã trở thành một nhân vật vừa được ngưỡng mộ vừa là nỗi lo sợ.

id: Unit uji coba yang dimodel dari Tilith, dewi yang melayani Lucius dan memerintah Gerbang. Rumornya, kesuksesan Unit uji coba si dewa adalah berkat informasi yang diperoleh Aula Pemanggil yang berhubungan dengannya. Meski informasi ini tidak menjabarkan bagaimana cara membuat ulang kekuatan sejati si dewi, sehingga Unit jauh lebih lemah. Masih lama sebelum "dewi cantik dan gigih" bisa dibuat ulang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50253_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mock Unit modeled after Tilith, the goddess who serves Lucius and governs the Gate. There's a rumor that the success of the goddess's mock Unit was thanks to information obtained from Summoner Hall authorities who were in contact with her. However, this information didn't explicit how to recreate the goddess's true power, therefore the resulting Unit is far weaker. There's still a long way to go before the "beautifully indomitable goddess" can be recreated.

raw.en: A mock Unit modeled after Tilith, the goddess who serves Lucius and governs the Gate. There's a rumor that the success of the goddess's mock Unit was thanks to information obtained from Summoner Hall authorities who were in contact with her. raw.es: Unidad de práctica hecha a imagen de Tilith, la diosa que sirve a Lucius y gobierna el Portal. Se rumorea que el éxito de la unidad de práctica de la diosa se dio gracias a la información proveniente de las autoridades del Consejo de invocadores que estaban en contacto con ella. Sin embargo, en la información obtenida no se explicitaba cómo recrear los verdaderos poderes de la diosa. Esto causó que la unidad fuera mucho más débil. Hay un largo trecho por recorrer hasta que se pueda recrear a la "diosa hermosa e indomable".

raw.pt: Uma unidade baseada em Tilith, a deusa que serve Lucius e governa o Portal. Existe um boato de que o sucesso da cópia da deusa foi graças a informações obtidas de autoridades do Salão dos Invocadores, que estavam em contato com ela. Porém, esta informação não explicava como recriar o verdadeiro poder da deusa, portanto esta unidade é muito mais fraca. Ainda estamos longe de recriar a “deusa maravilhosamente invencível”.
raw.th: ยูนิตลอกเลียนที่สร้างตามแบบ ทิลิธ เทพธิดาผู้รับใช้ลูเชียสและควบคุมประตู มีข่าวลือว่าผลสำเร็จของยูนิตเลียนแบบเทพธิดาเป็นเพราะข้อมูลที่ได้รับมาจากผู้ใหญ่ที่มีอำนาจในสภาซัมมอนเนอร์ที่ได้เคยติดต่อกับเธอโดยตรง อย่างไรก็ตาม ข้อมูลนี้ก็ไม่ได้เปิดเผยวิธีจำลองพลังที่แท้จริงของเทพธิดาไว้ด้วย จึงเป็นผลให้ยูนิตนั้นอ่อนแอกว่ามาก หนทางยังอีกยาวไกลกว่าที่ "เทพธิดาแสนสวยผู้ทรหด" จะสามารถถูกจำลองได้อย่างแท้จริง
raw.vi: Một Nhân vật giả bắt chước theo Tilith, nữ thần phục vụ Lucius và cai trị Gate. Có tin đồn rằng thành công của Nhân vật giả nữ thần này là nhờ thông tin có được từ những người có quyền lực của Lâu đài người triệu hồi có quan hệ với cô. Tuy nhiên, thông tin này không nêu rõ cách thức tái tạo sức mạnh thực sự của nữ thần do đó Nhân vật tạo thành yếu hơn nhiều. Vẫn còn một chặng đường dài phải đi trước khi có thể tái tạo được "nữ thần xinh đẹp không thể khuất phục".

id: Unit uji coba yang dimodel dari Tilith. Kekuatan sangat tingginya bisa dilihat dari cara ia mengalahkan musuh setannya dan dari berbagai keajaiban yang ia lakukan. Temuan fasilitas riset mengindikasikan bhawa kekuatannya mungkin jauh lebih kuat daripada yang ia sadari, dan mereka menyimpulkan dari banyak Pemanggil yang telah mendukungnya untuk melanjutkan riset.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50254_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mock Unit modeled after the goddess Tilith. Her extremely high power could be seen in the way she outclassed her demonic opponents and from the countless other miraculous things she did. Also, the research facility's findings indicated that her powers may be even stronger than she had realized herself, and they've made it a point to hear from as many of the Summoners who've supported her as possible in continuing their research.

raw.en: A mock Unit modeled after the goddess Tilith. Her extremely high power could be seen in the way she outclassed her demonic opponents and from the countless other miraculous things she did. Also, the research facility's findings indicated that her powers may be even stronger than she had realized herself, and they've made it a point to hear from as many of the Summoners who've supported her as possible in continuing their research.
raw.es: Unidad de práctica hecha a imagen de Tilith. Su poder extremadamente elevado pudo apreciarse cuando sobrepasó a sus oponentes demoníacos y en la innumerable cantidad de actos milagrosos que realizó. Asimismo, los hallazgos del centro de investigaciones indicaron que sus poderes quizá hayan sido superiores a lo que ella misma creía poseer. Los miembros del centro, mientras continuaban con sus estudios, se plantearon escuchar a la mayor cantidad de invocadores que habían apoyado a la diosa.
raw.id: Unit uji coba yang dimodel dari Tilith. Kekuatan sangat tingginya bisa dilihat dari cara ia mengalahkan musuh setannya dan dari berbagai keajaiban yang ia lakukan.
